text:
The 30th Tank Corps was formed entirely in the Urals Military District as a result of a decree issued by the Sverdlovsk Communist Party authorities on 24 February 1943 calling for the organization of a 'Urals Volunteer' Tank Corps from the various militia and volunteer units raised by the Party. Most of the units were formed at Sverdlovsk and Chelyabinsk, and while the enthusiastic Urals Military District military and local Communist Party authorities formed a complete set of supporting subordinate units, not all of them remained with the corps! While forming between March and early July 1943 the corps benefited from having all the various local government (and Communist Party) groups trying to outdo each other in volunteering equipment and support for the unit. When the unit left the Urals Military District in early July it was assigned to 4th Tank Army. When it went into action for the first time with 4th Tank Army on 27 July the corps consisted of:<cr><cr>197th Tank Brigade
243rd Tank Brigade
244th Tank Brigade
30th Motorized Rifle Brigade
1621st SU Regiment (21 SU-76s)
299th Mortar Regiment (36 120mm mortars)
1513th Antitank Regiment
219th Antiaircraft Regiment (16 37mm guns)
742nd Antitank Battalion (12 85mm guns)
248th Guards Mortar Battalion (8 BM-13 launchers)
88th Motorcycle Battalion
743rd Sapper Battalion
Signal, Medical, Repair Units<cr><cr>The 30th Tank Corps fought under 4th Tank Army in the summer of 1943, in offensive actions that collapsed the Orel salient and, by the end of September, had liberated both Bryansk and Smolensk. In recognition of its role in these actions, on 26 October 1943, in accordance with Order Number 306 of the High Command, 30th Tank Corps became the 10th Urals Volunteer Guards Tank Corps.<cr><cr>Soviet Order of Battle World War II Volume II by Charles C. Sharp
translation:
第30坦克军于1943年2月24日根据斯维尔德洛夫斯克共产党当局的命令在乌拉尔军区完全组建而成，该命令要求从各种民兵和志愿单位中组织一支“乌拉尔志愿者”坦克军。大多数部队是在斯维尔德洛夫斯克和车里雅宾斯克建立起来的，并且尽管热情高涨的乌拉尔军区军事当局以及当地共产党当局组成了完整的支援下属单位，但并非所有这些单位都留在了该军中！在1943年3月至7月初组建期间，该军受益于各种地方政府（和共产党）团体试图互相竞争提供装备和支持。当该部队于1943年7月初离开乌拉尔军区时，被分配给第4坦克集团军。当它首次与第4坦克集团军在1943年7月27日投入战斗时，其组成如下：
<cr>
<cr>
第197坦克旅
第243坦克旅
第244坦克旅
第30摩托化步兵旅
第1621自行火炮团（21门SU-76）
第299迫击炮团（36门120毫米迫击炮）
第1513反坦克团
第219防空团（16门37毫米高射炮）
第742反坦克营（12门85毫米火炮）
第248近卫迫击炮营（8具BM-13火箭发射器）
第88摩托化步兵营
第743工兵营
通信、医疗、维修单位
<cr>
<cr>
在1943年夏天，第30坦克军与第4坦克集团军一起作战，在进攻行动中摧毁了奥廖尔突出部，并且到九月底解放了布良斯克和斯摩棱斯克。为了表彰其在这次行动中的贡献，根据最高统帅部命令第306号，该部队于1943年10月26日被改编为第10乌拉尔志愿者近卫坦克军。
<cr>
<cr>苏联战斗序列 二战卷二 查尔斯·C·肖普著

text:
The 30th Tank Division was formed from 32nd Light Tank Brigade in February 1941 at Pruzhan, Western Special Military District as part of 14th Mechanized Corps. On 22
June 1941 included:<cr><cr>59th Tank Regiment
1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th Tank Bns - each 25 to 32 T-26 tanks
60th Tank Regiment
1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th Tank Bns - each 25 to 32 T-26 tanks
30th Motorized Rifle Regiment
1st, 2nd, 3rd bns
30th Motorized Howitzer Regiment
1 light, 1 medium bn
30th Reconnaissance Battalion
30th Motorized Pontoon Battalion
30th Antiaircraft Battalion - 2 batteries of 37mm only<cr><cr>The 30th Tank Division, like many units formed from an existing Tank Brigade, was very short of trucks and tractors for the rifle regiment or the artillery, even though both those units had all their authorized weapons. The division had just 243 T-26 tanks on 22 June, and only 120 of those managed to make it out of the motor pool on the first day of the war. 30% of those broke down on the first move, and by 23 June the divison had only about 40 working tanks left! With most of the rest of the division already on foot for lack of motorization, the entire division was overrun and destroyed in the Minsk pocket and officially disbanded in early July.<cr><cr>Soviet Order of Battle Volume I by Charles C. Sharp
translation:
第30坦克师于1941年2月在普鲁尚，西部特别军区从第32轻型坦克旅组建，并成为第14机械化军的一部分。6月22日包括：
<cr><cr>第59坦克团
第1、2、3、4坦克营——每营25至32辆T-26坦克
第60坦克团
第1、2、3、4坦克营——每营25至32辆T-26坦克
第30机械化步兵团
第1、2、3营
第30机械化榴弹炮团
轻型和中型营各一个
第30侦察营
第30机械化浮桥营
第30防空营——仅两个37毫米高射炮连<cr><cr>与许多从现有坦克旅组建的单位一样，第30坦克师严重缺乏卡车和拖拉机供步兵团或炮兵团使用。尽管这些部队拥有所有授权武器，该师在6月22日仅有243辆T-26坦克，在战争第一天只有120辆能够驶出车库。其中30%的车辆在首次移动时就抛锚了，到6月23日，仅剩下约40辆可工作的坦克！由于缺乏机动能力，该师其余大部分部队已经徒步作战，整个师被包围并消灭于明斯克包围圈，并于7月初正式解散。<cr><cr>苏联战斗序列第一卷 作者：查尔斯·C·夏普

text: The 310th Rifle Division was a standard Red Army rifle division formed on July 15, 1941 in Kazakhstan before being sent to the vicinity of Leningrad, where it spent most of the war, sharing a similar combat path with its 'sister', the 311th Rifle Division. The soldiers of the division fought until early 1944 to, first, hold open some sort of lifeline to the besieged city, then to break the siege and drive off the besieging German forces. They then participated in the offensive that drove Germany's Finnish allies out of the war. Finally, the division was redeployed to take the fight to the German heartland in the winter and spring of 1945. It ended the war north of Berlin with a very creditable combat record for any rifle division.<cr><cr>
translation: 第310步兵师是红军于1941年7月15日在哈萨克斯坦组建的一个标准步兵师，随后被派往列宁格勒附近，在那里度过了大部分战争时间，并与它的“姊妹”师——第311步兵师有着相似的战斗历程。该师士兵一直奋战到1944年初，先是为围困的城市保持一条生命线，然后打破包围并击退德国入侵者。之后他们参与了将芬兰盟军逐出战争的攻势行动。最后，该师在1945年冬春之交被重新部署，向德国本土发起进攻，在柏林以北结束了战斗，并取得了步兵师中非常值得称赞的战绩。<cr>指挥官报告：第310步兵师是一支英勇善战、屡建奇功的部队。

text: The 311th Rifle Division was a standard Red Army rifle division formed on July 14, 1941 at Kirov before being sent to the vicinity of Leningrad, where it spent most of the war, sharing a similar combat path with its 'sister', the 310th Rifle Division. The men and women of the division were fully engaged in the struggle for Leningrad until early 1944, fighting in several offensives to drive a lifeline through the German positions to the besieged city, and then to finally drive the besiegers away. When this was accomplished, the division was redeployed to take the fight into the Baltic States in 1944, then into the German heartland in the winter and spring of 1945. It ended the war north of Berlin after compiling a very distinguished record of service.<cr><cr>
translation: 第311步兵师是标准的红军步兵师，成立于1941年7月14日的基洛夫。该师随后被派往列宁格勒附近，在那里度过了大部分战争时间，并与它的“姊妹”师——第310步兵师有着相似的战斗历程。师里的官兵们全力投入了对列宁格勒的斗争，直到1944年初，他们参与了几次攻势，试图在德军阵地中开辟一条生命线通往被围困的城市，然后驱逐包围者。当这一目标实现后，该师于1944年重新部署到波罗的海国家作战，并在1945年的冬季和春季进入德国腹地作战。战争结束时，该师位于柏林以北地区，取得了非常卓越的服务记录。<cr><cr><cr><cr>

text:
The 313th began forming on July 15, 1941 in the Udmurt ASSR in the Urals Military District. Maj. Gen. Anton Aleksandrovich Pavlovich was given command of the division on the day it began forming. In August, while still forming up, the division was assigned to the Reserve of the Supreme High Command and between September 5 - 9 it arrived in the Petrozavodsk area near Lake Onega and was assigned to the 7th Army. In October it moved north and became part of the Karelian Front, in the Medvezhegorskaya Operational Group, which became the 2nd Formation of the 32nd Army in March 1942. In mid-October, General Pavlovich handed command to Col. Aleksandr Pavlovich Petrov, but he in turn was replaced by Col. Grigorii Vasilevich Golovanov a month later; Golovanov remained in command until the end of February 1944. The 313th also remained on this static front, facing the Finns just south of the Arctic Circle, until the summer of 1944. On July 19, 1943, it was awarded the Order of the Red Banner for 'exemplary fulfillment of command tasks' and its 'valor and courage'.<cr><cr>Leningrad Front began its offensive on the Isthmus of Karelia on June 10, making rapid progress towards Vyborg despite strong Finnish resistance. On June 16 the Finnish commander-in-chief, Marshal Mannerheim, issued orders to give up East Karelia, to free up forces for the main front on the Isthmus, so when Karelian Front launched its own offensive on the 20th it faced a very fluid situation. The 313th was tasked with clearing the railway southwards along the western shores of Lake Onega to link up with 7th Army. It did so on June 29 at Petrozavodsk, and was distinguished with the name of the town where it had arrived at the front, and finally liberated nearly three years later, as an honorific. Following this, the division helped continue to push the Finnish forces back to the so-called U-Line, along the Uksu River - Lake Loimola - Lake Tolva, north of Lake Ladoga, which was reached by July 10.<cr><cr>In November, when this operation was ended, the 313th was transferred to the 19th Army in the Reserve of the Supreme High Command. It returned to the fighting front in January 1945, in the 132nd Rifle Corps of that Army, in the 2nd Belorussian Front, and fought under those headquarters until the end of the war. At the start of the second phase of the Vistula-Oder Offensive on February 24, 19th Army attached the division to the 3rd Guards Tank Corps as an exploitation force to drive through to the Baltic coast north of Koslin to cut the path to the west of the German forces in eastern Pomerania. By the 27th the tanks had made great progress, advancing as much as 60km, forcing units of German 2nd Army to fall back without much resistance, but the rifle divisions were falling behind; the 313th reached Gross Karzenburg on this date, some 45km farther back. As well, 19th Army headquarters was losing communications with its troops, and the Front had to order a delay of the further offensive by the tank corps while the Army reorganized.

On March 5 the division received its last commander, Col. Vasilii Andryanovich Asafev, replacing Colonel Tsygankov. In April, the 313th participated in the Berlin Strategic Offensive Operation, and ended the war north of Berlin. When hostilities ceased, the division carried the official title of 313th Rifle, Petrozavodsk, twice Order of the Red Banner, Order of Suvorov, Order of Kutuzov Division.<cr><cr>
translation:
第313师于1941年7月15日在乌德穆尔特自治州开始组建，隶属于乌拉尔军区。该师成立当天由安托ン·亚历山大维奇·帕夫洛维奇少将指挥。8月，尚未完全编成的第313师被分配给最高统帅部预备队，在9月5日至9日期间抵达奥涅加湖附近的彼得罗扎沃茨克地区，并被分配给第7集团军。10月，该师向北移动并成为卡累利阿方面军的一部分，隶属于梅德韦日戈尔斯卡亚战役群，在1942年3月成为第32集团军的第二编成部队。10月中旬，帕夫洛维奇将军将指挥权移交给亚历山大·帕夫洛维奇·彼得罗夫上校，但一个月后又被格里戈利·瓦西里耶维奇·哥卢万诺夫上校取代；哥卢万诺夫一直担任指挥官直到1944年2月底。第313师一直在这一静态战线上面对芬兰军队，直至北极圈以南的1944年夏季。1943年7月19日，该师因“出色完成命令任务”及其“英勇和勇气”，被授予红旗勋章。<cr><cr><cr><cr>列宁格勒方面军于6月10日开始在卡累利阿地峡发动攻势，尽管遭遇了芬兰的强烈抵抗，仍迅速向维堡推进。6月16日，芬兰总司令曼纳海姆元帅下令放弃东卡累利阿地区，以便将部队调往主战场——卡累利阿地峡。因此，当卡累利阿方面军于20日发动自己的攻势时，面对的是一个非常混乱的局面。第313师的任务是沿着奥涅加湖西岸清理铁路线向南推进，与第7集团军会合。该师在6月29日在彼得罗扎沃茨克完成了任务，并以到达前线的城市名称作为荣誉称号。最终，在将近三年后解放了这座城市。随后，该师继续帮助将芬兰军队推回到所谓的U线——乌斯库河-洛伊莫拉湖-托尔瓦湖一线，这条防线在7月10日被突破。<cr>指挥官报告：<cr>第313师于6月29日在彼得罗扎沃茨克完成了任务，并以到达前线的城市名称作为荣誉称号。最终，在将近三年后解放了这座城市。11月，当此次行动结束时，第313步兵师被调至最高统帅部预备队中的第19集团军。该师于1945年1月返回前线，在第19集团军的第132步兵军和第二白俄罗斯方面军中作战，并在这些司令部指挥下一直战斗到战争结束。1945年2月24日，第二次维斯瓦-奥得河攻势开始时，第19集团军将该师编入第三近卫坦克军作为追击部队，向科松以北的波罗的海沿岸推进，切断东波美拉尼亚德军西撤的道路。到27日为止，坦克取得了巨大进展，最远前进了60公里，迫使德国第2集团军的部分单位后撤，并未遇到太多抵抗；但步兵师却落在了后面；第313步兵师当天到达格罗斯·卡岑堡，距离前线约45公里。此外，第19集团军司令部与部队之间的通信中断，方面军不得不命令坦克军暂停进攻，以便集团军重新组织。

该师于3月5日迎来了最后一位指挥官，瓦西里·安德烈亚诺维奇·阿萨菲夫上校，接替了茨冈科夫上校。4月份，第313步兵师参加了柏林战略进攻行动，并在战争结束时位于柏林以北地区。<cr>停战后，该师获得了官方称号：两次荣获红旗勋章的第313步兵师（彼得罗扎沃茨克），苏沃洛夫勋章和库图佐夫勋章师。<cr> <cr>

text: The 318th Rifle Division began forming on June 15, 1942, in and near Novorossiysk on the coast of the Black Sea, as a standard Red Army rifle division; it was later re-formed as a mountain rifle division, but exactly when this happened is disputed among the various sources. It fought in the area it was formed in until September, 1943, and was granted the name of this city as an honorific. In November of that year it took part in the largest Soviet amphibious operation of the war, across the Kerch Straits into the easternmost part of the Crimea, but its small beachhead was eliminated some weeks later. After the Crimea was liberated in May, 1944, it remained there for several months before it was transferred to the Carpathian Mountains west of Ukraine as a mountain division, and spent the remainder of the war fighting through Czechoslovakia in the direction of Prague.<cr><cr>
translation: 第318步兵师于1942年6月15日在黑海沿岸的诺沃罗西斯克及其附近开始组建，作为标准的红军步兵师；后来被重组为山地步兵师，但具体何时发生这一变化在各种资料中存在争议。该师一直在其组建地区作战至1943年9月，并因此城之名获得荣誉命名。同年11月，它参与了苏联战时规模最大的两栖行动之一，横跨刻赤海峡进入克里米亚半岛东部，但几周后其小型滩头阵地被消灭。在1944年5月解放克里米亚之后，该师在那里驻扎了几个月，然后作为山地师被转移到乌克兰西部的喀尔巴阡山脉，并在战争剩余时间里向布拉格方向穿过捷克斯洛伐克作战。<cr><cr>

text: The 319th Rifle Division was first formed in December 1941, as a standard Red Army rifle division, in the Moscow Military District, but after a month was redesignated as the 2nd formation of a pre-war division that had been destroyed and disbanded. Another 319th was formed in the summer of 1942 in the North Caucasus Military District while the German offensive was threatening the Soviet oilfields near Baku. This formation had a short and undistinguished career, seeing little combat, and was disbanded in December. A third and final 319th was formed in the autumn of 1943 in the northern part of the front. This unit gave very creditable service for the duration of the war, distinguishing itself in the fighting through the Baltic states, and completing its combat path East Prussia.<cr><cr>
translation: 第319步兵师于1941年12月在莫斯科军区组建为标准的红军步兵师，但一个月后被重新指定为战前一个已被消灭并解散的师的第二次重建。另一个第319步兵师于1942年夏季在北高加索军区组建，当时德军进攻威胁到巴库附近的苏联油田。这个部队有着短暂且不显赫的职业生涯，很少参与战斗，并于同年12月被解散。第三个也是最后一个第319步兵师于1943年秋季在前线北部地区重建。该部在整个战争期间表现出色，在波罗的海诸国的战斗中表现突出，并完成了其在东普鲁士的作战任务。<cr>指挥官报告：<cr><cr><cr>第319步兵师<cr><cr>

text: The 31st Army engaged the Germans on October 2, 1941, during Operation Typhoon. On October 6, it formed a task force under the command of Major General Polenov and along with a task force from 19th Army under the command of Lieutenant General I. Boldin, was given the mission to break the enemy advance near Volokolamsk and Rzhev. On October 7 the first snow fell, turning the roads into mud and forcing the 3rd Panzer Group's advance to a halt. The snow allowed the army to set up defensive positions along the line, Zhuralyovo - Large Yakovtsevo - Ivashkova and create a corridor for retreating Soviet troops. This began the Kalinin Defensive phase of the Moscow Strategic Defensive operations.<cr>From October 19 to 22, the army fought against German forces which had broken into the district of Mednoye and received reinforcements from the 113th and 252nd Rifle Divisions. On October 22, the army was ordered to take the offensive in conjunction with the 29th and 30th Armies to liberate the city of Kalinin. While unable to retake the city, the attack was able to draw off a number of German forces from the attack on Moscow.<cr>On December 5 as part of the Moscow Strategic Offensive the Kalinin Front began the Kalinin Offensive. Encountering stubborn resistance and repeated counterattacks, the 29th and 31st Army had broken the flanks of the forces defending Kalinin by December 15, and on December 16 the 31st Army liberated the city.<cr>On January 7, 1942, troops of the 39th, 29th, 31st and 30th armies were stopped on prepared defensive lines north of Rhzev near Lotoshino.<cr>From January 8 to April 20, the army participated in the Rzhev-Vyazma Strategic Offensive. On April 20, the army moved into defensive positions east of Zubtsov.<cr>On July 23 the army was assigned to the Western Front and took part in the Rzhev-Sychevka offensive from July 30 to August 23, liberating the city of Zubstov on the 23rd.<cr>From November 25 to December 20, 1942, the army participated in Operation Mars.<cr>On March 20, 1943, the army crossed the Dnieper River, despite the complications of the spring thaw breaking up the river's ice. The army attempted to go on the offensive but was unable to break through the German defenses, and by the end of the month the commander decided to discontinue the general offensive and go over on to the defensive.<cr>On August 7, the army went on the offensive as part of Operation Suvorov, part of the Smolensk Strategic Offensive. The army made only limited penetrations of the German lines. After beating off heavy German counterattacks, the attack was suspended on August 11. After a regrouping of the forces, the attack resumed on August 16. However, the forces were unable to advance even a mile and the attack was again suspended on August 20.<cr>The attack resumed on August 30 with little progress made. That evening the Germans began to withdraw their forces. The Soviet pursuit began on August 31 with the crossing of the Vopets River. After a week of retreating, the Germans managed to establish a defensive line near Yartsevo and on September 7 took up defensive positions.<cr>On September 15 they resumed the attack, crossing the Vop River. In conjunction with the 5th and 68th Armies, they liberated Smolensk on September 25.<cr>In February - March 1944 the army participated in operations to liberate Brest.<cr>Assigned to the 3rd Belorussian Front the army Operation Bagration participated in the elimination of German forces in the Minsk Offensive encirclement. In addition to the 31st Army, the 2nd Belorussian Front's 33rd, 49th and 50th Armies were given the task of containing the Germans within the encirclement and destroying German forces in the surrounding area.<cr>By the end of the summer of 1944, the forces of 3rd Belorussian Front and 31st Army had reached the approaches to the border of East Prussia.<cr>In 1945 the army took part in the East Prussian Strategic Offensive under the command of the 3rd Belorussian Front. The army was transferred to the 1st Ukrainian Front in order to participate in the Prague Offensive.<cr><cr>
translation:
第31集团军于1941年10月2日在台风行动中与德军交战。10月6日，该集团军在波列诺夫少将的指挥下组建了一个特遣队，并与由博尔丁中将指挥的第19集团军的一个特遣队一起，被赋予了阻止敌人在沃尔科拉姆斯克和日兹赫附近推进的任务。10月7日，第一场雪降临，道路变成了泥泞，迫使第3装甲集群的推进停止。这场雪让军队能够在朱拉利约沃-大雅可夫采沃-伊瓦什科娃一线设置防御阵地，并为撤退中的苏联部队开辟了一条走廊。这标志着加里宁防御阶段的开始。

从10月19日至22日，该集团军与突破梅德诺耶地区的德军交战，并得到了第113步兵师和第252步兵师的增援。10月22日，该集团军接到命令，与第29集团军和第30集团军协同进攻，解放加里宁城。虽然未能夺回城市，但这次攻击成功地吸引了部分德军从对莫斯科的攻势中抽离。

作为莫斯科战略反攻的一部分，加里宁方面军于12月5日开始加里宁攻势。面对顽强抵抗和反复反击，第29集团军和第31集团军到12月15日已经突破了守卫加里宁部队的侧翼，并在12月16日解放了该城。

1942年1月7日，第39、第29、第31和第30集团军的部队在日兹赫附近洛托什诺以北的预设防御线上被阻止。从1月8日至4月20日，该集团军参与了日兹赫-维亚兹马战略反攻行动。4月20日，该集团军转移到祖布采夫东侧的防御阵地。<cr>7月23日，集团军被分配给西方方面军，并参加了从7月30日至8月23日的勒热夫-瑟乔夫卡进攻行动，在23号解放了祖布斯托夫市。<cr>1942年11月25日至12月20日期间，集团军参与了火星行动。<cr>1943年3月20日，尽管春季解冻导致第聂伯河冰层破裂的复杂情况，集团军还是渡过了第聂伯河。集团军试图发起进攻但未能突破德国防御阵地，月底时指挥官决定停止总体攻势并转入守势。<cr>8月7日，作为苏沃洛夫行动的一部分，集团军发起了进攻，这是斯摩棱斯克战略进攻的一部分。集团军仅有限度地穿透了德国防线。在击退了德国的重反击后，攻击于8月11日暂停。重新部署兵力后，攻击于8月16日恢复。然而，部队甚至无法推进一英里，攻击再次于8月20日暂停。<cr>8月30日进攻再次开始，但进展甚微。当晚德国人开始撤退他们的部队。苏联追击行动从8月31日开始，渡过了沃佩茨河。在一周的撤退后，德国人在雅尔采沃附近建立了防御线，并于9月7日占据了防御阵地。<cr>9月15日他们再次发起进攻，渡过了沃普河。与第5集团军和第68集团军协同作战，他们在9月25日解放了斯摩棱斯克。<cr>1944年2月至3月期间，集团军参与了解放别列津纳的行动。<cr>隶属于第3方面军，该集团军参加了巴格拉季昂行动，在明斯克进攻中参与消灭德军的包围圈。除了第31集团军外，第2方面军的第33、49和50集团军被赋予了在包围圈内牵制德军并在周边地区摧毁德军的任务。<cr>PH0到1944年夏末，第3方面军和第31集团军已经推进到了东普鲁士边境附近。<cr>PH11945年，该集团军参加了由第3方面军指挥的东普鲁士战略进攻。该集团军被调至第1乌克兰方面军参加布拉格攻势。<cr>PH2PH3

text: In 1941 the 31st Infantry Division took part in the Russian invasion with the 2nd Panzer Army in the central sector, fighting in the battles for Bialystok, Minsk, Smolensk, Vyazma, and Bryansk, as well as in Guderian's unsuccessful attempt to encircle Tula (southeast of Moscow) in late 1941. It suffered serious losses in the Russian winter offensive of 1941-42. Remaining on the defensive with Army Group Center in 1942, it fought in the Battle of Kurskin July 1943, as part of 9th Army. Later that year, the 31st took part in the battles of the middle Dnieper and in the subsequent retreats through Russia. It was down to battle group strength by October and had been reorganized as a six grenadier battalion unit (with three grenadier regiments). In June 1944, it faced the gigantic Russian summer offensive as part of 4th Army and was finally overwhelmed and virtually destroyed in the fighting. Lieutenant General Wilhelm Ochsner, the divisional commander, was taken prisoner along with most of his men.<cr> The 31st was resurrected in Germany that fall, using returning wounded and new recruits. It was initially designated the 31st Grenadier Division, but was merged with the 550th Grenadier Division to form the 31st Volksgrenadier Division. It returned to combat in September 1944, as part of Army Group North. It was officially commended for its conduct in the early battles of the Courland Pocket. In early 1945, it was evacuated by sea to northern Germany and fought with Army Group Vistula in the final campaigns. It was isolated on the Hela peninsula and was forced to surrender to the Russians in May 1945.<cr><cr>German Order of Battle Vol I 1st - 290th Infantry Divisions in WWII, Samuel W. Mitcham Jr.
translation:
1941年，第31步兵师参加了德国中央战区的巴巴罗萨行动，隶属于第2装甲集团军。该师参与了比亚韦斯托克、明斯克、斯摩棱斯克、维亚兹马和布良斯克等地的战斗，并且在1941年末古德里安试图包围图拉（莫斯科东南方向）未遂后继续作战。在1941-42年的苏联冬季攻势中，该师遭受了严重损失。

1942年，第31步兵师随中央集团军群转入防御态势，并于1943年7月作为第9集团军的一部分参加了库尔斯克会战。同年晚些时候，该师参与了中部第聂伯河的战斗以及随后在俄罗斯境内的撤退行动。到10月份，该师已缩减为战斗群规模，并重组为拥有三个掷弹兵团（六个掷弹兵营）的新编制。

1944年6月，作为第4集团军的一部分，该师面对苏联的大规模夏季攻势，在战斗中最终被击溃并几乎全军覆没。师长威廉·奥克纳少将及其大部分官兵被俘虏。<cr>第31步兵师在当年晚些时候于德国复活，使用归来的伤员和新招募的士兵重建。最初该师被称为第31掷弹兵师，但后来与第550掷弹兵师合并重组为第31国民掷弹兵师。<cr><cr>该师于1944年9月作为北方集团军群的一部分重返战场，并因在库尔兰包围圈早期战斗中的表现而获得官方嘉奖。1945年初，该师被海上撤退至德国北部，并参加了维斯瓦河集团军的最后战役。<cr><cr>该师最终被孤立于赫拉半岛上，并被迫向苏联军队投降。<cr>

参考文献：<cr>Samuel W. Mitcham Jr., 《二战中的德军战斗序列：第1-290步兵师》第一卷

text: The corps was transferred from the Far East Military District shortly before the outbreak of hostilities and was assigned to Kiev Military District as general reserve. It consisted of 17th, 24th and 31st Rifle Divisions. It fought in Ukraine in 1941 and was disbanded in September. It was reformed as part of Karelian Front in August 1943 and participated in the Petsamo-Kirkenes Operation in October 1944. At that time, it consisted of 83rd and 367th Rifle Divisions. <cr><cr>Poirier, Robert and Conner, Albert, The Red Army Order of Battle in the Great Patriotic War, Presidio Press, 1985<cr><cr>Entry contributed by Stewart King
translation: 该军从远东军区调至基辅军区，作为预备队参与作战。它由第17、第24和第31步兵师组成。该部于1941年在乌克兰参战，并于9月解散。1943年8月，该部重组为卡累利阿方面军的一部分，并参加了1944年10月的佩察莫-基尔肯内斯行动。当时，它由第83和第367步兵师组成。<cr>指挥官报告: Poirier, Robert 和 Conner, Albert，《伟大卫国战争中的红军战斗序列》，Presidio Press, 1985<cr>条目贡献者: Stewart King

text: The 31st Rifle Division was formed in 1925 near Stalingrad. The division was garrisoned in the city until 1940, when it was transferred to Yerevan to strengthen the Iranian and Turkish borders. At this time the division consisted of the 75th, 177th and 248th Rifle Regiments, 32nd Light Artillery Regiment and 104th Sapper Battalion.<cr>The division was sent north to Taganrog on the Black Sea coast in October 1941 and fought in the Rostov. During the Germans Fall Blau offensive in mid-1942 the division retreated south into the Caucasus. The division suffered heavy losses in the defense of Tuapse and in August 1942 was reinforced by the 818th Rifle Regiment which was formed from the remnants of the 9th NKVD Motorized Division. The 177th Rifle Regiment was disbanded. The division advanced north as the German retreat from the region began. In the spring of 1943 it was relocated north, fighting in the Battle of the Dnieper later that year. It fought in the Jassy-Kischinev Offensive in the summer of 1944 and advanced into Romania before being transferred to Poland and fighting in the Vistula-Oder Offensive in early 1945. It fought in theBattle of Berlin and was disbanded postwar in western Ukraine in mid-1946.<cr><cr><cr><cr>Entry courtesy Chris Munson
translation: 第31步兵师成立于1925年，靠近斯大林格勒。该师驻扎在该市直到1940年，之后被调往埃里温以加强与伊朗和土耳其的边界防御。此时，该师由第75、第177和第248步兵团、第32轻炮团以及第104工兵营组成。<cr>第31步兵师于1941年10月被派往黑海沿岸的塔甘罗格，并在罗斯托夫作战。在德国1942年中期进行的“蓝色行动”攻势中，该师撤退到高加索地区。<cr>第31步兵师在图阿普谢的防御战中遭受了重大损失，在1942年8月得到了由第九内务人民委员部机械化师残部组成的第818步兵团的增援。第177步兵团被解散。随着德军从该地区撤退，该师向北推进，并于1943年初春转移到北方作战，在当年参加了第聂伯河战役。<cr>在1944年夏季进行的雅西-奇尔斯基攻势中，该师继续战斗并进入罗马尼亚，之后被调往波兰参加奥得河—维斯瓦河进攻战。最后，该师参与了柏林之战，并于1946年中期在乌克兰西部被解散。<cr>感谢克里斯·芒森提供条目

text: The 31st Tank Corps was forming at Oboyan at the beginning of July 1943 when it was thrown into action with the rest of 1st Tank Army against 4th Panzer Army's 48th Panzer Corps in the first days of the Battle of Kursk. Both 237th and 242nd Tank Brigades had 1/3 or more of their tank forces made up of Lend Lease M3 Grant tanks - nicknamed by their Russian crews 'a coffin for seven brothers', while the rest of the corps had T-34/76S. Without the usual supporting motorized riflemen, antitank. Guards Mortars, or antiaircraft units, the corps fought the battle of Kursk largely as separate tank brigades reinforcing other units, such as 1st Tank Army's 6th Tank Corps or 3rd Mechanized Corps. After the German drive on Kursk was stopped, 1st Tank Army had a short refitting rest and then went right into the 4th Battle for Kharkov and the advance to the Dnepr River and beyond.<cr>The 31st Tank Corps fought throughout this period while still trying to get organized, and did not receive all its required supporting units until nearly the end of 1943.<cr>The 31st Tank Corps finally finished forming in November 1943, after it had been sent back into STAVKA Reserves and given a chance to rest and refit after five months' of fighting semi-organized.<cr>Like many of the tank corps, 31st Tank Corps had a number of SU Regiments under command, depending on the mission. 1244th SU Regiment, for instance, was only with the corps for a few months, and then temporarily replaced by 400th Guards SU Regiment (SU-85s) in February 1944. By late March 1944 31st Tank Corps was in 1st Ukrainian Front reserves preparing for the spring offensives with only 1548th Heavy SU Regiment left of all the SU units it had controlled that winter. When 1st Ukrainian Front started the Lvov-Sandomir Operation in July 1944, 31st Tank Corps was paired with 6th Guards Cavalry Corps in the 2nd Cavalry-Mechanized Group.<cr>In September 1944, 269th Light Artillery Regiment (24 76mm guns) was added to the corps. At the end of 1944, as 1st Ukrainian Front was building up for the Vistula Oder Offensive in January 1945, 753rd Antitank Battalion was replaced in the corps with the 722nd SU Regiment (SU-76s) .<cr>This was the last organizational change made to 31st Tank Corps during the war. It remained as a separate tank corps in 1st Ukrainian Front, ending the war operating as a Mobile Group for 60th Army.<cr><cr>Soviet Order of Battle World War II Volume II by Charles C. Sharp
translation: 第31坦克军于1943年7月初在奥博扬组建，随后被投入库尔斯克战役初期阶段，与第1坦克集团军一起对抗德军第4装甲集团军的第48装甲军。第237和第242坦克旅中各有三分之一或更多的坦克是租借法案提供的M3“格兰特”坦克——它们被俄籍车组人员戏称为“七兄弟棺材”，而其余部队则装备T-34/76S。没有通常伴随的摩托化步兵、反坦克近卫迫击炮和防空单位，该军在库尔斯克战役中主要以独立坦克旅的形式增援其他部队，如第1坦克集团军的第6装甲军或第3机械化军。德军对库尔斯克的攻势被阻止后，第1坦克集团军短暂休整并补充后立即投入了第四次哈尔科夫之战以及向第聂伯河及其以西地区的推进。<cr>在此期间，第31坦克军一直在努力组织起来，并且直到1943年底才获得所有必需的支援单位。<cr>该军最终于1943年11月完成组建，在此之前它被送回最高统帅部大本营预备队休整和补充，此前已经进行了五个月半有组织状态下的战斗。<cr>像许多坦克军一样，第31坦克军在执行任务时指挥了多个SU团。例如，第1244独立自行火炮团仅与该军共事了几个月，在1944年2月被第400近卫独立自行反坦克炮兵团（装备SU-85）暂时取代。到1944年3月底，第31坦克军成为第1乌克兰方面军的预备队，准备春季攻势时只剩下该军在那个冬天曾指挥的所有SU部队中的一个：第1548重型独立自行火炮团。<cr>1944年7月，当第1乌克兰方面军开始利沃夫-桑多梅日行动时，第31坦克军与第6近卫骑兵军配合作战，在第2骑兵团中。<cr>1944年9月，第269轻型炮兵团（装备24门76毫米火炮）加入该军。<cr>到1944年底，随着第1乌克兰方面军为1945年1月的维斯瓦河-奥得河攻势做准备，第753反坦克营被第722独立自行火炮团（装备SU-76）取代。<cr>这是该军在战争期间做的最后一个组织变更。<cr>它作为第1乌克兰方面军的一个单独的坦克军存在，在战争结束时为第60集团军作战，作为一个机动部队行动。<cr><cr>查尔斯·C·夏普著《苏联二战战斗序列 第二卷》

The 31st Tank Division was formed February 1941 near Botskyi in Western Special Military District as part of 13th Mechanized Corps with:<cr><cr>61st Tank Regiment - 0 tanks
62nd Tank Regiment - 0 tanks
31st Motorized Rifle Regiment
1st, 2nd, 3rd bns
31st Howitzer Regiment
1 light, 1 medium bn
31st Reconnaissance Bn
1 co with 9 tankettes, 2 foot companies
31st Pontoon Battalion
31st Antiaircraft Battalion<cr><cr>The 31st Tank Division was virtually unformed when the Germans attacked on 22 June 1941. The division had only 15 BT tanks and some light amphibious tankettes on hand for training, no antiaircraft guns, and no tractors or trucks for the infantry or the howitzer regiment - which did, at least, have all its guns. Caught by German air attacks, the division was scattered and overrun almost immediately and the rest destroyed in the Bialystok pocket. The division was officially dissolved on 4 July 1941.<cr><cr>Soviet Order of Battle Volume I by Charles C. Sharp

第31坦克师成立于1941年2月，在西特别军区的博茨基附近，隶属于第13机械化军：<cr><cr>第61坦克团 - 无坦克
第62坦克团 - 无坦克
第31摩托化步兵团
第1、2、3营
第31榴弹炮团
第1轻型营、第1中型营

第31防空营<cr><cr>当德国人于1941年6月22日发动攻击时，第31坦克师几乎尚未组建完毕。该师仅有15辆BT坦克和一些轻型两栖坦克车用于训练，并无高射炮、也无拖拉机或卡车供步兵及榴弹炮团使用——至少所有火炮都已到位。由于遭到德军空袭，该师被击溃并几乎立即被包围，在比亚韦斯托克包围圈中剩下的部队也被消灭了。该师于1941年7月4日被正式解散。<cr><cr>苏联战斗序列 第一卷 作者：查尔斯·C·夏普

text: The 320th Rifle Division was formed in September 1941, as a standard Red Army rifle division, based on an existing division of militia. This formation was devastated in the Kerch Penisula in May 1942, and officially disbanded before the end of the month. A second division began forming in the Transcaucasus in August, and served for the duration in the southern regions of the Soviet-German front. It distinguished itself in the liberation of Yenakiyevo in March 1943, but also suffered massive losses, including the death of the division's commanding officer, along the Dniestr River in May 1944. A substantially rebuilt division soldiered on through the Balkans, ending the war near Vienna.<cr><cr>
translation: 第320步兵师于1941年9月组建，作为标准的红军步兵师，基于一个现有的民兵师。该部队在1942年5月克里米亚半岛遭到重创，并在月底前正式解散。第二支师级部队从8月开始在高加索地区重建，并在整个战争期间服务于苏联-德国战场的南部区域。它在1943年3月解放叶尼凯耶夫市时表现出色，但在1944年5月沿德涅斯特河作战时遭受了重大损失，包括师长阵亡。经过大幅重建后，该部队继续战斗，在巴尔干地区作战，并最终接近维也纳结束战争。<cr><cr>

text: The 321st Rifle Division was formed in September 1941, as a standard Red Army rifle division, based on an existing division of militia. This formation had an extremely short career, coming under devastating attack in the north of the Crimea on the day of its redesignation and being officially disbanded just over a month later. A second division began forming in the Transbaikal in February 1942, and served in the defensive and offensive fighting around Stalingrad, eventually distinguishing itself sufficiently to be redesignated as the 82nd Guards Rifle Division. The world had not seen the last of the 321st, however, as a new division was formed from two existing rifle brigades in the spring of 1944, which gave very creditable service for the duration, completing its combat path in northeastern Germany.<cr><cr>
translation: 第321步兵师于1941年9月组建，作为标准的红军步兵师，基于一个现有的民兵师。该部队有着极其短暂的职业生涯，在克里米亚北部重新编组当天即遭到毁灭性攻击，并在一个月后被正式解散。第二支第321步兵师于1942年2月在外贝加尔地区开始组建，并参加了斯大林格勒防御和进攻战斗，最终表现出色而被改编为第82近卫步兵师。然而，世界并未见证完第321步兵师的全部历史，因为一支新的部队于1944年春季从两个现有的步兵旅中组建而成，在整个服役期间表现优异，并在东北部德国完成了其战斗历程。<cr><cr>

text: The 321st Static Division was formed as a garrison division in December 1940 as part of the 13th Wave from elements of the 267th and 295th Infantry Divisions (3 battalions from each division). It consisted of the 588th, 589th and 590th Infantry Regiments, the 321st Artillery Regiment and various support units. In October 1942 the division was converted to a field division and sent to Russia. At this time the grenadier battalions had their infantry gun companies replaced by 150mm Nebelwerfer batteries. The artillery regiment also had a battery of 150mm Nebelwerfers. In November 1943 the division was reduced to the 321st Division Group and most of the divisions elements were used to rebuild the 110th Infantry Division. The remaining elements were dispersed to other units. <cr><cr>George F. Nafziger, The German Order of Battle Infantry in World War II<cr><cr>Entry courtesy Chris Munson
translation: 第321静态师于1940年12月作为守备师组建，属于第13波部队，由第267步兵师和第295步兵师（每个师抽调3个团）的元素组成。该师包括第588、589和590步兵团，第321炮兵团以及各种支援单位。1942年10月，该师被改编为野战师并派往俄罗斯。此时掷弹兵营的步兵炮连被替换为150毫米喷烟者火箭炮连。炮兵团也配备了一个150毫米喷烟者火箭炮连。1943年11月，该师缩减为第321师群，并且大部分单位被用于重建第110步兵师。剩余的单位则分散到其他部队。<cr>参考文献：George F. Nafziger, 《二战中的德国战斗序列：步兵》<cr>条目由Chris Munson提供

text: The 322nd Rifle Division was a standard Red Army rifle division during World War II. It is most notable for liberating Auschwitz as part of the 60th Army on January 27, 1945, in the course of the Vistula-Oder Offensive. Prior to this the division also distinguished itself during the second liberation of Zhitomir on the last day of 1943. It received further distinctions for its service in western Ukraine and in Poland.<cr><cr>
translation: 第322步兵师是苏联红军在第二次世界大战期间的标准步兵师。该师最著名的是作为第60集团军的一部分，在1945年1月27日的维斯瓦-奥得河进攻中解放了奥斯威辛集中营。在此之前，该师还在1943年最后一天解放日托米尔时表现出色。此外，该师在西乌克兰和波兰的服务期间也获得了进一步的荣誉。<cr><cr><cr>

text: The 323rd Rifle Division was formed as a standard Red Army rifle division late in the summer of 1941, as part of the massive buildup of new Soviet fighting formations at that time. After a successful but costly start in the Soviet winter counteroffensive in the Tula region the division served on relatively quiet sectors into 1943, after which it joined the offensive push into German-occupied western Russia through the rest of that year, winning a battle honor for the liberation of Bryansk. In the course of the destruction of Army Groups Center in the summer of 1944, the division further distinguished itself in the liberation of Bialystok in July. In 1945 the men and women of the 323rd took part in the Vistula-Oder Offensive through Poland and into Pomerania, and then finally in the Battle of Berlin, ending the war with distinction, but being disbanded soon after.<cr><cr>
translation: 第323步兵师于1941年夏末作为标准的红军步兵师组建，是当时苏联大规模新建战斗编队的一部分。该师在图拉地区的苏军冬季反攻中取得成功但代价高昂后，在相对平静的战线上一直服役到1943年。之后，它参加了进攻德国占领的西部俄罗斯的行动，并于当年赢得了布良斯克解放的荣誉。在1944年夏季中央集团军群被摧毁的过程中，该师进一步在7月解放比亚韦斯托克时表现出色。1945年，第323步兵师参加了维斯瓦-奥得河攻势，并最终参与了柏林战役，以卓越的表现结束了战争，但不久后即解散。<cr><cr>

text: The 323rd Static Division was formed as a garrison division in November 1940 as part of the 13th Wave from elements of the 62nd and 73rd Infantry Divisions (6 battalions and 3 battalions respectively). It consisted of the 591st, 592nd and 593rd Infantry Regiments, the 323rd Artillery Regiment and various support units. The division was converted into a field division in February 1942. By March 1943 after heavy fighting the division had been reduced to a Kampfgruppe. The division was disbanded in November 1943.<cr><cr>George F. Nafziger, The German Order of Battle Infantry in World War II<cr><cr>Entry courtesy Chris Munson
translation: 第323步兵师于1940年11月作为守备师组建，属于第13波增援部队，由第62步兵师和第73步兵师（分别有6个团和3个团）的部分兵力组成。该师包括第591、592和593步兵团以及第323炮兵团，并配有各种支援单位。该师于1942年2月改编为野战师，在1943年3月经过激烈战斗后，被削减为一个作战群。该师于1943年11月解散。<cr>参考文献：George F. Nafziger, 《二战中的德国战斗序列：步兵》<cr>条目由Chris Munson提供

text: The 324th Rifle Division was a standard Soviet infantry division of the Red Army during World War II. It was formed as part of the massive mobilization of August 1941, and first saw action in early December in the counteroffensive west of Moscow. During 1942 and into 1943 it saw limited action on a relatively quiet sector of the front north of Bryansk, before joining a limited offensive in February. During the general offensives of that summer, the division fought in the drive past Smolensk, and made a forced crossing of the upper Dnieper River. The 324th played a limited role in Operation Bagration, but distinguished itself in the fighting in East Prussia in 1945, sufficiently to be awarded the Order of the Red Banner. During the course of the war the men and women of the division served under no fewer than nine commanding officers.<cr><cr>
translation: 第324步兵师是苏联红军在第二次世界大战期间的标准步兵师。该师成立于1941年8月大规模动员期间，并于1941年12月初首次参与莫斯科西部的反攻作战。1942年至1943年初，它在布良斯克以北相对平静的战线上进行了有限的战斗，在2月份加入了一次有限进攻。在那年的夏季攻势中，该师参加了穿过斯摩棱斯克的战役，并被迫渡过上第聂伯河。第324步兵师在巴格拉季昂行动中扮演了有限的角色，但在1945年东普鲁士的战斗中表现出色，获得了红旗勋章。在整个战争期间，该师官兵先后有九位指挥官。<cr><cr><cr><cr>

text: The 325th Rifle Division was formed in September 1941, as a standard Red Army rifle division, made up of older reservists and young men with no prewar training. As with many other divisions in the 320-330 series it was flung into the fighting west of Moscow in the 10th Army to defend the capital and then to take part in the winter counteroffensive. After a year on a quiet sector the division rejoined the fighting in the late winter of 1943, eventually distinguishing itself sufficiently to be redesignated as the 90th Guards Rifle Division. After disappearing from the Soviet order of battle for more than a year a new division was formed in the spring of 1944, based on a cadre of two distinguished rifle brigades, and gave very creditable service for the duration, completing its combat path in East Prussia.<cr><cr>
translation: 第325步兵师成立于1941年9月，作为标准的红军步兵师组建，由较老的预备役人员和没有战前训练的年轻人组成。与其他320至330系列中的许多师一样，它被投入到莫斯科西面第十集团军的战斗中，以保卫首都，并参与冬季反攻。在平静的防区度过一年后，该师于1943年晚冬重新投入战斗，最终表现出色，被改组为第90近卫步兵师。从苏联战斗序列消失一年多后，新的步兵师于1944年春季组建，基于两个杰出步兵旅的骨干力量，并在剩余战争期间提供了非常值得称赞的服务，在东普鲁士完成了其作战历程。<cr>指挥官报告<cr>第325步兵师: 从1941年到1944年的战斗历程。

text: The 326th Rifle Division was formed as a standard Red Army rifle division late in the summer of 1941, as part of the massive buildup of new Soviet fighting formations in response to the German invasion. Like several other divisions in the 320-330 series, it was not fully trained and equipped when thrown into the Soviet winter counteroffensive, and after taking heavy losses mostly served on relatively quiet sectors into 1943, apart from several weeks of costly and futile fighting during Operation Mars. As the offensive into German-occupied western Russia developed during the autumn of that year the soldiers of the division distinguished themselves in the liberation of Roslavl in September. During 1944 the unit continued its combat path through the Baltic states, and in the following year helped liberate Poland and drive into Germany, ending the war near the Baltic coast in western Pomerania.<cr><cr>
translation: 第326步兵师于1941年夏末作为标准的红军步兵师组建，是苏联为应对德国入侵而大规模集结新战斗部队的一部分。与320至330系列中的其他几个师一样，在被投入苏联冬季反攻之前并未完全训练和装备完毕。该师在火星行动期间进行了数周代价高昂且徒劳无功的战斗后，主要驻守相对平静的战区直至1943年。同年秋天，随着进攻德国占领的西部俄罗斯的发展，该师士兵在九月解放罗斯拉夫利时表现出色。1944年，该部队继续其作战路径穿越波罗的海国家，并于次年帮助解放波兰并向德国境内推进，在战争结束时接近波罗的海沿岸的西波美拉尼亚地区。<cr>司令部集结补给：<cr>1: 无<cr>2: 无

text: The 327th Rifle Division was first formed in September 1941, as a standard Red Army rifle division, based on a cadre of workers from Voronezh. This formation was assigned to the Volkhov Front near Leningrad, toiling through the so-called 'Rat's War' in the wooded swamps of that region and taking significant casualties in the encirclement of its 2nd Shock Army near Lyuban in early 1942. In January 1943, it helped to lead the partial raising of the German siege of Leningrad in Operation Iskra, distinguishing itself sufficiently to be redesignated as the 64th Guards Rifle Division. Well over a year later a second 327th Rifle Division was formed and was also moved to the Leningrad region where it took part in the offensive that drove Finland from the war, then spent the first months of 1945 clearing German forces from the coasts of the Baltic States and containing the German forces trapped in Courland.<cr><cr>
translation: 第327步兵师于1941年9月首次组建，作为标准的红军步兵师，在沃罗涅日工人骨干的基础上建立。该部队被分配到列宁格勒附近的沃尔霍夫方面军，在该地区的林地沼泽中经历了所谓的“鼠战”，并在1942年初在卢班附近包围第2突击集团军时遭受了重大伤亡。<cr>1943年1月，它帮助部分解除了德国对列宁格勒的围困，在“火花”行动中表现出色，足以被重新指定为第64近卫步兵师。一年多后，第二个第327步兵师于1944年初组建，并被转移到列宁格勒地区参加将芬兰逐出战争的攻势，然后在1945年第一季度清除波罗的海沿岸地区的德军，并包围了库尔兰半岛上的德军。<cr><cr>指挥官报告<cr><cr>

text: The 327th Static Division was formed as a garrison division for service in Vienna in November 1940 as part of the 13th Wave with cadres from the 183rd, 198th and 297th Infantry Divisions. It consisted of the 595th, 596th and 597th Infantry Regiments, the 327th Artillery Regiment and various support units. The division was sent to eastern France in the spring of 1941. It spent 1942 at LaRochelle in southwestern France and took part in the occupation of Vichy France in November 1942. The division was converted into a field division in July 1943 and sent to Russia. The division was disbanded in November 1943 and its elements transferred to the 340th and 357th Infantry Divisions and other Army formations.<cr><cr>George F. translation: 第327步兵师于1940年11月作为守备部队在维也纳组建，属于第13波次，由第183、198和297步兵师抽调人员组成。该师包括第595、596和597步兵团以及第327炮兵团，并配有各种支援单位。1941年春天，该师被派往法国东部。1942年，该师驻扎在西南部的拉罗谢尔，并参与了1942年11月占领维希法国的行动。1943年7月，该师改编为野战部队并被派往苏联战场。1943年11月，该师解散，其人员分别调至第340和357步兵师及其他集团军单位。<cr>参考文献：乔治·F·纳夫齐格，《二战中的德国战斗序列：步兵》<cr>塞缪尔·W·米查姆，《二战中的德国战斗序列第二卷：第291至第999步兵师、命名步兵师及其他特殊部队》<cr>克里斯·芒森提供

text: The 328th Infantry Division was formed in December 1941 as part of the 17th Wave. It contained the 547th, 548th and 549th Infantry Regiments, 328th Artillery Regiment and various support units. Shortly therafter the division was assigned to Army Group Centre and fought in the Soviet winter offensive of 1941-1942. Each of the divisions three regiments was assigned to different corps in the Army Group and the 547th Regiment was aborbed by the 83rd Infantry Division. The division was heavily damaged around Subzow in October 1942. In November 1942 elements of the division were transferred to southern France and by the spring of 1943 the remainder of the division joined it there. The division was rebuilt and the 569th Grenadier Regiment was added to replace the 547th Regiment. The division returned to Russia in late summer of 1943 and was largely destroyed in the retreat to the Dnieper. In November 1943 it was designated a divisional group and attached to the 306th Infantry Division. It was aborbed by that division in July 1944 with the divisional group becoming the 569th Grenadier Regiment.<cr><cr>George F. Nafziger, The German Order of Battle Infantry in World War II<cr>Samuel W. Mitcham, German Order of Battle Volume II: 291st-999th Infantry Divisions, Named Infantry Divisions, and Special Divisions in WWII<cr><cr>Entry courtesy Chris Munson
translation: 第328步兵师成立于1941年12月，属于第17波组建的部队。该师包括第547团、第548团和第549团，第328炮兵团以及各种支援单位。不久之后，该师被分配到中央集团军群，并参加了苏联在1941-1942年的冬季攻势。每个团分别隶属于集团军中的不同军。第547团被并入了第83步兵师。1942年10月，该师在苏兹达地区遭受重创。1942年11月，该师的部分单位被转移到法国南部，并于1943年春季与其余部队会合。该师重建后加入了第569掷弹兵团以取代第547团。1943年夏末，该师返回俄罗斯，在撤退至第聂伯河时几乎被消灭殆尽。1943年11月，它被指定为师级集团，并隶属于第306步兵师。1944年7月，该师级集团被并入了第306步兵师，成为第569掷弹兵团。<cr>参考文献：<cr>George F. Nafziger，《二战中的德国战斗序列：步兵》<cr>Samuel W. Mitcham，《二战中的德国战斗序列 第二卷：291至999师、命名步兵师及其他特殊部队》<cr>Chris Munson 提供

text: The 328th Rifle Division was formed as a standard Red Army rifle division at Yaroslavl late in the summer of 1941, as part of the massive buildup of new Soviet fighting formations in response to the German invasion. Like several other divisions in the 320-330 series, it was neither fully trained nor equipped when thrown into the Soviet winter winter counteroffensive as part of 10th Army, but did its part in throwing back the forces of Army Groups Center from the southern approaches to Moscow in December and January. Over the course of five months of nearly continual offensive combat the soldiers of the division distinguished themselves sufficiently to be re-designated as the 31st Guards Rifle Division. A few months later a new 328th was formed, this time in the Transcaucasian Military Distric as the German summer offensive of 1942 was producing a crisis in that region. This new division had a slow start, but eventually proved itself in fighting through Ukraine, Belarus and Poland, gaining a battle honor for the liberation of Warsaw, and helping to complete the encirclement of Berlin in April 1945. Despite this record, it was disbanded shortly after the German surrender.<cr><cr>
translation: 第328步兵师于1941年夏末在雅罗斯拉韦尔作为标准的红军步兵师组建，是苏联为应对德国入侵而大规模集结新战斗编队的一部分。与该系列中的其他几个师一样，在被投入第十集团军参与苏德冬季反攻时，第328步兵师既未完全训练也未充分装备。然而在1941年12月和1942年1月期间，该师还是成功地帮助击退了中央集团军群从莫斯科南部方向的进攻。<cr><cr>经过五个月几乎不间断的攻势作战，第328步兵师表现出色，被重新指定为第31近卫步兵师。几个月后，在德国于1942年夏季发动攻势导致高加索地区出现危机时，一个新的第328步兵师在高加索军区组建起来。<cr><cr>新组建的第328步兵师起步缓慢，但最终在乌克兰、白俄罗斯和波兰作战中证明了自己的实力，并因解放华沙而获得荣誉。1945年4月，该师还帮助完成了对柏林的包围圈。尽管有这些战绩，该师还是在德国投降后不久被解散了。<cr><cr><cr><cr>

text: The 329th Infantry Division was formed in December 1941 as part of the 17th Wave. It contained the 551st, 552nd and 553rd Infantry Regiments, 329th Artillery Regiment and various support units although the 552nd and 553rd Regiments had only two battalions instead of three as was typical of a German infantry regiment at this point in the war. The artillery regiment also had only two battalions rather than the standard four battalions. By 1943 the division had the standard TOE of three grenadier regiments of two battalions each and a typical four battalion artillery regiment. The pioneer battalion though had only two companies rather than the typical three and none of the grenadier regiments had infantry gun or Panzerjger companies. In September 1944 the 553rd Infantry Regiment was disbanded and replaced by the 21st Luftwaffe Regimental Group which became the 42nd Jger Regiment. On May 8th 1945 the division passed into Russian captivity in Courland.<cr><cr>George F. Nafziger, The German Order of Battle Infantry in World War II<cr><cr>Entry courtesy Chris Munson
translation: 第329步兵师成立于1941年12月，属于第17波组建的部队。该师包括第551、552和553步兵团，第329炮兵团以及各种支援单位。不过，第552和553团只有两个营而不是通常的三个营；同样，炮兵团也只有两个营而非标准编制下的四个营。到1943年，该师已调整为拥有三个掷弹兵团（每个团有两个营）的标准编制表，并且炮兵团也恢复了典型的四个营配置。然而，战斗工兵营只有两个连而不是通常的三个连；此外，没有一个掷弹兵团配备有步兵炮或装甲猎兵连。1944年9月，第553步兵团被解散并由第21德国空军团组取代，后者后来成为第42猎兵团。1945年5月8日，该师在库尔兰地区落入苏联战俘营。<cr>参考文献：George F. Nafziger, 《二战中的德军战斗序列：步兵》<cr>条目由Chris Munson提供

text: The 329th Rifle Division was first formed in September 1941, as a standard Red Army rifle division, at Voronezh. text: The 32nd Army was formed on 16 July 1941 in the Moscow Military District near the cities of Naro-Fominsk, Kubinka, and the settlement of Dorokhovo. The army was formed with four divisions of Moscow Militia. The assigned units included the 2nd, 7th, 8th, 13th Moscow Militia divisions. In addition, on 20 July 1941, 18th Moscow People's Militia Divisions was assigned to the Army at positions west of Moscow. The 18th had a strength of 10,000.<cr>On 18 July the army was incorporated into the Moscow line of defense and took up defensive positions in the vicinity of Karacharovo. On 30 July the army was assigned to the Reserve Front. On 1 October, the army included the 2nd Rifle Division, 8th Rifle Division, 29th Rifle Division and the 140th Rifle Division. It also included the 685th Corps Artillery Regiment, 533rd Antitank Artillery Regiment, 877th Antitank Artillery Regiment, 200th Naval Artillery Battalion and the 36th Antiaircraft Artillery Battalion.<cr>On 3 October the army was heavily engaged in a defensive battle against German forces advancing on Vyazma as part of the northern wing of Operation Typhoon. On 5 October the army was reassigned to the Western Front and two days later along with the 16th, 19th, 20th and 24th Armies were encircled by the German 4th and 9th Armies and 3rd and 4th Panzer Groups. The 32nd Army was disbanded on 12 October 1941. Small elements of the army were able to break out of the encirclement and were assigned to the 16th and 19th Armies.<cr>STAVKA ordered the army reformed on 2 March 1942. The reformation was completed on 10 March 1942. The army was formed from the Medvezhegorshaya and Maselskaya Operational Groups of the Karelian Front.<cr>Until the end of May 1944 the 32nd Army defended the frontier in the Medvezhyegorsky District and from 21 July to 9 August the army participated in the Svir-Petrozavodsk Offensive, when part of the army reached the Finish border in the vicinity of Longonvara. When Finland was knocked out of the war on 19 September 1944 the army was relegated to guarding the Finnish border.On 15 November 1944 the 32nd Army was put into the Reserve of the Supreme High Command (Stavka Reserve) and on 21 April 1945 was directly subordinated to the Stavka.<cr><cr>
translation: 第32集团军于1941年7月16日在莫斯科军区成立，靠近纳罗-福明斯克、库宾卡和多罗霍沃镇。该集团军由四个莫斯科民兵师组建而成，包括第二、第七、第八和第十三莫斯科民兵师。此外，在1941年7月20日，第十八莫斯科人民民兵师被分配到位于莫斯科以西的阵地，该师拥有约1万名士兵。<cr><cr>7月18日，集团军并入莫斯科防御线，并在卡恰罗沃附近占据防御位置。7月30日，集团军被分配给预备方面军。10月1日，集团军包括第二步兵师、第八步兵师、第二十九步兵师和第一百四十步兵师。此外还包括第六百八十五军炮兵团、第五百三十三反坦克炮兵团、第八百七十七反坦克炮兵团、第二百海军炮兵营以及第三十六防空炮兵营。<cr><cr>10月3日，集团军在防御战斗中与德国部队交战，后者正在推进至维亚兹马作为台风行动的北部翼。10月5日，集团军被重新分配给西方面军，并于两天后与第十六、十九、二十和二十四集团军一起被德军第四和第九集团军以及第三和第四装甲集群包围。第32集团军于1941年10月12日解散。该集团军的小部分部队成功突围并被分配给第十六和第十九集团军。<cr><cr>最高统帅部大本营命令在1942年3月2日重建第32集团军，重组工作于1942年3月10日完成。该集团军由卡累利阿方面军的梅德韦日戈尔斯卡亚和马谢尔斯基作战群组建而成。直到1944年5月底，第32集团军一直在梅德韦日戈尔斯克区守卫国界。从7月21日至8月9日，该集团军参加了斯维里-彼得罗扎沃茨克进攻战役，在隆贡瓦拉附近的部分部队到达了芬兰边境。当芬兰在1944年9月19日退出战争时，第32集团军被调去守卫芬俄边界。1944年11月15日，第32集团军被列入最高统帅部大本营预备队（Stavka 预备队）。1945年4月21日，该集团军直接隶属于最高统帅部。<cr>指挥官报告：<cr><cr>

text:
The 32nd Cavalry Division was formed in 1938 in the Kiev Special Military District from the 1st Zaporozhe Cossack Cavalry Division.<cr><cr>The division participated in the Invasion of Poland. It was assigned to the Ukrainian Front's Cavalry Group.<cr><cr>Assigned to the 9th Rifle Corps in the Crimea the division had been undergoing amphibious training before the war started. On 10 July 1941 the division left for Gomel, leaving its assigned tank regiment behind, and was assigned to the 21st Army. The division commander took command of the one of the first 'Cavalry Groups' of the war. In July and August 1941 the group and the division raided into the rear areas and flanks of the German 2nd Army and 2nd Panzer Group south of Smolensk. During this raid the division conducted a successful saber-swinging cavalry charge when they caught a German rear-echelon unit by surprise and overran it in a mounted attack.

In October-November 1941 the group and division operated along the flanks of the German attack towards Tula. In December 1941 the division was assigned to the 5th Cavalry Corps in December 1941 before the Corps was redesignated as the 3rd Guards Cavalry Corps on 26 December 1941.

The division remained assigned to the 3rd Guards Cavalry Corps for the remainder of the war. On 10 November 1942 the division absorbed the remnants of the 47th Cavalry Division as replacements. In early 1943 the division was upgraded to the new cavalry standards. The division received the 207th Tank Regiment in June 1943.

The division was disbanded in the summer of 1945.<cr><cr>
translation:
第32骑兵师成立于1938年，在基辅特别军区从第一扎波罗热哥萨克骑兵师改编而成。<cr>指挥官报告：该师参加了入侵波兰的行动，被分配到乌克兰方面军的骑兵群。<cr>在克里米亚地区的第9步兵军中，该师战前一直在接受两栖作战训练。1941年7月10日，该师前往戈梅利，并将其坦克团留在原地，随后被分配给第21集团军。师长接管了其中一个最早的“骑兵群”。在1941年7月至8月期间，该群和该师对德国南方战线的第2集团军和第2装甲集群后方进行了突袭行动。<cr>在此过程中，该师成功地发动了一次骑兵冲锋，当他们突然袭击并击溃了一个德军后勤单位时。

在1941年10月至11月期间，该群和该师沿德国进攻图拉方向的侧翼活动。1941年12月，该师被分配给第5骑兵军，在同年12月26日该军改名为第3近卫骑兵军之前。

在战争剩余时间里，该师一直隶属于第3近卫骑兵军。1942年11月10日，该师吸收了第47骑兵师的残部作为补充部队。<cr>1943年初，该师升级到新的骑兵标准。1943年6月，该师接收了第207坦克团。

该师在1945年夏季被解散。<cr>

text: The 32nd Guards Rifle Divison fought at Krasnodar, on the Kuban, and in Crimea prior to fighting in Courland. On 1 June 1942 it was part of 47th Army, North Caucasus Front. The division was with the 2nd Guards Army of the 3rd Belorussian Front in May 1945.<cr><cr>
translation: 第32近卫步兵师曾在克拉斯诺达尔、库班地区和克里米亚作战，之后又在库尔兰进行了战斗。1942年6月1日，该师隶属于高加索方面军的第47集团军。<cr>1945年5月，该师属于第三白俄罗斯方面军的第2近卫集团军。<cr><cr>指挥官报告<cr>

text: During the invasion of Russia in 1941, the 32nd Infantry Division fought in the battles of Dvinsk, Kholm, Lake Ilmen, and the Valdai Hills, and was tied down in the battles around Demyansk from January 1942 to February 1943. It was encircled much of this time and had to be resupplied by air. Three of its infantry battalions were disbanded in 1942, due to heavy casualties. The 32nd remained on the northern sector during the defensive battles of 1943 and was briefly transferred to Army Group Center in January 1944, where it fought at Nevel. Hurried back to the northern sector after the Russians broke the siege of Leningrad on January 18, the Lion Division was cited for its excellent conduct in the retreat through the Baltic States. Finally withdrawn into the Courland Pocket, it took part in the desperate battles in western Latvia in the winter of 1944-45, before being evacuated to Germany by sea in early 1945. The division was finally cut off in the Hela peninsula by the final Soviet offensives and surrendered to the Red Army on May 8, 1945.<cr><cr>German Order of Battle Vol I 1st - 290th Infantry Divisions in WWII, Samuel W. Mitcham Jr.
translation: 在1941年入侵俄罗斯期间，第32步兵师参加了德夫尼亚克、霍尔姆、伊利门湖和瓦尔代山的战斗，并从1942年1月至1943年2月被牵制在德米扬斯克周围的战斗中。在此期间大部分时间里该师陷入包围圈，不得不依靠空投补给。由于伤亡惨重，其三个步兵营于1942年解散。第32师在1943年的防御战中一直驻守北部地区，并于1944年1月短暂调往中央集团军群，在内夫尔作战。在苏联军队于1942年1月18日解除列宁格勒包围后，该狮师急忙返回北方地区，并因在波罗的海国家撤退中的出色表现而受到表彰。最终被撤至库尔兰包围圈中，参加了1944-45年冬季西部拉脱维亚地区的绝望战斗，在1945年初通过海上撤离到德国。该师最后在苏联最后一次攻势中被切断于赫拉半岛，并于1945年5月8日向红军投降。<cr>参考资料：Samuel W. Mitcham Jr.,《二战中的第1至290步兵师：德国战斗序列卷一》

text: The corps was in Smolensk as part of 16th Army at the outbreak of hostilities. It consisted of 46th and 152nd Rifle Divisions in July 1941. It was disbanded after the Battle of Smolensk and reformed in August 1943 in Southwestern Front. In January 1944, it consisted of 259th, 266th and 279th Rifle Divisions. At that time, it was assigned to 3rd Guards. In April, 1945, it was part of 5th Shock Army during the Berlin Strategic Offensive. <cr><cr>Poirier, Robert and Conner, Albert, The Red Army Order of Battle in the Great Patriotic War, Presidio Press, 1985<cr><cr>Entry contributed by Stewart King
translation: 该军在1941年7月作为第16集团军的一部分驻扎在斯摩棱斯克，辖有第46步兵师和第152步兵师。它在斯摩棱斯克战役后被解散，并于1943年8月在西南方面军中重建。1944年1月，该军辖有第259、第266和第279步兵师。此时，它隶属于第3近卫集团军。1945年4月，在柏林战略进攻中作为第5突击集团军的一部分行动。<cr>参考文献：Poirier, Robert and Conner, Albert, 红军在伟大卫国战争中的战斗序列, Presidio Press, 1985<cr>条目由Stewart King提供

text: The 32nd Rifle Division was formed in 1920 in the Saratov area. In 1934 it joined the Special Red Banner Far Eastern Army, serving the Far Eastern Military District as part of the 39th Rifle Corps. It took part in a number of border skirmishes on the Manchurian border near Lake Khasan. By 1941 it consisted of the 17th, 113th and 322nd Rifle Regiments and the 133rd and 154th Artillery Regiments. When Operation Typhoon, the German attack on Moscow began in late 1941 the division was ordered west and was rapidly transported by train to the Mozhaisk Defense Line. By October 1941 the forward elements had arrived and dug in on the old Borodino battlefield. The best the division could hope for was to delay the German advance long enough to form a new line of defense further east. The Germans attacked with two veteran divisions, the 10th Panzer Division and the 2nd SS Division Das Reich on the 32nd Divisions line of defense. The battle continued for five days until the exhausted Russians fell back further to the east and Mozhaisk fell on the 18th of October. The division stayed on the front lines through November and took part in theBattle of Moscow. For its service in these battles the divsion was given the title 29th Guards Rifle Division.<cr>A new 32nd Rifle Division was formed and was back at the front by October 1942. The division was in action until the end of the war and was disbanded in 1946.<cr><cr><cr><cr>Entry courtesy Chris Munson
translation: 第32步兵师成立于1920年，在萨拉托夫地区组建。1934年，该师加入特别红旗远东军区，作为第39步兵军的一部分服务于远东军区。它参与了在哈桑湖附近的满洲国边境上发生的多次边界冲突。到1941年，该师由第17、113和322步兵团以及第133和154炮兵团组成。当台风行动——德国对莫斯科的攻击于1941年末开始时，该师被命令向西调动，并迅速通过铁路运送到莫扎伊斯克防御线。到10月1941年，先头部队已经到达并挖掘了博罗季诺战场上的旧阵地。该师最好的希望是延缓德军的推进，以便在更靠东的地方形成新的防线。德国人用两个经验丰富的装甲师——第10装甲师和第2党卫军“帝国”师发动攻击。战斗持续了五天，直到精疲力竭的俄国人向东方撤退，莫扎伊斯克于10月18日陷落。该师在前线一直坚守到1941年11月，并参加了莫斯科战役。由于在这场战斗中的表现，该师被授予第29近卫步兵师称号。<cr>新的第32步兵师于1942年10月重新组建并返回前线。该师一直作战直到战争结束，并在1946年解散。<cr><cr><cr><cr>本文由克里斯·芒森提供

text:
The 32nd Tank Division was formed from 30th Light Tank Brigade in March-April 1941 in western Kiev Special Military District. On 22 June 1941 included:<cr>
63rd Tank Regiment
64th Tank Regiment
32nd Motorized Rifle Regiment
32nd Howitzer Regiment - only 1 light bn
32nd Reconnaissance Battalion
32nd Motorized Pontoon Battalion
32nd Antiaircraft Battalion<cr><cr>The 32nd Tank Division was one of the best-equipped units formed in 1941, and one of the best-equipped tank divisions in the Red Army in June 1941. Unfortunately, most of the modern equipment was only received in April and May 1941, and there was no time to train crews, platoons, or companies on the new
KVs and T-34 tanks. In addition, the division had only 50.3% of the officers and 42.9% of NCOs assigned, so that experienced leadership was lacking as well as time to train. Overall the division was missing 60% of its authorized equipment. Most critically, only a fifth of the tractors were on hand to ull the artillery, less than 1/3 of the radios, half the telephones, and 10% or less of repair equipment and spare parts required. All of which made it difficult to control, move, or sustain the division in combat.<cr>Nevertheless, the 32nd Tank Division managed to hold together throughout the tank battles in the western Ukraine in June and July. In August 1941 the 4th Mechanized Corps HQ was dissolved and the 32nd Tank Division withdrawn into the reserves, where it was disbanded and the personnel used to form 8th Tank Brigade.<cr><cr>Soviet Order of Battle Volume I by Charles C. Sharp
translation:
第32坦克师于1941年3月至4月在基辅特别军事区西部从第30轻型坦克旅组建而成。6月22日包括：
第63坦克团
第64坦克团
第32摩托化步兵营
第32榴弹炮团——只有1个轻装营
第32侦察营
第32机械化舟桥营
第32防空营

第32坦克师是1941年组建的装备最好的部队之一，也是1941年6月红军中装备最好的坦克师之一。不幸的是，大部分现代化装备仅在1941年4月至5月间收到，没有时间让车组、班排和连队训练新KV和T-34坦克。此外，该师只有50.3%的军官和42.9%的士官到位，因此缺乏经验丰富的领导层以及培训时间。总体而言，该师缺少60%的授权装备。最关键的是，仅有一成拖拉机可用以牵引炮兵，不到三分之一的无线电设备，一半的电话，10%或更少的维修设备和备件。所有这些都使得控制、移动或维持该师在战斗中的运作变得困难。

然而，在6月和7月的乌克兰西部坦克战中，第32坦克师还是设法坚持下来了。1941年8月，第4机械化军司令部解散，第32坦克师撤至预备队，并在那里被解散，人员用于组建第8坦克旅。

苏联战斗序列 第一卷

text: The 330th Infantry Division was formed in December 1941 as part of the 17th Wave. It contained the 554th, 555th and 556th Infantry Regiments, 330th Artillery Regiment and various support units although all three infantry regiments had only two battalions instead of three as was typical of a German infantry regiment at this point in the war. The artillery regiment also had only two battalions rather than the standard four battalions. In April 1943 the 556th Regiment was disbanded and its troops absorbed into the two remaining regiments. In November 1943 the division was reduced to the 330th Divisional Group and its elements absorbed by the 342nd and 367th Infantry Divisions.<cr><cr>George F. Nafziger, The German Order of Battle Infantry in World War II<cr><cr>Entry courtesy Chris Munson
translation: 第330步兵师成立于1941年12月，属于第17波组建的部队。该师包括第554、555和556步兵团，第330炮兵团以及各种支援单位。然而，这三个步兵团每个团只有两个营而不是通常的三个营；同样，炮兵团也只有两个营而非标准的四个营。1943年4月，第556团被解散，其部队并入剩余的两个团中。1943年11月，该师被缩减为第330师编组，并被第342和367步兵师吸收。<cr>参考文献：George F. Nafziger，《二战中的德国战斗序列：步兵》<cr><cr>—<cr>克里斯·芒森提供

text: The 330th Rifle Division was formed as an infantry division of the Red Army late in the summer of 1941, as part of the massive buildup of new Soviet fighting formations at that time. It took part in the defense of Tula in 10th Army soon after reaching the front, and remained in that army for a remarkably long time, until April 1944. It fought in the offensive push into German-occupied western Russia through 1943, then in the destruction of Army Groups Center in the summer of 1944, distinguishing itself in the liberation of Mogilev in June. In 1945 the men and women of the 330th took part in the Vistula-Oder Offensive through Poland and into Pomerania, and then finally in the fighting north of Berlin, ending the war with high distinction, but being disbanded soon after.<cr><cr>
translation: 第330步兵师是红军在1941年夏末组建的一个步兵师，作为当时大规模新建苏军战斗编队的一部分。该师刚到达前线不久就参加了第十集团军在图拉的防御作战，并且令人惊讶地长时间留在该集团军内，直到1944年4月。它参与了1943年向占领西部俄罗斯的德军发起进攻的行动，然后又参加了解放莫吉廖夫的夏季攻势（1944年），在此次行动中表现出色。1945年，第330步兵师参加了维斯瓦-奥得河战役，并进入波美拉尼亚地区作战，最后还参与了柏林北部的战斗，以卓越的表现结束了战争，但不久后就被解散了。<cr><cr>

text: The 331st Infantry Division was formed in December 1941 as part of the 17th Wave. It contained the 557th, 558th and 559th Infantry Regiments, 331st Artillery Regiment and various support units although the 558th and 559th Regiments had only two battalions instead of three as was typical of a German infantry regiment at this point in the war. The artillery regiment also had only two battalions rather than the standard four battalions. As part of the German 4th Army in Army Group Centre it suffered terribly in the winter of 1941/42. Records show by February of 1942 the division was a mere skeleton fleshed out with every sort of odd unit that could be scraped together and was operating as five improvised Groups named Dolle, Koch, Ronicke, Weise and Haase. In December 1943 the division was disbanded and became the Wahn Shadow Division. In March 1944 that division was rebuilt and designated the 331st Grenadier Division with the original three regiments containing two grenadier battalions each. The division fought in Normandy and the Falaise pocket where it was destroyed. The survivors were distributed to other units.<cr><cr>George F. Nafziger, The German Order of Battle Infantry in World War II<cr><cr>Entry courtesy Chris Munson
translation: 第331步兵师成立于1941年12月，属于第17波组建的部队。该师包括第557、558和559步兵团，第331炮兵团以及各种支援单位。然而，第558和559团只有两个营而不是通常的三个营。同样，炮兵团也只有两个营而非标准的四个营。作为中央集团军群下的德国第4集团军的一部分，在1941/42年冬季遭受了严重损失。记录显示到1942年2月该师已形同虚设，由各种拼凑起来的杂牌部队勉强维持，并以五个临时编组“多尔”、“科赫”、“罗尼克”、“魏斯”和“哈塞”进行作战。1943年12月该师被解散并成为“瓦恩幽灵师”。1944年3月，该师重建并改称为第331掷弹兵师，原三个团各包含两个掷弹兵营。该师参加了诺曼底战役和法莱斯包围圈，在后者中被消灭。幸存者被分配到其他部队。<cr>参考文献：George F. Nafziger,《二战中的德国战斗序列：步兵》<cr>条目由Chris Munson提供

text:
One of the so called 'Siberian' divisions, the 331st Rifle Division began forming on the 27th August, 1941, in the Orel Military District, based on workers and reservists from the Bryansk region. As such the Division was also known as the 331st 'Bryansk Proletarian' Rifle Division and went on to have a distinguished history. In November, when moving up to the front line, elements of the Division marched in the October Revolution Anniversary parade in the Red Square. The Division fought with determination in the defense of Moscow and had some success in the Soviets Winter Offensive.

In 1942 the Division was assigned to the Western Front, to which it remained with for the rest of the war, and took part in Operation Mars, with limited success and substantial casualties.

In April 1943 the Division was assigned to the 31st Army and fought with the distinction at Smolensk and Roslavl, and later in the year was part of the unsuccessful attempts to take Orsha. In 1944 the Division took part in Operation Bagration and was commended for the liberation of Orsha and Minsk. In 1945 the Division fought its way into East Prussia where its leading elements were isolated for 2 days and support elements suffered casualties from the retreating Germans. The Division was enroute towards Prague when the war ended and it was disbanded in Friedeberg, Silesia, in July 1945.

A highly decorated unit, the Division was twice awarded the Order of the Red Banner, Order of Suvorov and the honorifics of 'PROLETARIAN', 'BRYANSK' and 'SMOLENSK'. Some of the individual regiments were also awarded the honorific of 'MINSK'. It is perhaps surprising that the Division was not renamed as a Guards Division.



Courtesy of John Tomlinson
translation:
这是一支所谓的“西伯利亚”师之一，第331步兵师于1941年8月27日在奥廖尔军区开始组建，基于布良斯克地区的工人和预备役人员。因此该师也被称为第331“布良斯克无产者”步兵师，并且拥有辉煌的历史。11月，在前往前线的过程中，该师的部分部队参加了纪念十月革命的阅兵式。

在莫斯科防御战中，该师表现出色，并在苏军冬季攻势中取得了一些成功。1942年，该师被分配到西方方面军，并参与了火星行动，虽然取得了有限的成功但伤亡惨重。

1943年4月，第331步兵师被分配给第31集团军，在斯摩棱斯克和罗斯拉夫利作战中表现出色。同年晚些时候，该师参加了未能占领奥尔沙的尝试。在1944年的巴格拉季昂行动中，该师因解放奥尔沙和明斯克而受到表彰。

1945年，第331步兵师一路推进到东普鲁士，在那里其先头部队被孤立了两天，并且支援部队遭受了从撤退德军处来的伤亡。当战争结束时，该师正前往布拉格途中，并于1945年7月在西里西亚的弗里德贝格解散。

这是一支获得高度荣誉的单位，第331步兵师两次被授予红旗勋章、苏沃洛夫勋章以及“无产者”、“布良斯克”和“斯摩棱斯克”的荣誉称号。一些独立团还获得了“明斯克”的荣誉称号。或许令人惊讶的是，该师并未改名为近卫师。

感谢约翰·汤姆林森

text:
The 332nd Rifle Division began forming on the 8th August, 1941, at Ivanovo, in the Moscow Military District, based on the barely formed Ivanovo Militia division. In November, when moving up to the front line, elements of the Division also marched in the October Revolution Anniversary parade in the Red Square. The Division fought in the defense of Moscow and in January 1942 was assigned to the Northwestern Front where it was assigned to operations attempting to retake Velikiye Luki. 

In October 1943 the Division, assigned to the 4th Shock Army, participated in offensive operations towards Vitebsk, and in July 1944 was recognised for its part in the liberation of Polotsk. In early August, the divisional commander T.F. Egoshin, was mortally wounded by artillery fire when directing his troops during a German counter attack. In 1945 the division fought at Knigsberg and in the Courland.

The Division was awarded the Order of Suvorov for the liberation of Riga, and the honorifics of 'IVANOVO' and 'POLOTSK'. 



A.A. Maslov, Fallen Soviet Generals

Courtesy of John Tomlinson
translation:
第332步兵师于1941年8月8日在伊万诺沃开始组建，地点在莫斯科军区，基于刚刚形成的伊万诺沃民兵师。11月，在向前线推进时，该师的部分部队参加了红场举行的十月革命周年阅兵。

该师参与了莫斯科的防御作战，并于1942年1月被分配到西北方面军，负责试图夺回维捷布斯克地区的行动。1943年10月，该师被分配给第4突击集团军，参加了向维捷布斯克方向的进攻战役。1944年7月，因参与波洛茨克解放而受到表彰。

1944年8月初，在指挥部队抵御德军反攻时，师长T.F.叶戈申被炮火严重击伤。1945年该师参加了柯尼斯堡和库尔兰的战斗。

第332步兵师因里加解放获得苏沃洛夫勋章，并获得了“伊万诺沃”和“波洛茨克”的荣誉称谓。

A.A.马斯洛夫，《阵亡苏联将军》

text:
The 333rd Rifle Division began slowly forming in August, 1941, at Kamyshin on the Volga, and was held in Reserve till the end of the year, when it then participated in the Soviet winter counter offensive. In May 1942 the Division, assigned to the 9th Army, Southern Front, just avoided disaster at Kharkov, lost a regiment at Izium, and spent the year retreating towards the Don, where it was rebuilt. Assigned to the newly reformed Southwestern Front, the Division fought at Stalingrad with some success. 

In 1943 the Division fought in the Ukraine, and in 1944 in the 2nd Jassy-Kishinev Offensive and ended the war near Bucharest, assigned to the 37th Army.

The Division was awarded the Order of the Red Banner, Order of Suvorov for the liberation of Nikopol, and the honorific of 'SINELNIKOVO'. 




Courtesy of J. Tomlinson
translation:
第333步兵师于1941年8月在伏尔加河畔卡缅斯克开始缓慢组建，并一直作为预备队直到年底，之后参加了苏联的冬季反攻。1942年5月，该师被分配给南方方面军第9集团军，在哈尔科夫险些遭遇灾难，损失了一个团于伊久姆，并在当年撤退至顿河地区重建。

1943年，该师在乌克兰作战；1944年参加了第二次雅西-奇尔诺夫攻势，并最终战线推进到布加勒斯特附近，被分配给第37集团军。

该师荣获红旗勋章和苏沃洛夫勋章（解放尼科波尔），并获得“斯涅林尼科沃”荣誉称号。

text:
The 334th Rifle Division began forming in August, 1941, at Kazan, in the Volga Military District, and stayed in Reserve until January 1942 when it was assigned to the 4th Shock Army, Northwestern Front. It took part in offensive operations attempting to retake Velikiye Luki with some success as it formed a battery from captured German artillery.

In 1943 the Division participated in offensive operations near Smolensk, and in July 1944 was recognised for its part in the liberation of Vitebsk. The division fought at Riga, along the Baltic, at Knigsberg and ended the war in mopping up operations in the Samland Peninsula.

The Division was awarded the Order of Suvorov for the capture of Landsberg, and the honorific of 'VITEBSK'. 



Courtesy of John Tomlinson
translation:
第334步兵师于1941年8月在伏尔加河军区的喀山开始组建，并一直保持预备状态直到1942年1月，随后被分配给西北方面军中的第4突击集团军。该师参与了试图夺回维捷布斯克附近的弗拉基米尔大卢基的进攻行动，并取得了一定的成功，因为它从被俘获的德国炮兵中组建了一个炮兵连。

在1943年，该师参加了斯摩棱斯克附近的一系列攻势。1944年7月，由于其在解放维捷布斯克中的作用而受到表彰。该师还参与了里加、波罗的海沿岸、柯尼斯堡等地的战斗，并最终在萨姆兰半岛进行清剿行动中结束了战争。

第334步兵师因攻克兰茨贝格获得苏沃洛夫勋章，以及“维捷布斯克”荣誉称号。

text:
The 335th Rifle Division began forming in September, 1941, at Stalingrad, in the North Caucasus Military District, and when assigned to the 57th Army, Southwestern Front, took part in the Soviet Winter offensive. In May 1942, at the 2nd Battle of Kharkov, the Division was only at 50% strength and had to fight it's way out of encirclement. In July 1942 the bulk of the Division was trapped in the Millerovo pocket, in August the Division was listed as without troops and in November it was disbanded.

In May 1944 the Division was raised for a 2nd time, based on the 6th Rifle Brigade, in the Far East, where it remained for the rest of the war. It took no major part in the Soviet invasion of Manchuria.

A commander of interest was P.M. Volosatykh, demoted in February 1942 and condemned to 8 years frontline duty as a Regiment Commander. He was able to rehabilitate his career, served again as a Divisional Commander and was awarded the Hero of the Soviet Union.



Courtesy of John Tomlinson
translation:
第335步兵师于1941年9月在斯大林格勒的北高加索军区开始组建，并被分配到西南方面军第57集团军，参加了苏联冬季攻势。1942年5月，在第二次哈尔科夫战役中，该师仅剩50% s%实力，不得不奋力突围。1942年7月，该师主力被困在米列罗沃包围圈内，8月被列为无兵可派，11月解散。

1944年5月，该师第二次组建，基于远东地区的第6步兵旅，并在整个战争期间留在那里。它没有参与苏联入侵满洲的主要行动。

值得一提的指挥官是P.M.沃洛萨季赫少校，他在1942年2月被降职，并被判在前线担任团级指挥官8年。他成功恢复了职业生涯，再次担任师长，并获得苏联英雄称号。

text: The 335th Static Division was formed in November 1940 using two battalions from the 197th Infantry Division, three from the 298th Infantry Division and one from the 87th Infantry Division. In the summer of 1941 the division was sent to central France on garrison duty. In October 1942 the division was upgraded to a field division and became the 335th Infantry Division. It contained the 682nd, 683rd and 684th Grenadier Regiments, 335th Artillery Regiment and various support units. The division was sent to southern Russia in February 1943 and was in action almost continuously the next year and a half. It fought at Kursk , Stalino, the Dnieper Bend battles, Nikopol, the retreat through the Donets and in the Zaporoshje bridehead. The division was destroyed at Kishinev, Romania in August 1944 and on October 9, 1944 was disbanded.<cr><cr>George F. Nafziger, The German Order of Battle Infantry in World War II<cr>Samuel W. Mitcham, German Order of Battle Volume II: 291st-999th Infantry Divisions, Named Infantry Divisions, and Special Divisions in WWII<cr><cr>Entry courtesy Chris Munson

text:
The 336th Rifle Division began forming in August, 1941, at Melekess, in the Volga Military District, and in December was assigned to the 5th Army, Western Front. Committed to the defence of Moscow, the Divisions first combat was a disaster; the Officers lost control of the troops who fled the field of battle in a disorderly manner and as a consequence the Divisional Commander, G.M Shapovalov, took his own life. The Division suffered heavy casualties.

In 1942 the Division fought in the Rhzev area as part of Operation Mars, and once again suffered heavy casualties, without success.

In 1943 the Division was assigned to operations in the Ukraine and fought with success in the liberation of Zhitomir and assisting later on in the liberation of Rovno and Lutsk. The Division fought its way across the Ukraine and ended the war in Czechoslovakia. At this time the Division was at half strength.

The Division was awarded the Order of the Red Banner, Order of Suvorov and the honorific 'ZHITOMIR'.




Courtesy of John Tomlinson
translation:
第336步兵师于1941年8月在伏尔加河军区的梅列克谢斯开始组建，并于同年12月被分配给西方面军下的第5集团军。该师奉命保卫莫斯科，首次战斗即是一场灾难；军官们失去了对部队的控制，士兵们以混乱的方式逃离战场，结果导致师长G.M沙波瓦洛夫自杀。该师遭受了重大损失。

1942年，该师在勒热夫地区参加了火星行动，并再次遭受重大损失而未取得成功。

1943年，该师被分配到乌克兰地区的作战任务，在解放日托米尔和后来协助解放罗夫诺与卢茨克的战斗中取得了成功。该师一路奋战穿越了整个乌克兰，并最终在捷克斯洛伐克结束战争。此时，该师已减员至半数。

该师荣获红旗勋章、苏沃洛夫勋章以及“日托米尔”荣誉称号。

text: The 336th Static Division was formed in December 1940 as part of the 14th Wave from cadres of the 61st and 256th Infantry Divisions. This Saxon unit consisted of the 685th, 686th and 687th Infantry Regiments, 336th Divisional Fusilier Battalion, 336th Artillery Regiment and various support units. The division was posted to Belgium in May 1941, to Le Havre France in June 1941 and to Brittany in April 1942.<cr>In May 1942 the division was sent to Russia and in June 1942 the division was upgraded to a field division becoming the 336th Infantry Division. The division was posted to the Hungarian Second Army near Kharkov. Later the division was part of Army Detachment Hollidt during its unsuccessful attempt to relieve Stalingrad. The division was transferred to the Crimea in November 1943 and was destroyed during the Crimean Offensive in May 1944. A few survivors were evacuated by sea from Sevastopol before the city fell. The survivors were incorporated into the 685th Grenadier Regiment of the 294th Infantry Division.<cr><cr>George F. Nafziger, The German Order of Battle Infantry in World War II<cr>Samuel W. Mitcham, German Order of Battle Volume II: 291st-999th Infantry Divisions, Named Infantry Divisions, and Special Divisions in WWII<cr><cr>Entry courtesy Chris Munson
translation:
第336步兵师于1940年12月作为第十四波组建，由第61和第256步兵师的骨干人员组成。这个萨克森部队包括第685、686和687步兵团，第336师掷弹兵营，第336炮兵团以及各种支援单位。该师于1941年5月被派驻比利时，同年6月被派驻法国勒阿弗尔，1942年4月被派驻布列塔尼。<cr>1942年5月，该师被派往俄罗斯，并在同年6月升级为野战师，成为第336步兵师。该师被派驻匈牙利第二集团军，在哈尔科夫附近。后来该师作为霍尔迪特集群的一部分参与了试图解救斯大林格勒的行动但未成功。<cr>1943年11月，该师被调往克里米亚，并在1944年5月的克里米亚攻势中被消灭。少数幸存者在塞瓦斯托波尔沦陷前通过海上撤离。<cr>这些幸存者被编入第294步兵师的第685掷弹兵团。

text:
The 338th Rifle Division began forming in September, 1941, at Penza, in the Volga Military District, and when combat ready was assigned to the 37th Army, Western Front. The Division took part in the Soviet winter offensive but was trapped by German counter offensive operations in February 1942, and along with most of the 33rd Army was destroyed by May. Remnants of the Division, including the Divisional Commander and some staff officers, eventually made it back to Soviet lines.

The Division was raised for a 2nd time in June 1942, based on the 18th Rifle Brigade, and was assigned to the Western Front. In 1943 the Division fought in the Rzhev area and in operations that eventually led to the liberation of Smolensk. In early 1944 the Division took part in the unsuccessful liberation of Vitebsk and was reduced to 3,500 men. In Operation Bagration the Division had a secondary, follow up role, fought in the Baltic and Riga, and by the end of the year was attempting to surround Knigsberg in East Prussia. 

The Division ended the war performing mopping up operations in Samland, assigned to the 39th Army. 

The Division was eventually awarded the Order of the Red Banner and the honorific 'NEMAN'.



Courtesy of John Tomlinson
translation:
第338步兵师于1941年9月在伏尔加河军区的彭塔成立，当准备就绪时被分配给西方方面军的第37集团军。该师参加了苏联冬季攻势，但在1942年2月被德军反攻围困，并且与大部分第33集团军一样，在5月份被消灭。该师残部包括师长和一些参谋军官最终返回苏军防线。

该师于1942年6月第二次组建，基于第18步兵旅，随后被分配给西方方面军。在1943年，该师参加了热季地区作战，并参与了最终解放斯摩棱斯克的行动。1944年初，该师参加了未能解放维捷布斯克的战斗，兵力减少到3500人。在巴格拉季昂行动中，该师扮演次要支援角色，在波罗的海和里加作战，并试图包围东普鲁士的柯尼斯堡。

战争结束时，该师负责萨姆兰地区的清剿任务，隶属于第39集团军。

该师最终被授予红旗勋章并获得“涅曼”荣誉称号。

text:
The 339th Rifle Division began forming in August, 1941, at Rostov, from reservists and local communist party members. Barely formed it was rushed to the front and in November took part in the operations that drove the Germans out of Rostov for the first time. In July 1942, assigned to the 56th Army, the Division unsuccessfully defended Rostov and retreated into the Caucasus where it saw action at Krasnodar and finally Tuapse. 

With the Axis retreat from the Caucasus the Division fought with distinction in clearing the Taman peninsula and in November 1943 crossed over to the Crimea via Kerch. It was at this time that the Divisional Commander T.S. Kulakov was killed in action during an air raid. 

When the Crimea had been cleared, in September 1944 the Division moved North and fought its way to the Oder River, ending the war at the Oder Spree canal.

The Division was awarded the Order of the Red Banner, Order of Suvorov, and the honorifics 'ROSTOV', 'TAMAN' and 'BRANDENBERG'.



A.A. Maslov, Fallen Soviet Generals


Courtesy of John Tomlinson
translation:
第339步兵师于1941年8月在罗斯托夫开始组建，由预备役人员和当地共产党成员组成。该师刚刚组建便被紧急送往前线，在11月参加了第一次将德军驱逐出罗斯托夫的行动。

1942年7月，第339步兵师被分配给第56集团军，试图保卫罗斯托夫但未能成功，并撤退至高加索地区，在克拉斯诺达尔和图阿普谢作战。

随着轴心国从高加索地区的撤退，该师在清理塔曼半岛的战斗中表现出色，并于1943年11月通过刻赤海峡进入克里米亚。此时，师长T.S.库拉科夫将军在一次空袭中阵亡。

当克里米亚被肃清后，在1944年9月该师向北推进至奥得河，并最终在奥得-施普雷运河结束战争。

第339步兵师荣获红旗勋章、苏沃洛夫勋章，以及“罗斯托夫”、“塔曼”和“勃兰登堡”的荣誉称号。
