text: The army was first formed by order of the STAVKA within Stalingrad Front on July 22, 1942, based on the remaining elements of the headquarters of the former 28th Army, which had been largely destroyed in recent fighting. Mjr. Gen. V.D. Kryuchenkin, commander of the former 28th Army, was given command of 4th Tank Army. The new formation incorporated the 22nd Tank Corps, under Mjr. Gen. Shamshin, and Mjr. Gen. Khashin's 23rd Tank Corps, plus three rifle divisions transferred from the Far Eastern Front, two anti-tank regiments and two anti-aircraft regiments. 8th Separate Fighter Air Brigade provided support.<cr>It was committed to battle without being fully formed, as German forces had broken through. The Army attempted to stop the 6th Army, but was not successful and lost a large number of tanks. On 1 August 1942 official Soviet records show the Army as comprising the 22nd Tank Corps (133rd, 173rd, 176th, and 182nd Tank Brigades plus the 22nd Motor Rifle Brigade), the 18th and 205th Rifle Divisions, an independent brigade, and two artillery regiments. In August 1942 it fought on the southern approaches to Stalingrad, having conducted some successful counterattacks against units of the 48th Panzer Corps.<cr>4th Tank Army later came under command of Gen. K.K. Rokossovsky's Don Front. On 22 October Kryuchenkin was replaced by Gen. P.I. Batov. The much diminished army was re-designated the 65th Army on 27 October, and served for the duration under Batov's command.<cr><cr>
translation: 该集团军于1942年7月22日由最高统帅部大本营命令在斯大林格勒方面军建立，基于前第28集团军司令部的剩余力量。前第28集团军指挥官克柳琴金中将被任命为第4坦克集团军指挥官。新编成包括沙缅中将指挥的第22坦克军和哈申中将指挥的第23坦克军，以及从远东方面军调来的三个步兵师、两个反坦克团和两个防空团。<cr>第8独立歼击航空旅提供支援。<cr>由于德军突破，该集团军尚未完全编成即被投入战斗。它试图阻止第6集团军的推进，但未能成功并损失了大量坦克。<cr>1942年8月1日，官方苏联记录显示该集团军包括第22坦克军（第133、173、176和182坦克旅以及第22摩托化步兵旅）、第18和205步兵师、一个独立旅和两个炮兵团。在1942年8月，它在斯大林格勒南部地区作战，并对第48装甲军的部分单位进行了几次成功的反击。<cr>第4坦克集团军后来被罗科索夫斯基将军指挥的顿河方面军接管。克柳琴金于10月22日被巴托夫将军取代。该集团军在人数大减后，于10月27日重新编为第65集团军，并一直由巴托夫指挥。<cr>

text:
The 4th Tank Corps was formed in March 1942 in the Moscow Military District. In early April moved to Voronezh in Orel Military District to take command of units.<cr>The corps had a total of 21-23 KVs, 60-70 T-34s, 30 Matilda Us (in 102nd Tank Brigade) and 60 T-60 light tanks. By the end of April it was in Bryansk Front reserves, where it finished forming, but had little time for unit training before it went into action in June and July near Voronezh. In August the corps was shifted south, and assigned to 1st Guards Army during the improvised attacks that army made to relieve the pressure on Stalingrad in September. In October 1942 4th Tank Corps went into Southwestern Front reserves to prepare for the Stalingrad counteroffensive. When that offensive started on 19 November, 4th Tank Corps was in 21st Army, forming part of the 'inner ring' that encircled the German 6th Army from the north.In the November battles 4th Tank Corps controlled:
45th Tank Brigade 
47th Tank Brigade 
102nd Tank Brigade
4th Motorized Rifle Brigade
127th Guards Mortar Battalion
1116th Antiaircraft Regiment 
468th Separate Antiaircraft Battalion
Combined total: 25 37mm, 23 12.7mm AAMG<cr>For the Stalingrad operation, 4th Tank Corps received the honorific title: 'Stalingradskikh'. The corps took part in Voronezh Front's operations in January 1943 against the 8th Italian Army, and was in Voronezh Front reserves on 7 February 1943 when it was officially redesignated as the 5th Guards
'Stalingradskikh' Tank Corps.<cr><cr>Soviet Order of Battle World War II Volume II by Charles C. Sharp

第4坦克军于1942年3月在莫斯科军区组建。4月初移至奥廖尔军区的沃罗涅日，接管部队指挥权。<cr>该军共有KV重型坦克21-23辆、T-34中型坦克60-70辆、102坦克旅辖马蒂尔达步兵坦克30辆以及T-60轻型坦克60辆。到4月底，该军进入布良斯克方面军预备队，在那里完成组建工作，但在6月和7月在沃罗涅日附近投入战斗前几乎没有时间进行部队训练。<cr>8月，该军被调往南方，并于9月德军第6集团军对斯大林格勒施加压力时，被分配给第1近卫集团军参与临时反击行动。1942年10月，第4坦克军进入西南方面军预备队，为斯大林格勒反攻做准备。<cr>当进攻于11月19日开始时，第4坦克军隶属于第21集团军群，成为从北面包围德军第6集团军的“内圈”部队的一部分。在11月的战斗中，该军指挥：
<cr>第45坦克旅
第47坦克旅
第102坦克旅
第4机械化步兵旅
第127近卫迫击炮营
第1116防空团
第468独立防空营
合计：25门37毫米高射炮，23挺12.7毫米机枪<cr>在斯大林格勒行动中，第4坦克军获得了“斯大林格勒的”荣誉称号。该军参加了沃罗涅日方面军于1943年1月对第8意大利集团军的作战，并于1943年2月7日正式改称为第5近卫‘斯大林格勒的’坦克军。<cr>查尔斯·C·夏普著《苏联二战战斗序列 第二卷》

text:
The 4th Tank Division was formed in July 1940 in Western Special Military District as part of 6th Mechanized Corps. On 22 June 1941 included:<cr>
7th Tank Regiment
1st Bn - 31 KV tanks
2nd, 3rd Tank bns - each 52 mixed T-34s and BT tanks
4th Tank Bn - light tanks
8th Tank Regiment
1st Bn - 31 KV tanks
2nd, 3rd Tank Bns - each 52 mixed T-34 and BT tanks
4th Tank Bn - all light tanks
4th Motorized Rifle Regiment
1st, 2nd, 3rd bns
4th Motorized Howitzer Regiment
1 light, 1 medium bn
4th Reconnaissance Battalion
4th Motorized Pontoon Battalion
4th Antiaircraft Battalion<cr><cr>The 6th Mechanized Corps was slow to form up and equip in 1940: by October there were only 315 old light tanks in the entire Corps, or less than 30% of what was authorized. In early 1941, however, this unit had priority in Western Special Military District for new tanks and equipment. By June 1941 4th Tank Division was almost completely equipped with artillery, including the light 37mm AA guns that were in short supply throughout the army.<cr>In armor, 4th Tank Division started the war with 63 KVs, 88 T-34s, and over 200 BT-5 or BT-7s, and a few lighter T-26 tanks. In modern tanks, it was one of the five best-equipped divisions in the Red Army, and one of the only divisions with two fully-equipped Heavy Tank Battalions. It was also one of the most completely ineffective tank divisions in the Red Army in June 1941. The division headquarters in Bialystok was bombed on the first day of the war, the division commander killed, communications broke down, and most of the tanks ran out of fuel and were abandoned without firing a shot. Caught in the Bialystok and Minsk 'pockets' the last bits and pieces of the division disappeared from the Soviet order of battle less than 2 weeks after the war started.<cr><cr>Soviet Order of Battle Volume I by Charles C. Sharp

第4防空营<cr>@PH2@@第6机械化军在1940年组建和装备缓慢：到10月整个军只有315辆老旧轻型坦克，或不到授权数量的30%。然而，在1941年初，该部队成为西部特别军区优先获得新坦克和设备的单位之一。到1941年6月，第4坦克师几乎完全装备了火炮，包括在全军短缺的37毫米轻型防空炮。<cr>在装甲方面，第4坦克师在战争开始时拥有63辆KV坦克、88辆T-34坦克和超过200辆BT-5或BT-7坦克以及少量较轻的T-26坦克。在现代坦克中，它是红军五大最充分装备的师之一，并且是唯一拥有两个完全配备重型坦克营的师之一。然而，在1941年6月，它也是红军中最无能的装甲师之一。该师司令部位于比亚韦斯托克，在战争的第一天遭到轰炸，师长阵亡，通信中断，大部分坦克因燃料耗尽而被遗弃未开一枪。被困在比亚韦斯托克和明斯克“口袋”中，该师最后残余部分在战争开始不到两周后从苏联战斗序列中消失。<cr>@PH5@@苏联战斗序列 第一卷 作者：查尔斯·C·肖普

text: The 4th Ukrainian Front was formed on 20 October 1943, by renaming the Southern Front.<cr>The front's first operations were the Lower Dnieper Stategic Offensive Operation and the Kiev Stategic Offensive and Kiev Strategic Defensive operations. In early 1944, after an amphibious landing against the German-held Crimea, begun the Crimean Stategic Offensive Operation in which 4UF, including 2nd Guards Army, 51st Army and the Separate Coastal Army destroyed the 17th Army which was holding out there.<cr>Its final operations were the Moravian-Ostrava Offensive Operation and the Prague Offensive.<cr><cr>
translation: 第4乌克兰方面军成立于1943年10月20日，由南方方面军改名而来。<cr>该方面军的首次行动是第聂伯河下游战略进攻战役和基辅战略进攻及防御战役。1944年初，在克里米亚登陆战之后，开始了克里米亚战略进攻战役，在此战役中，包括第2近卫集团军、第51集团军以及独立海岸集团军在内的第4乌克兰方面军消灭了坚守在那里的第17集团军。<cr>其最后的行动是摩拉维亚-奥斯特拉瓦攻势和布拉格攻势。<cr><cr>

text: The 50th Army became active on Aug. 16, 1941 along the Desna River as part of the newly-forming Bryansk Front. On Sept. 30, 1941, the 2nd Panzer Army launched Operation Typhoon in the 50th Army's sector. On the third day it had penetrated the weak 13th Army and a day later reached Oryol. The 50th Army was bypassed, and was able to fall back beyond Bryansk without catastrophic losses.<cr>By late October 50th Army had fallen back towards the city of Tula and partly repaired its strength. Three extremely depleted divisions, the 293rd, 413th and 239th, arrived from the front, each with between 500 and 1,000 men, who were exhausted and with little equipment. Within two months these divisions had been refitted and reinforced to authorized strength.<cr>In December, more divisions were added to the army: four rifle divisions, three cavalry divisions, a depleted tank division, and independent tank regiments. The rapid reconstruction of this army was probably typical of many others in this period.<cr>On Jan. 8, 1942 50th Army launched the second phase of the Moscow counteroffensive with a surprise attack on German positions southeast of Tula. The 50th pressed westward as part of the Rzhev-Vyasma Offensive, making repeated and increasingly futile efforts to cut the Smolensk-Moscow highway and encircle Army Group Center.During the balance of 1942 and into early 1943 the 50th, reduced to just four rifle divisions and a few supporting units, manned the defenses southwest of Moscow. It played a very limited role in the Third Rzhev-Sychevka Offensive Operation, liberating a small sector at the base of the Rzhev Salient as the Germans withdrew.<cr>Following the Soviet victory at the Battle of Kursk, STAVKA began developing its first summer offensive, beginning with Operation Kutuzov against the vulnerable salient centered at Oryol. 50th Army was given a supporting role, due to its relatively small size.<cr>During the spring of 1944, 50th Army was reinforced with the 8th SU Brigade of SU-76 self-propelled guns, backing up the rifle divisions in their limited assaults until being withdrawn into front reserves prior to the summer offensive.<cr>2nd Belorussian Front played a secondary role in Operation Bagration, mainly holding German 4th Army in place on both sides of the River Dnieper. 50th Army was spread over a 75 km sector. The East Prussian operation began on Jan. 14, 1945. 2nd Belorussian Front made relatively slow progress at first, but gained speed with the introduction of tank forces and improving weather. 50th Army was set to keep an eye on the German forces defending along the Augustw Canal. All but a small rearguard of those slipped away to battle the Front's main forces .<cr>Beginning on Apr. 6, the army formed the right flank of the Soviet forces in the assault on Knigsberg. One corps was to hold the line while two corps with a total of six rifle divisions took part in the attack. 50th Army was reinforced with artillery, 65 tanks and 42 heavy self-propelled guns, and one assault engineer-sapper brigade. On the first day the army's units had advanced up to two kilometres, capturing a fort west of Baydritten and clearing 39 city blocks. On the 7th an additional 1.5-2 km penetration was made, helping to force the German garrison back to their second position. On the 8th the army, closely cooperating along its right flank with the 43rd Army, captured the Palfe area. The German forces capitulated late in the day on the 9th, and on the 10th the remaining pockets of resistance were eliminated.<cr><cr>
translation: 第50集团军于1941年8月16日在德纳河沿岸作为新成立的布良斯克方面军的一部分开始活动。1941年9月30日，第2装甲集团军在第50集团军辖区发起了台风行动。三天后，它突破了薄弱的第13集团军，并于一天后到达奥廖尔。第50集团军被绕过，在布良斯克以西得以撤退而没有遭受重大损失。<cr><cr>到10月下旬，第50集团军已撤退至图拉市附近并部分恢复了实力。三个极度减员的师——第293步兵师、第413步兵师和第239步兵师——从前线抵达，每个师有500到1,000人，他们疲惫不堪且装备不足。两个月内这些师得到了整备并加强到了授权编制。<cr><cr>12月，更多师被加入该集团军：四个步兵师、三个骑兵师、一个减员的坦克师以及独立坦克团。这个集团军迅速重建的情况可能是当时许多其他部队的典型情况。<cr><cr>1942年1月8日，第50集团军发起了莫斯科反攻第二阶段，在图拉东南方向对德军阵地发动了突袭攻击。作为别列津纳-维亚兹马攻势的一部分，第50集团军向西推进，不断尝试切断斯摩棱斯克-莫斯科公路并包围中央集团军群，但这些努力越来越徒劳。<cr><cr>1942年剩余时间和1943年初，被削减至仅四个步兵师和少数支援单位的第50集团军在莫斯科西南方向守卫防御工事。它在第三次别列津纳-斯切夫卡攻势中扮演了非常有限的角色，在德军撤退时解放了别列津纳突出部底部的一小片区域。<cr><cr>在库尔斯克战役胜利后，最高统帅部大本营开始制定第一个夏季攻势计划，首先实施科图佐夫行动，针对奥廖尔附近的德军突出部。第50集团军被赋予辅助角色，因为其规模相对较小。<cr>1944年春季，第50集团军得到第8自行火炮旅（装备SU-76自行火炮）的增援，在步兵师有限进攻期间提供支援，并在夏季攻势开始前撤入方面军预备队。<cr>第二白俄罗斯方面军在巴格拉季昂行动中扮演次要角色，主要任务是牵制德军第4集团军，使其无法从第聂伯河两岸发起攻击。第50集团军负责75公里宽的防区。东普鲁士攻势于1945年1月14日开始。第二白俄罗斯方面军初期进展缓慢，但随着坦克部队的加入和天气好转而加快了速度。第50集团军的任务是监视沿奥古斯图瓦运河防守的德军部队。<cr>除了留下少数后卫外，其余德军都撤退到主力部队面前迎战方面军的主要力量。从4月6日开始，该集团军构成了苏联部队对柯尼斯堡突击行动的右翼。一个军负责坚守防线，两个军共六个步兵师参与了攻击。第50集团军得到了炮兵、65辆坦克和42门重型自行火炮的增援，并且增加了一个突击工兵旅。第一天内，该集团军的部队推进了两公里，占领了贝德里滕西面的一座要塞，并清理了39个街区。7日又向前推进了1.5至2公里，帮助迫使德军守备部队退回到第二道防线。8日，在其右翼与第43集团军密切配合下，该集团军占领了帕尔费地区。德军在9日晚上投降，到10日为止，剩余的抵抗据点被肃清。<cr>指挥官报告：<cr>损失：无<cr><cr>增援：炮兵、65辆坦克和42门重型自行火炮、一个突击工兵旅<cr>

text: The 50th Guards Rifle Division was formed in November, 1942 from the 2nd formation of the 124th Rifle Division, and served in that role until well after the end of the WWII. It was in the 21st Army of Southwestern Front when it formed but soon moved to 5th Tank Army and played a leading role in the defeat of the 3rd Romanian Army in Operaton Uranus. It was transferred to the 3rd Guards Army when that was formed and was under this Army as it advanced into the Donbass in late winter. In April, 1943 the division was moved again to the 51st Army in Southern Front where it was assigned to the 3rd Guards Rifle Corps, which it remained with for the duration of the war.<cr><cr>The division remained in the south of Ukraine into early 1944, in the 51st or later the 5th Shock Army, and won a battle honor, its first Order of the Red Banner, and the Order of Suvorov in the process. It was then moved to the Reserve of the Supreme High Command for rebuilding before returning to the front in May, 1944 and joining the 28th Army, where it remained for the duration. The 50th Guards took part in the summer offensive in Belarus and later the abortive Gumbinnen Operation. In January, 1945 the division fought into East Prussia and assisted in the battles southwest of the city of Knigsberg, winning two further decorations including a rare second Order of the Red Banner, before 28th Army was redeployed westward to take part in the Berlin operation. By now it was part of 1st Ukrainian Front and spent the last days of the war advancing on Prague.<cr><cr>
translation:
第50近卫步兵师成立于1942年11月，由第124步兵师的第二组建改编而成，并一直服役到二战结束之后。该师成立时隶属于西南方面军第21集团军，但很快被调往第5坦克集团军，在天王星行动中发挥了重要作用，击败了第3罗马尼亚集团军。当第3近卫集团军建立后，它被转隶至该集团军，并在冬季末期随其推进到顿巴斯地区。1943年4月，该师再次调往南方方面军的第51集团军，在那里隶属于第3近卫步兵军，直至战争结束。

第50近卫步兵师于1944年初仍驻扎在乌克兰南部，先是在第51集团军，后来转隶到第5突击集团军，并在此过程中获得了一项荣誉——首次荣获红旗勋章和苏沃洛夫勋章。随后该师被调往最高统帅部预备队进行重建，在1944年5月重返前线并加入第28集团军，直至战争结束。

在白俄罗斯夏季攻势中以及后来的贡宾嫩行动中，第50近卫步兵师均参与其中。1945年1月，该师进入东普鲁士，并协助了柯尼斯堡西南部的战斗，在此过程中又获得了两项荣誉，包括罕见的第二次红旗勋章。随后第28集团军被重新部署到柏林方向作战。

此时，该师隶属于乌克兰第1方面军，并在战争最后几天推进至布拉格附近。

text: The 50th crossed into southern Russia, where it fought at Odessa and Nikolajew, and was involved in breaching the Perekop Isthmus in the northern Crimea and in the reduction of Sevastopol (1941-42). Later, in the fall of 1942, the 50th Infantry took part in the Caucasus campaign and narrowly avoided being cut off in the Kuban bridgehead by marching across the Sea of Azov on the ice, because the land routes had been cut off or threatened by the Russians.<cr>After the retreat to the lower Dnieper, the 50th Infantry was returned to the Crimea, where, in April 1944, it faced an exact reversal of roles from that of 1941: it was defending the Perekop Isthmus against a Russian attack. Finally defeated after suffering heavy losses, it retreated back to Sevastopol, where the divisional commander, Major General Friedrich Sixt, was seriously wounded and had to be evacuated by air on May 1. Eight days later his replacement, Colonel Paul Betz, was killed in action. In the evacuation of the Crimea by the German Navy, most of the 50th was left behind; most of these were made prisoner, except for the officers, who were brutally murdered by the Russians after they had surrendered. Only 2,800 men from the division managed to escape by sea. They were transported to Romania, reformed, and sent back into action with Army Group Center in July. Its grenadier regiments, however, now only had two weak battalions each. The burned-out division suffered heavy losses against the Soviet summer offensive of 1944 but was still in combat in late 1944, when it was defending a sector in East Prussia. It was largely destroyed in the Heiligenbeil Pocket in March 1945. The remnants of the division escaped to the Hela Pocket, where they surrendered to the Red Army in May.<cr><cr>German Order of Battle Vol I 1st - 290th Infantry Divisions in WWII, Samuel W. Mitcham Jr.
translation:
第50师进入南俄，参加了敖德萨和尼古拉耶夫的战斗，并参与了北部克里米亚佩雷科普地峡的突破以及塞瓦斯托波尔（1941-42年）的围攻。后来，在1942年秋季，第50步兵师参加了高加索战役，并通过在亚速海上冰面上行军，险些避免了被库班桥头堡切断的命运，因为陆上路线已经被俄国人切断或威胁。

撤退到第聂伯河下游后，第50步兵师返回克里米亚，在1944年4月面对着与1941年的角色完全相反的局面：它正在佩雷科普地峡防御俄罗斯的进攻。在遭受重大损失后最终被击败，该师撤退到塞瓦斯托波尔，师长弗里德里希·齐克斯少将在此严重受伤，并于5月1日通过空运撤离。八天后，他的继任者保罗·贝茨上校阵亡。

在德国海军从克里米亚的撤退中，第50师大部分被遗弃；除了军官外，大多数人都成为战俘，而这些军官在投降后被俄国人残忍杀害。只有2800名士兵通过海上逃脱。他们被运送到罗马尼亚重组，并于7月重新投入中央集团军群的战斗。

然而，该师掷弹兵团现在每个只拥有两个虚弱的营。这支疲惫不堪的部队在1944年苏联夏季攻势中遭受了重大损失，但仍能在1944年底继续作战，在东普鲁士的一个地区进行防御。它于1945年3月在海利根贝伊尔包围圈被大部分摧毁。该师残部逃到了赫拉包围圈，并在那里向红军投降。德国战斗序列 第一卷：第1至第290步兵师在二战，萨缪尔·W·米查姆少将

text: The 50th Rifle Division was an infantry division of the Red Army from 1936 to 1946. The division took part in the Soviet invasion of Poland and the Winter War. After Germany launched Operation Barbarossa, the 50th fought in the Battle of Moscow, the Battles of Rzhev, the Donbass Strategic Offensive, the Dnieper-Carpathian Offensive, the Jassy-Kishinev Offensive, Vistula-Oder Offensive and the Berlin Offensive.<cr><cr><cr><cr> Entry courtesy of NotOneStepBack
translation: 第50步兵师是红军自1936年至1946年期间的一个步兵师。该师参加了苏联入侵波兰和冬季战争。德国发动巴巴罗萨行动后，第50步兵师参与了莫斯科保卫战、热季夫战役、顿巴斯战略进攻、第聂伯-喀尔巴阡进攻、雅西-奇西瑙攻势、维斯瓦-奥得攻势以及柏林战役。<cr>指挥官报告：NotOneStepBack 提供

text:
The 50th Tank Division was formed February-March 1941 in Kharkov Military District as part of 25th Mechanized Corps with:<cr>
99th Tank Regiment
1st, 2nd, 3rd Tank Bns - each 25 to 31 tanks
100th Tank Regiment
1st, 2nd, 3rd Tank Bns - each 25 to 31 tanks
50th Motorized Rifle Regiment
1st, 2nd, 3rd bns
50th Howitzer Regiment
1 light, 1 medium bn
50th Reconnaissance Battalion
50th Motorized Pontoon Battalion
50th Antiaircraft Battalion<cr>
Kharkov was one of the large tank production center sin the Soviet Union, but that didn't change the fact that units forming here were not on the frontier with Germany or Japan, and so had no priority to get the tanks. 50th Tank Division had only about 150 tanks, all but a dozen or so old light tanks. The only modern vehicles were 20 KVs and T-34s in the Corps for training and familiarization, and those had only arrived in May; almost no one in the entire Corps had time to train on them before the war started.
50th Tank Division fought under 25th Mechanized Corps in the Western Direction (or Theatre) on the road to Moscow, and then as a separate division in 13th Army in August and September. In early September it was sent into the reserves and disbanded to provide cadres for new tank brigades.<cr><cr>Soviet Order of Battle Volume I by Charles C. Sharp
translation:
第50坦克师成立于1941年2月至3月，在哈尔科夫军区组建，隶属于第25机械化军，下辖：
第99坦克团
第1、2、3坦克营——每营有25至31辆坦克
第100坦克团
第1、2、3坦克营——每营有25至31辆坦克
第50摩托化步兵团
第1、2、3营
第50榴弹炮团
一个轻型和一个中型营
第50侦察营
第50机械化舟桥营
第50防空营

哈尔科夫是苏联重要的坦克生产基地之一，但这并未改变这里组建的部队不在与德国或日本接壤边境的事实，因此这些部队没有优先获得新坦克。第50坦克师只有大约150辆坦克，除了十几辆较新的轻型坦克外，其余都是老旧型号。唯一现代化车辆是20辆KV和T-34，在军中用于训练和熟悉装备，但它们直到5月才到达；整个机械化军几乎没有人有时间在开战前进行这些新车型的训练。

第50坦克师曾在西方向（或战区）隶属于第25机械化军，沿着通往莫斯科的道路作战。8月至9月间作为独立师隶属于第13集团军。9月初被调往预备队并解散，以提供人员骨干组建新的装甲旅。
Soviet Order of Battle Volume I by Charles C. Sharp

text: The Army was ordered formed on 14 August 1941 in the Crimea based on the 9th Rifle Corps and other units as the 51st Independent Army, with the task of guarding the Crimean Peninsula. In November the army was evacuated from the Taman Peninsula and it joined the Transcaucasian Front. The army participated in the Kerch-Feodosiya landing operation in December 1941-January 1942 . A German offensive was launched against the Front on 8 May 1942. The offensive concluded around 18 May 1942 with the near complete destruction of Soviet defending forces. Three armies (44th, 47th, and 51st), 21 divisions, 176,000 men, 347 tanks, and nearly 3,500 guns were lost. The remains of the force were evacuated.<cr>After the evacuation 51st Army joined the North Caucasian Front at Kuban. In July, Marshal Budenny received orders to combine the Southern Front and North Caucasian Front into a single formation retaining the title of North Caucasian Front, and 51st Army joined the 'Don group' of that front. As part of the Stalingrad Front (from 1-5 August), then briefly with the Southeast Front (from 6 August until 27 September), and then back with the Stalingrad Front it took part in the Battle of Stalingrad. On 30 January 1943, the Luftwaffe's Kampfgeschwader 51 destroyed the 51st Army's Headquarters, near Salsk. Dropping 100 - 250 kg bombs, a wave of Junkers Ju 88s and Heinkel He 111s destroyed the communications center, working offices of the chief-of-staff, the operational headquarters and the offices of the operational duty officer. Up to 20 buildings and personnel billets were also destroyed. Casualties among personnel were also very high.<cr>After January 1943 as part of the Southern Front, that became the 4th Ukrainian Front on 20 October 1943, the 51st Army took part in the Rostov, Donbass (August-September 1943), Melitopol (September-November 1943) and the 1944 Crimean offensive operation.<cr>The army was withdrawn to the Reserve of the Supreme High Command (Stavka Reserve) on 20 May and relocated to the area of Polotsk and Vitebsk in Belarus. As part of the 1st Baltic Front it participated in operations clearing Latvia and Lithuania - the Baltic Offensive. After regrouping in September 1944, the 51st Army attacked westward in October, reaching the Baltic coast north of Memel, and with other 1st Baltic Front armies, definitively cut off Army Group North in Courland, where the German force would remain for the rest of the war. Thereafter, 51st Army took up position on the far western flank of the Soviet forces arrayed against Army Group North (later renamed Army Group Courland). Of the six major battles for Courland, 51st Army's only real progress was during the first Courland battle, from 15-22 October 1944, in which the army pushed some ten kilometers north against bitter resistance of the German III. SS-Panzerkorps. Thereafter, the front lines in this area of the Courland front changed little.<cr><cr>
translation: 该集团军于1941年8月14日在克里米亚组建，基于第9步兵军和其他部队编成第51独立集团军，任务是保卫克里米亚半岛。11月，该集团军从塔曼半岛撤出，并加入高加索方面军。该集团军参加了1941年12月至1942年1月的刻赤-费奥多西亚登陆行动。<cr>1942年5月8日，德军对方面军发动攻势。此次攻势于1942年5月18日左右结束，苏联守备部队几乎被完全消灭。三个集团军（第44、47和51集团军）、21个师、176,000人、347辆坦克以及近3,500门火炮损失殆尽。<cr>撤出后，第51集团军加入库班的北高加索方面军。7月，布琼尼元帅接到命令将南方面军和北高加索方面军合并为单一部队，并保留北高加索方面军的名称，第51集团军加入了该方面的顿河群。<cr>作为斯大林格勒方面军的一部分（从1942年8月1日至5日），然后短暂加入东南方面军（从8月6日至9月27日），最后再次回到斯大林格勒方面军，参加了斯大林格勒战役。1943年1月30日，德国空军第51轰炸机联队摧毁了位于萨尔斯基附近的第51集团军司令部。<cr>投放了100-250公斤的炸弹，一波容克斯Ju 88和亨克尔He 111飞机摧毁了通信中心、参谋长办公室、作战指挥部以及作战值班官办公室。多达20栋建筑和人员宿舍也被摧毁。<cr>人员伤亡也非常惨重。1943年1月以后，作为南方方面军的一部分，该集团军参加了罗斯托夫、顿巴斯（1943年8月至9月）、梅利托波尔（1943年9月至11月）和1944年的克里米亚进攻行动。<cr>第51集团军于1943年10月20日成为第四乌克兰方面军。该集团军于1944年5月20日撤至最高统帅部预备队，并被重新部署到白俄罗斯波洛茨克和维捷布斯克地区。<cr>作为第一巴尔干方面军的一部分，它参与了清除拉脱维亚和立陶宛的作战行动——巴尔干进攻。1944年9月重组后，第51集团军于10月向西发起攻击，到达梅梅尔以北的波罗的海沿岸，并与其他第一巴尔干方面军一起，最终切断了北方集团军群在库尔兰地区的联系，在那里德军将一直驻守到战争结束。<cr>此后，第51集团军占据了苏联部队对抗北方集团军群（后改名为库尔兰集团军群）最西端的阵线。在库尔兰地区进行的六次主要战役中，第51集团军唯一真正的进展是在第一次库尔兰战役期间，即1944年10月15日至22日，在此期间该集团军向北推进了约10公里，面对德意志第三党卫装甲师（骷髅）的顽强抵抗。此后，这一地区的库尔兰战线几乎没有变化。<cr>

text:
The 51st Guards Rifle Division was created from the 76th Rifle Division on November 23, 1942.<cr><cr>The newly renamed Division was sent back to Stalingrad where it helped encircle and trap the attacking German 6th and 4th Panzer Armies during Operaton Uranus. For its participation in the Battle of Stalingrad, the unit was decorated with the Order of Lenin. In the summer of 1943, it was sent to complement tanks and other armored vehicles during the Battle of Kursk in Ukraine, once again retaking the cities of Belgorod and Bogodouqovye. From Kursk, the division was sent northward to push back German Army Groups Center and North. Under the command General Ivan Bagramyan, the 1st Baltic Front commander, it liberated the Belorussian cities of Vitebsk and Polotski. Continuing its advance to the west, the 51st Guards Division took part in pushing Army Group North out of the former Soviet republics the Soviet Union had annexed in 1940, Latvia and Lithuania.

Its sacrifice and courage in recapturing Vitebsk were recognized as it was bestowed with the honorary title of Vitebskyan in October 1944. In the Latvian province of the Courland Peninsula was the final bastion of Army Group Courland. Despite repeated attempts to take the region, the German units resisted and successfully fended off Red Army offensives. In May 1945, the 51st Division was sent to Courland where it managed to isolate the forces remaining at the peninsula.<cr><cr>
translation:
第51近卫步兵师于1942年11月23日由第76步兵师改编而成。该重新命名的师被派往斯大林格勒，在天王星行动中帮助包围并困住了进攻的德军第6集团军和第4装甲集团军。<cr>由于在斯大林格勒战役中的表现，该部队获得了列宁勋章。<cr>1943年夏天，它被派往乌克兰参与库尔斯克会战，支援坦克和其他装甲车辆作战，并再次收复了别尔哥罗德和波戈杜霍夫耶两座城市。<cr>从库尔斯克出发后，该师向北推进，协助击退中央集团军群和北方集团军群的德军。<cr>在第1巴伦支方面军司令伊万·巴格拉米扬将军的指挥下，它解放了白俄罗斯境内的维捷布斯克和波洛茨克两座城市。<cr>继续向西推进时，第51近卫步兵师参与了将北方集团军群逐出苏联于1940年吞并的前拉脱维亚共和国和立陶宛共和国的行动。

该师在收复维捷布斯克过程中所作出的牺牲与勇气得到了认可，在1944年10月被授予“维捷布斯克”这一荣誉称号。<cr>在库尔兰半岛上的拉脱维亚省份，德军集团军群的最后一道堡垒仍然存在。尽管多次尝试夺取该地区，但德国部队顽强抵抗并成功击退了红军的进攻。<cr>1945年5月，第51步兵师被派往库尔兰，在那里它设法将半岛上剩余的德军孤立起来。

text: The corps was part of Ural Military District at the outbreak of hostilities and was assigned to the newly-formed 22nd Army on June 25th 1941. At that time, it consisted of 98th, 112th, and 170th Rifle Divisions. It moved to the Velikie Luki area and was destroyed there in August. Reformed in July 1942, it participated in the Battle of Kalach. In September 1943, it was assigned to 38th Army and fought in the Second Battle of Kiev. At that time, it consisted of 167th, 180th, 232nd, 240th and 340th Rifle Divisions. It was assigned to 1st Ukrainian Front in January 1944 and fought in Ukraine and the Dniepr-Carpathian Offensive. <cr><cr>Poirier, Robert and Conner, Albert, The Red Army Order of Battle in the Great Patriotic War, Presidio Press, 1985<cr><cr>Entry contributed by Stewart King
translation: 该军在冲突爆发时隶属于乌拉尔军区，并于1941年6月25日被分配给新成立的第22集团军。当时，它包括第98、第112和第170步兵师。该军转移到维捷布斯克地区并在八月份被消灭。该军在1942年7月重建，并参加了卡拉萨战役。1943年9月，该军被分配给第38集团军，并参加了第二次基辅战役。当时，它包括第167、第180、第232、第240和第340步兵师。该军于1944年1月被分配给第1乌克兰方面军，并在乌克兰以及第聂伯-喀尔巴阡进攻战役中作战。<cr>参考文献：Poirier, Robert and Conner, Albert, 红军战斗序列：伟大卫国战争，Presidio Press, 1985<cr>词条由Stewart King提供

text: The 51st Rifle Division was an infantry division of the Soviet Army, formed twice. Its first formation was formed during the Russian Civil War and fought in the Perekop-Chongar Offensive in 1920. It also fought in the Soviet invasion of Poland, Winter War and World War II. During World War II, it fought in the Battle of Rostov, Barvinkove-Losowaja Operation and Second Battle of Kharkov before being destroyed at the Battle of Voronezh. Officially disbanded on 28 November 1942, the division was reformed on 15 April 1943 from the 15th Rifle Brigade. The 2nd formation fought in Operation Bagration and the Battle of Knigsberg. The division was formally disbanded in 1946.<cr><cr><cr><cr> Entry courtesy of NotOneStepBack

The 51st Tank Division was formed February-March 1941 in Orel Military District as part of 23rd Mechanized Corps with:<cr>
101st Tank Regiment
1st, 2nd Tank Bns - each 30 to 40 light tanks
102nd Tank Regiment
2st, 2nd Tank Bns - each 30 to 40 light tanks
51st Motorized Rifle Regiment
1st, 2nd, 3rd bns
5lst Howitzer Regiment<cr>1 light bn
51st Reconnaissance Battalion
51st Motorized Pontoon Battalion
51st Antiaircraft Battalion<cr>
Like 48th Tank Division, 51st Tank Division was formed with a low priority for equipment and personnel, and had almost no time for training of any kind before being sent into battle in early July. text: The 52nd Army was created on 25 August 1941 from the headquarters of the 25th Rifle Corps and defended north of Novgorod. On 26 September 1941, the 52nd Army headquarters was used to form the 4th Army (II Formation). The 52nd Army headquarters was reestablished on 28 September 1941. In May 1943, the army was moved to control of the Reserve of the Supreme High Command (Stavka Reserve). Stavka released the 52nd Army to subordination of the Steppe Front in July 1943, and the 52nd Army thereafter fought in the Ukraine, southern Poland, southeastern Germany, and finally in northern Czechoslovakia.<cr> The army took part in the following operations:<cr>1941, theTikhvin Defensive Operation. <cr>1942, the Tikhvin Offensive and Lyuban Offensive Operations.<cr>1943, the Chernigov-Poltava and Cherkassy Offensive's.<cr>1944, the Kirovograd, KorsunShevchenkovsky, Uman-Botoshany Offensive's and Iassy-Kishinev Operation.<cr>1945, the SandomierzSilesian, Lower Silesian, Berlin (including the Battle of Bautzen) and Prague Offensive's.<cr>On 3 April 1945 the 52nd Army comprised the 7th Guards Mechanised Corps, the 48th Rifle Corps (116th and 294th Rifle Divisions), the 73rd Rifle Corps (50th, 111th and 254th Rifle Divisions) and the 78th Rifle Corps (31st, 214th and 373rd Rifle Divisions), the 213th Rifle Division, the 214th Tank Regiment, two artillery units, and service units.<cr>At the beginning of the Battle of Bautzen, on April 21, 1945, the Germans drove in between the Polish 2nd Army and the 52nd Army around Bautzen, some 40 kilometers (25 mi) north-east of Dresden and 25 kilometers (16 mi) west of Grlitz, sweeping the Soviet units of the 48th Rifle Corps, and driving towards Spremberg. Major General M. K. Puteiko, commander of the 52nd Army's 254th Rifle Division of the 73rd Rifle Corps was mortally wounded around Bautzen. Subsequently, the 52nd Army took part in the advance on Prague with the 1st Ukrainian Front.<cr><cr>
translation:
第52集团军成立于1941年8月25日，由第25步兵军司令部组建，并在诺夫哥罗德以北进行防御。1941年9月26日，第52集团军司令部被用于组建第4集团军（第二次编成）。第52集团军司令部于1941年9月28日重新建立。1943年5月，该集团军转由最高统帅部预备队指挥。1943年7月，最高统帅部将第52集团军交由顿河方面军管辖，此后该集团军参加了乌克兰、波兰南部、德国东南部以及最终捷克斯洛伐克北部的战斗。

该集团军参与了以下作战行动：
1941年：蒂霍文防御战役。
1942年：蒂霍文进攻战役和柳班进攻战役。
1943年：切尔尼戈夫-波尔塔瓦和切尔卡瑟进攻战役。
1944年：基洛夫格勒、科尔松谢夫琴科夫斯基、乌曼-博托沙尼进攻战役以及伊萨克-奇什尼亚克行动。
1945年：桑多梅日西里西亚、下西里西亚、柏林（包括包岑之战）和布拉格进攻战役。

1945年4月3日，第52集团军编成如下：
第7近卫机械化军司令部
第48步兵军（第116师和第294师）
第73步兵军（第50师、第111师和第254师）
第78步兵军（第31师、第214师和第373师）
第213步兵师
第214坦克团
两个炮兵单位
后勤保障部队1945年4月21日，布楚拉战役开始时，德军在布楚拉东北约40公里（25英里）、德累斯顿东北约25公里（16英里）处，在波兰第2集团军和第52集团军之间楔入，扫荡了苏联第48步兵军的部队，并向施雷姆贝格推进。第73步兵军下属第52集团军的第254步兵师师长M.K.普特耶科少校在布楚拉附近重伤。随后，第52集团军参加了第一乌克兰方面军进攻布拉格的行动。<cr><cr><cr><cr>

text:
The 52nd Cavalry Division was one of the first cavalry divisions formed after the start of the war. The unit was formed at Novocherkassk in the North Caucasus Military District likely from the reservists and cavalry depots in the district's cavalry training grounds.<cr><cr>The division was rushed to the front less than two weeks after being formed. It arrived in the 21st Army by the middle of July and was assigned to the Kuliev Cavalry Group under the command of the 21st Mountain Cavalry Division's commander. By August the division was assigned to the Central Front's 13th Army. The division was brushed aside by the 2nd Panzer Group as it turned south towards Kiev in September.

When the German attack on Moscow began the division was in Bryansk Front reserves in Ermakov's Operation Group (a mixed unit of cavalry, tank brigade, motorized divisions). The group was quickly disbanded and the division was used as a mobile reserve in the 13th or 3rd Armies on the southern flank of the German advance on Tula. Assigned to the 8th Cavalry Corps on 15 January. The units assigned to the corps were so depleted upon their assignment the corps was not committed during the winter counter-offensive in 1942. On 13 March 1942 the division was officially disbanded to provide replacements and reinforcements for other units.<cr><cr>
translation:
第52骑兵师是在战争开始后不久组建的第一批骑兵师之一。该部队可能由北高加索军区的预备役人员和骑兵补给站组成，于诺沃切尔卡斯克成立。<cr>该师在组建不到两周后就被紧急调往前线，7月中旬抵达第21集团军，并被分配到库利耶夫骑兵群，由第21山地骑兵师的指挥官领导。8月，该师被分配给中央方面军的第13集团军。<cr>9月，该师被第2装甲集群轻易击溃，后者转向南面进攻基辅。

当德国发动对莫斯科的攻击时，该师位于布良斯克方面军预备队中，在阿尔马科夫行动群（一个由骑兵、坦克旅和摩托化师组成的混合部队）内。该行动群很快被解散，该师被用作第13或第3集团军在图拉南线德军推进中的机动预备队。<cr>于1942年1月15日分配给第8骑兵军。由于这些单位的兵力严重不足，在冬季反攻期间（1942年）该军没有被投入战斗。<cr>1942年3月13日，该师正式解散，为其他部队提供补充兵员。

text: The 52nd Infantry Division was on occupation duty in France until June 1941, when it was sent to Army Group Center in Russia. The 52nd remained on the line for more than two years, fighting at Bobruisk, Bryansk, and Moscow, against the Soviet winter offensive of 1941-42, and at Juchnow, Spass-Demensk, Orel, and Nevel before suffering such heavy losses in the defensive Battle of Smolensk in the fall of 1943 that it had to be withdrawn. (Meanwhile, each third grenadier battalion was disbanded due to heavy casualties.)<cr>Instead of rebuilding the 52nd as an infantry division, the High Command of the Army decided to convert it into a field training unit, and it was stripped of most of its artillery. On December 3, 1943, it was formally redesignated a field training division. It now consisted of the 565th, 566th, and 567th Grenadier Regiments (two battalions each) and a handful of division support units. (Its tank destroyer battalion, for example, had been reduced to a company.) The 52nd was stationed in White Ruthenia from November 1943 to June 1944. On April 12, 1944, the division was disbanded as a combat unit. The divisional staff, however, was transferred to Army Group North, where it was redesignated 52nd Security Division and controlled the 57th, 89th, and 611th Security Regiments in the Baltic States. In April 1945 it became Fortress Command Libau as part of the 18th Army's reserve. It surrendered to the Red Army in May 1945.<cr><cr>German Order of Battle Vol I 1st - 290th Infantry Divisions in WWII, Samuel W. Mitcham Jr.
translation:
第52步兵师在法国驻防直到1941年6月，之后被调往中央集团军群参加俄罗斯战役。该师在前线坚守了两年多时间，在鲍里斯拉夫、布良斯克和莫斯科等地作战，并抵御苏联的冬季攻势（1941-1942）。它还参加了尤赫诺沃、斯帕斯-德梅内茨、奥廖尔和涅韦尔地区的战斗，直到在1943年秋季的斯摩棱斯克防御战中遭受重大损失而不得不撤出。在此期间，每个掷弹兵营都因伤亡惨重而被解散。

高级指挥部没有重建第52师作为步兵师，而是将其改造成野战训练单位，并削减了大部分炮兵部队。1943年12月3日，该师正式更名为野战训练师。此时它由第565、566和567掷弹兵团（每个团两个营）以及少量支援单位组成。（例如它的歼击坦克营被缩减为一个连）。从1943年11月至1944年6月，该师驻扎在白俄罗斯。1944年4月12日，该师作为战斗部队解散。

然而，其指挥部被转移到北方集团军群，并重新命名为第52治安师，控制着波罗的海地区的第57、89和611治安团。1945年4月，它成为第18集团军预备队中的利巴瓦要塞指挥所。该师于1945年5月向红军投降。

text: At the outbreak of hostilities, the corps was part of 24th Army and consisted of 91st, 119th, and 166th Rifle Divisions. It served as the cadre for the formation of 30th Army in July 1941. Reformed in July 1943, it participated in the Lvov-Sandomierz Operation in July 1944, at which time it consisted of the 117th Guards Rifle and 24th and 395th Rifle Divisions. text: The Western Rifle Division was a Red Army infantry division that served during the Russian Civil War. The division also served between the Civil War and World War II as the 52nd Rifle Division. After the first formation of the division was promoted to Guards status as the 10th Guards Rifle Division in late December, 1941, a second formation of the division fought on for the duration in several Fronts. At the outbreak of the German invasion in 1941, the 52nd was in the far north, near Murmansk. 25 June 1941, the 158th and 112th regiments were transferred by sea to the 14th Rifle Division. Due to its skill in defending vital port of Murmansk the 52nd Rifle Division became one of the first and few formations raised to Guards status in the Arctic, as the 10th Guards Rifle Division on Dec. 26. The division remained in that region until late 1944, when it was transferred to 2nd Belorussian Front and took part in the invasion of Germany.<cr><cr><cr><cr> Entry courtesy of NotOneStepBack
translation: 西部步兵师是红军的一个步兵师，参加了俄罗斯内战。该师还在内战和第二次世界大战之间作为第52步兵师服役。在1941年12月底，第一支编队晋升为近卫部队，成为第10近卫步兵师；第二支编队则继续战斗，在多个方面军中作战。1941年德国入侵爆发时，第52步兵师位于北方的摩尔曼斯克附近。<cr>1941年6月25日，第158团和第112团被海运至第14步兵师。<cr>由于在保卫至关重要的摩尔曼斯克港口方面表现出色，第52步兵师成为北极地区首批少数几个晋升为近卫部队的编队之一，在1941年12月26日升格为第10近卫步兵师。该师一直驻扎在这一区域直到1944年底，之后被调至第二白俄罗斯方面军，并参与了入侵德国的行动。<cr>条目由NotOneStepBack提供

text:
The 52nd Tank Divison was formed February-March 1941 in North Caucasus Military District as part of 26th Mechanized Corps with:<cr>
104th Tank Regiment
105th Tank Regiment
- combined total 2 tank bns with 30 to 40 light tanks each
52nd Motorized Rifle Regiment
1st, 2nd, 3rd bns
52nd Howitzer Regiment
1 light bn
52nd Reconnaissance Battalion
52nd Motorized Pontoon Battalion
52nd Antiaircraft Battalion<cr>
The 26th Mechanized Corps and all of its components were so unready that the corps was left behind when the rest of the North Caucasus Military District was mobilized in May and sent west as 19th Army. With less than 80 tanks in the entire division, and short of every other kind of equipment, personnel, and training as well, 52nd Tank Division went into combat in early July with 24th Army. It disintegrated almost immediately: while some of the equipment and personnel may have reinforced other units, the 52nd Tank Division lasted less than 3 weeks in the Soviet order of battle!<cr><cr>Soviet Order of Battle Volume I by Charles C. Sharp

第52坦克师成立于1941年2月至3月，在北高加索军区作为第26机械化军的一部分组建，包括：
104坦克团
105坦克团
- 合计拥有两个坦克营，每个营装备30至40辆轻型坦克

由于第26机械化军及其所有组成部分都未就绪，当北高加索军区在5月动员其余部队并将其编入第19集团军西进时，该机械化军被留在原地。整个师仅有不到80辆坦克，并且其他装备、人员和训练也严重不足。第52坦克师于7月初随第24集团军投入战斗，几乎立即瓦解：尽管部分装备和人员可能补充了其他部队，但第52坦克师在苏联战斗序列中仅存续不到3周！

《苏联战斗序列 第一卷》查尔斯·C·夏普著

text: The 52nd Torino Italian Motorized Division was formed from an expansion of the Torino Brigade in June 1940. It participated in the invasion of Yugoslavia in early 1941 and was sent to the Eastern Front as part of the Italian Expeditionary Corps in July and August of 1941. The division was classified as 'semi-motorized' which met in practice its transport was a mixture of commerical vehicles (commerical logos intact) that had been pressed into service. The Expeditionary Corps was initially attached to the German 11th Army. Between October 20th and November 2nd 1941 it participated in the assualt on Stalino. The July 1942 the Italians forces in Russia were substantially increased with the arrival of the Italian 8th Army to which the division was now subordinated. The 8th Army, stretched along a 160 mile section of the Don River between the Hungarian Second Army and Romanian 3rd Army on the German left flank was largely destroyed in March 1943 during Operation Little Saturn. The survivors returned to Italy and the division was disbanded by the Germans in September 1943 after Italy's surrender.<cr><cr><cr><cr>Entry courtesy Chris Munson
translation:
第52摩托化托里诺师于1940年6月由扩编的托里诺旅组建而成。该师参加了1941年初入侵南斯拉夫的行动，并在同年7月至8月作为意大利远征军被派往东线战场。该师被划分为“半摩托化”，实际上其运输工具是由多种商用车辆（保留了原始标志）拼凑起来的。最初，远征军隶属于德国第11集团军。从1941年10月20日至11月2日，该师参加了对斯塔林诺的进攻行动。1942年7月，随着意大利第8集团军的到来，驻俄意军得到了大幅加强，并且该师现在隶属于第8集团军。第8集团军沿顿河长达160英里的地段部署，在匈牙利第2集团军和罗马尼亚第3集团军之间，位于德军左翼。在1943年3月的“小土星行动”中，第8集团军大部分被消灭。幸存者返回意大利，该师于1943年9月因意大利投降而被德国解散。

<cr>词条由Chris Munson提供

text: At the outbreak of hostilities, the corps was part of 24th Army and consisted of 107th, 133rd, and 178th Rifle Divisions. It fought in the Yelnya Offensive in July-September 1941 and was disbanded in October. Reformed in May 1943, it consisted of the 96th and 369th Rifle Divisions. It was part of Bryansk Front and fought in the Battle of Kursk and the Bobruysk Offensive. <cr><cr>Poirier, Robert and Conner, Albert, The Red Army Order of Battle in the Great Patriotic War, Presidio Press, 1985<cr><cr>Entry contributed by Stewart King
translation: 在敌对行动爆发时，该军隶属于第24集团军，由第107步兵师、第133步兵师和第178步兵师组成。它参加了1941年7月至9月的叶尔尼亚攻势，并于10月被解散。在1943年5月重建后，该军由第96步兵师和第369步兵师组成。它是 Bryansk 方面军的一部分，参与了库尔斯克战役和鲍里斯波尔攻势。<cr>指挥官报告: Poirier, Robert 和 Conner, Albert, 红军二战战斗序列, Presidio Press, 1985<cr>条目由 Stewart King 贡献

text: The 53rd Rifle Division was an infantry division of the Soviet Union's Red Army, active during World War II. The division was formed in 1931. It was stationed in the Volga Military District. On 8 July 1937 it received the honorific 'named for Friedrich Engels'. Before the war it became part of the 21st Army in the Gomel Region of the Western Special Military District. The division fought at Yelnya, on the Dnieper River, at Uman and Targul Frumos. The division was with 46th Army of the 2nd Ukrainian Front in May 1945. The division was disbanded in late June 1946 in the Odessa Military District with the 34th Rifle Corps of the 40th Army.<cr><cr><cr><cr> Entry courtesy of NotOneStepBack
translation: 第53步兵师是苏联红军的一支步兵师，活跃于第二次世界大战期间。该师成立于1931年，并驻扎在伏尔加军区。1937年7月8日，它获得了“弗里德里希·恩格斯”荣誉称谓。战前，它成为西部特别军区戈梅利地区的第21集团军的一部分。该师参加了叶连纳、第聂伯河畔、乌曼和塔尔古勒夫鲁姆的战斗。1945年5月，该师隶属于乌克兰第二方面军的第46集团军。该师于1946年6月底在敖德萨军区解散，当时它属于第40集团军的第34步兵军。<cr>条目由NotOneStepBack提供<cr>

text:
The 53rd Tank Division was formed February - March 1941 near Tashkent in Central Asia Military District as part of 27th Mechanized Corps with:<cr>
106th Tank Regiment - 0 tanks
107th Tank Regiment - 0 tanks
53rd Motorized Rifle Regiment
1st, 2nd, 3rd bns
53rd Howitzer Regiment
1 light bn
53rd Reconnaissance Battalion
53rd Motorized Pontoon Battalion
53rd Antiaircraft Battalion<cr>
One could question whether to include this unit in a listing of divisions in the Soviet Army. Officially, the division was not even supposed to be activated until 1 July 1941. On 22 June it had no tanks, about 50% of its other vehicles, almost no other equipment, and very few personnel yet assigned. Since the unit had no experienced cadre, rather than use resources to build the it up, in early July 53rd Tank Division was combined with cadre from 9th Tank Division to form 104th Tank Division.<cr><cr>Soviet Order of Battle Volume I by Charles C. Sharp

可以质疑是否应该将此单位列入苏军师的列表中。官方上，该师甚至不应该在1941年7月1日之前被激活。6月22日时，它没有任何坦克，大约一半的其他车辆，几乎没有其他装备，并且人员非常少。由于该单位没有经验丰富的骨干力量，与其使用资源来加强它，第53坦克师于7月初与第9坦克师的骨干合并重组为第104坦克师。

text: The 541st Grenadier Division was formed in July 1944 as a Sperr (blocking) division as part of the 29th Wave. It was formed from the 1043rd - 1048th Kampf March Battalions. It consisted of the 1073rd, 1074th and 1075th Grenadier Regiments, 1541st Artillery Regiment and various support units. In October 1944 the division was designated a Volksgrenadier division as part of the 32nd Wave. In December 1944 the 1073rd Grenadier Regiment was disbanded and replaced by the former 931st Security Regiment. The division fought at Narev in Poland and was forced back into East Prussia in early 1945 where it remained until the end of the war.<cr><cr>George F. Nafziger, The German Order of Battle Infantry in World War II<cr>Samuel W. Mitcham, German Order of Battle Volume II: 291st-999th Infantry Divisions, Named Infantry Divisions, and Special Divisions in WWII<cr><cr>Entry courtesy Chris Munson
translation: 第541掷弹兵师于1944年7月作为阻击（封锁）部队组建，属于第29波。该师由第1043至1048战斗行军营组成，包括第1073、1074和1075掷弹兵团以及第1541炮兵团，并配有各种支援单位。1944年10月，该师被指定为国民掷弹兵师，属于第32波。1944年12月，第1073掷弹兵团解散，由原第931治安团取代。该师在波兰纳雷夫作战，并于1945年初被迫撤退到东普鲁士，直到战争结束。<cr>参考文献：George F. Nafziger, 《二战中的德国战斗序列：步兵》<cr>Samuel W. Mitcham, 《二战中的德军战斗序列 第二卷：第291至第999师、命名步兵师及其他特别部队》<cr>词条由Chris Munson提供

text: The 547th Grenadier Division was formed in July 1944 as a Sperr (blocking) division as part of the 29th Wave. It consisted of the 1091st, 1092nd and 1093rd Grenadier Regiments, 1547th Artillery Regiment and various support units. In October 1944 the division was designated a Volksgrenadier division as part of the 32nd Wave. In February 1945 the division was destroyed in East Prussia and the survivors sent to the 170th Infantry Division. The division was reformed in March 1945 with two regiments from the Hannover Shadow Division. The division was taken prisoner by the Americans near Schwerin.<cr><cr>George F. Nafziger, The German Order of Battle Infantry in World War III<cr><cr>Entry courtesy Chris Munson

text: The 54th Army was first formed in August, 1941, in the Leningrad Military District, to the east of the city in the vicinity of the town of Volkhov. 54th Army was under direct command of STAVKA, and on Zhukov's recommendations it was ordered into the attack on the 10th. This first attempt to break the blockade, the First Sinyavino Offensive, gained only 6 - 10km. during 16 days of on-and-off heavy fighting.<cr>A second attempt on Sinyavino was being prepared to start on Oct. 20, but was pre-empted by the German offensive towards Tikhvin on Oct. 16, which intended to encircle 54th Army on the way to cutting all possible supply routes to Leningrad and linking up with the Finnish Army. By Nov. 8, the entire German offensive had ground to a halt, due to Soviet resistance and the winter weather.<cr>Having liberated the territory occupied by the Germans in their Tikhvin offensive and caused them significant casualties, Stalin expected his armies to be able to break the siege of Leningrad, as part of a series of offensives across the front. The new offensive was launched by 54th Army on Jan. 4, 1942 when it once again attacked I Corps, to the west of Kirishi. Forty-eight hours of heavy fighting produced an advance of only 4 - 5km, after which a counterattack by 12th Panzer Division drove Fedyuninsky's troops back to their starting line. The attack was renewed on Jan. 13 and the village of Pogoste was taken on the 17th, but that was the limit of success.<cr>54th Army was only marginally involved in the Second Sinyavino Offensive during August - October, and was engaged in mostly local fighting through the balance of 1942.<cr>On January 12, 1943, the Leningrad and Volkhov Fronts launched Operation Iskra. The objective of 54th Army was to create a shallow encirclement, in conjunction with 55th Army from Leningrad, of the German forces still holding the Sinyavino - Mga area. The 54th was reinforced before the offensive, which it began on Feb. 10. Sukhomlin attacked the German 96th Infantry Division, but only managed to penetrate 3 - 4km on a 5km front in three days of heavy fighting. German reinforcements of small battlegroups from unengaged sectors brought the advance to a standstill. The front went back to relative inactivity for the remainder of 1943.<cr>On January 16, 1944, the 54th was launched as the third prong of a Soviet winter offensive. After six weeks of fighting, it had reached the Panther Line between Ostrov and Pskov. During March and the first half of April, the depleted armies of Leningrad and 2nd Baltic Fronts were ordered into repeated attacks against this line, with meagre results reached at high cost.<cr>During the following months 54th Army rebuilt its forces in anticipation of a summer offensive. This began to its south on June 22, with the launch of Operation Bagration. After the breaching of the Panther Line, 3rd Baltic Front was directed northwest both to retake Estonia and cut off retreating elements of Army Group North in the Tartu Offensive, and later the Riga Offensive. Although most of the German forces were able to escape (only to be bottled up in the Courland Pocket), the former objective was won. As these offensives drew to a close, it became apparent that 54th Army was no longer needed on a front that was contracting in length as it drew closer to Germany. Following the capture of Riga in mid-October, 3rd Baltic Front was disbanded, and 54th Army was removed to STAVKA reserves. On Dec. 13, Lt. Gen. Roginsky was placed in reserve; he would later briefly command 67th Army. On the last day of 1944, 54th Army was officially disbanded.<cr><cr>
translation: 第54集团军成立于1941年8月，在列宁格勒军区，位于城市以东的沃尔霍夫镇附近。该集团军直接受最高统帅部大本营指挥，并应朱可夫建议于10日发起攻击。这是第一次试图打破封锁的第一波希瓦诺夫攻势，在持续了16天断断续续的激烈战斗后，仅推进了6至10公里。<cr><cr>第二次对波希瓦诺夫的进攻原定于10月20日开始，但被德国人向季霍维纳发起的攻势提前打断。该攻势旨在包围第54集团军，并切断通往列宁格勒的所有可能补给路线，同时与芬兰军队会合。到11月8日，由于苏联抵抗和冬季天气的影响，整个德军攻势已陷入停滞。<cr><cr>斯大林期望他的部队能够通过一系列前线攻势打破对列宁格勒的封锁，并在德国人占领季霍维纳后造成重大伤亡。新的攻势由第54集团军于1942年1月4日发起，再次向西克里希什以西的第一军发动攻击。经过两天激烈的战斗，仅推进了4至5公里，随后被第12装甲师的反攻逼回原地。<cr><cr>该攻势在1月13日重新开始，并于17日占领了波戈斯特村，但这是成功的极限。<cr><cr>第54集团军只在第二次波希瓦诺夫攻势中略有参与，在8月至10月期间主要进行局部战斗。剩余的1942年时间里，该集团军继续进行大部分地方性的战斗。1943年1月12日，列宁格勒方面军和沃尔霍夫方面军发起了“火花”行动。第54集团军的目标是与来自列宁格勒的第55集团军协同作战，在辛亚维诺-姆加地区仍被德国部队占据的地方制造一个浅层包围圈。在进攻前，第54集团军得到了加强，并于2月10日开始进攻。苏霍米林攻击了德军第96步兵师，但在三天的激烈战斗中仅推进了3至4公里，在5公里宽的正面上。来自未被牵扯进战斗地区的德国小战斗群增援使得攻势停滞不前。直到1943年底，前线都回到了相对平静的状态。<cr>1944年1月16日，第54集团军作为苏军冬季攻势的第三支力量发起进攻。经过六周的战斗，它推进到了奥斯特罗夫和普斯科夫之间的豹式防线。3月及4月上半月期间，列宁格勒方面军和第二波罗的海方面军的兵力耗尽后被命令反复攻击这条防线，但以高昂代价仅取得微小成果。在接下来的几个月里，第54集团军重建了部队力量，为夏季攻势做准备。6月22日，巴格拉季昂行动在其南部开始。突破豹式防线后，波罗的海第三方面军向西北方向推进，在塔尔图攻势中收复爱沙尼亚并切断北方集团军群撤退中的部分兵力，并在后来的里加攻势中继续进攻。尽管大多数德军部队得以逃脱（仅被封锁在库尔兰包围圈内），但前者目标已经实现。随着这些攻势接近尾声，很明显第54集团军不再需要部署在一个长度不断缩短、越来越靠近德国的战线上。10月中旬占领里加以后，波罗的海第三方面军解散，第54集团军被调至最高统帅部大本营预备队。<cr>12月13日，罗金斯基中将进入预备状态；他后来曾短暂指挥过第67集团军。在1944年的最后一天，第54集团军正式解散。<cr> <cr>

text:
The 54th Guards Rifle Division was created on December 16, 1942 from the second formation of the 119th Rifle Division. It was assigned the honorific title of 'Guards' in recognition of that division's leading role in Operation Uranus, the breakthrough that led to the encirclement of the German/Romanian forces in Stalingrad, and the subsequent elimination of the 3rd Romanian Army.<cr>The 54th Guards was one of the first of many Guards rifle divisions created from the divisions that fought in the Battle of Stalingrad. When formed, its order of battle was as follows:

160th Guards Rifle Regiment from the 365th Rifle Regiment
162nd Guards Rifle Regiment from the 421st Rifle Regiment
163rd Guards Rifle Regiment from the 634th Rifle Regiment
125th Guards Artillery Regiment from the 349th Artillery Regiment
Guards Sapper Battalion from the 224th Sapper Battalion.<cr>
At the time of its formation the division it was serving in the 5th Tank Army of the Don Front. Later in the Stalingrad campaign it was transferred to various armies of the Southwestern Front. In February 1943 it was in the 18th Rifle Corps of the 3rd Guards Army and in the spring was reassigned to the 3rd Guards Rifle Corps, where it remained for the duration.<cr>The 54th Guards Division, along this its corps, was soon reassigned to the Southern Front (renamed 4th Ukrainian Front on October 20, 1943) and served there for the next 12 months, mostly as part of the 5th Shock Army. It campaigned through the Donbass, southern Ukraine, and finally across the Dnepr River in October 1943. During that time, the division was credited with the liberation of the town of Makeevka in eastern Ukraine, and was given its name as an honorific. After the advance ground to a halt along the Dniester River in the spring of 1944, the division was withdrawn into the Stavka Reserve, and after rebuilding was reassigned to the 28th Army of the 1st Ukrainian Front. During this rebuilding, the division became one of the first rifle divisions to have its towed anti-tank gun battalion replaced with a battalion of SU-76 self-propelled guns.<cr>With its Army, the 54th Guards drove into central Poland in the summer, and in early 1945 moved into Latvia to help mop up the German forces there. Following this, the 28th Army was shifted back across Poland, to join the 1st Ukrainian Front's offensive into Czechoslovakia in early May. The division ended the war near Prague. By this time the division had the following honorifics: Makeevka, Order of Lenin, Order of the Red Banner, Order of Suvorov, Order of Kutuzov).<cr><cr>
translation:
第54近卫步兵师于1942年12月16日从第119步兵师的第二次组建中成立。为了表彰该师在天王星行动中的先锋作用，即突破并包围了斯大林格勒地区的德国/罗马尼亚部队，并随后消灭了罗马尼亚第三集团军，授予其“近卫”荣誉称号。<cr>第54近卫步兵师是众多从参加斯大林格勒战役的步兵师中组建的近卫步兵师之一。成立时，其战斗序列为：

第160近卫步兵团（原属第365步兵师）
第162近卫步兵团（原属第421步兵师）
第163近卫步兵团（原属第634步兵师）
第125近卫炮兵团（原属第349炮兵师）
近卫工兵营（原属第224工兵营）。<cr>
该师组建时隶属于顿河方面军的第5坦克集团军。在斯大林格勒战役期间，它被转移到西南方面军的不同集团军中。1943年2月，它隶属第3近卫集团军下的第18步兵军，并于春季转隶至第3近卫步兵军，在那里一直待到战争结束。<cr>
第54近卫师及其所属的军很快被重新分配给南方方面军（该方面军在1943年10月20日改名为第4乌克兰方面军），并在接下来的一年内在那里服役，主要隶属于第5突击集团军。它参加了顿巴斯、南部乌克兰以及最终于1943年10月渡过第聂伯河的战役。在此期间，该师因解放了乌克兰东部的马伊斯基镇而获得荣誉称号。当进攻在1944年春季沿着德涅斯特河停滞不前时，该师被调入最高统帅部预备队，并在重建后重新分配给第1乌克兰方面军下的第28集团军。在此期间，该师成为首批用SU-76自行火炮营替换拖曳式反坦克炮兵营的步兵师之一。<cr>54近卫集团军在夏季进军波兰中部，1945年初进入拉脱维亚协助肃清当地的德军。之后，第28集团军被调回波兰，加入1月的乌克兰方面军对捷克斯洛伐克的进攻。该师战至接近布拉格的地方。此时，该师获得了以下荣誉称号：马耶夫卡、列宁勋章、红旗勋章、苏沃罗夫勋章、库图佐夫勋章。<cr><cr>

text: The 54th Rifle Division was an infantry division of the Soviet Union's Red Army and Soviet Army, formed twice. The division was formed in 1936 and fought in the Winter War. The division spent most of World War II in Karelia fighting with Finnish troops in the Continuation War. After Finland left the war the division was relocated southward and fought in the East Prussian Offensive and the Prague Offensive in 1945. The division was disbanded in the summer of that year. The 54th Rifle Division was awarded the Order of Lenin, the Order of the Red Banner and the Order of Kutuzov 2nd class. It was also awarded the honorific 'Masuria' for its actions in the East Prussian Offensive.<cr><cr><cr><cr> Entry courtesy of NotOneStepBack
translation: 第54步兵师是苏联红军和苏军中的一支步兵师，曾两次组建。该师成立于1936年，并参加了冬季战争。在第二次世界大战期间，该师大部分时间都在卡累利阿与芬兰军队一起作战，在继续战争中并肩战斗。当芬兰退出战争后，该师被南迁，并参与了1945年的东普鲁士进攻和布拉格攻势。该师于当年夏季解散。第54步兵师荣获列宁勋章、红旗勋章以及库图佐夫二级勋章。<cr>此外，由于在东普鲁士进攻中的表现，该师获得了“马祖里”荣誉称号。<cr>条目由NotOneStepBack提供

text: The 551st Grenadier Division was formed in July 1944 as a Sperr (blocking) division as part of the 29th Wave. It consisted of the 1113rd, 1114th and 1115th Grenadier Regiments, 1551st Artillery Regiment and various support units. In October 1944 the division was designated a Volksgrenadier division as part of the 32nd Wave. The division fought in East Prussia where it was destroyed by the Russians in January 1945.<cr><cr>George F. Nafziger, The German Order of Battle Infantry in World War III<cr><cr>Entry courtesy Chris Munson
translation: 第551掷弹兵师于1944年7月作为阻击（封锁）部队组建，属于第29波。该师包括第1113团、第1114团和第1115掷弹兵团，第1551炮兵团以及各种支援单位。1944年10月，该师被指定为国民掷弹兵师，属于第32波。该师在东普鲁士作战，在1945年1月被俄国人消灭。<cr>指挥官报告: George F. Nafziger, 《德国战斗序列：二战中的步兵》<cr><cr>-<cr>克里斯·芒森提供

text: The 551st Grenadier Division was formed in July 1944 as a Sperr (blocking) division as part of the 29th Wave. It consisted of the 1122nd, 1123rd and 1124th Grenadier Regiments, 1558th Artillery Regiment and various support units. In October 1944 the division was designated a Volksgrenadier division as part of the 32nd Wave. The division was part of the LV Corps in April 1945 when it was captured by the Russians near Pillau..<cr><cr>George F. text: The 55th Army was formed on 1 September 1941 as part of the Leningrad Front. It was formed from the Task Force of Major General I.G. Lazarev and the 19th Rifle Corps headquarters. The army fought in the Leningrad Strategic Defensive Operation. At the time, it was the largest of the four armies defending Leningrad, with up to half of the active formations. Using the defenses of the Slutsk-Kolpino Fortified Area, the army defended Leningrad's southern approaches in the area of Kolpino, Krasnogvardeysk, Zaborje, Vyritsa, the Izhora River and the Tosna River. Its units stopped the German advance at Putrolovo, Bolshoye Kuzmino, Novaya and Verkhneye Kuzmino. From October 1941 to December 1942, the army carried out local offensives to improve its positions. In November, Vladimir Sviridov replaced Lazarev. On 20 December the army began an attack at Mga, later joined by the 54th Army, to distract from the upcoming Lyuban Offensive Operation but was unsuccessful. On 23 July 1942 a rifle division and a tank brigade of the army attacked the SS Polizei Division south of Kolpino. The attack made some gains. On 26 September elements of two of the army's rifle divisions were sent across the Neva to reinforce the encircled 8th Army. After losing two of three bridgeheads, the 55th Army units withdrew across the Neva.<cr>In February 1943, the army fought in the Battle of Krasny Bor. The army was the left pincer of the offensive and was to attack out of Kolpino and destroy the Blue Division at Krasny Bor, then advance southeast to Tosno. A division-size attack on 8 February forced several Blue Division outposts back. On 10 February, the 55th Army attacked simultaneously with the 54th Army. The 55th Army attacked along a front of 14 kilometers, concentrating three rifle division and a tank brigade against one regiment of the Blue Division. The Soviet troops broke through the Spanish line and the army's 63rd Guards Rifle Division advanced into and captured Krasny Bor. On the army's left, its 43rd Rifle Division attacked a regiment of the SS Polizei Division, but was unable to advance. German reinforcements arrived and formed a new defensive line south of Krasny Bor, stopping the advance of the 55th Army. The army brought up its tank units and resumed the offensive towards Mishkino on 17 February but was again repulsed by Tiger tanks of Panzer-Abteilung 502. During the offensive, the army advanced five kilometers and suffered more than 10,000 casualties. The army inflicted 3,645 casualties on the Blue Division. On 19 March, the army attacked again in conjunction with the 8th Army, but was forced to retreat by counterattacks from Legion Flandern and Panzer-Abteilung 502. On 25 December 1943, the army was combined with the 67th Army.<cr><cr>
translation: 第55集团军成立于1941年9月1日，隶属于列宁格勒方面军。该集团军由伊·加·拉扎列夫少将的特遣部队和第19步兵军司令部组建而成。它参加了列宁格勒战略防御行动，在当时是保卫列宁格勒的四个集团军中最大的一个，拥有最多半数的现役编制单位。利用斯卢茨克-科尔平诺要塞区的防御工事，该集团军在科尔平诺、克拉斯诺瓦尔代斯克、扎博日耶、维里特萨、伊热奥河和托斯纳河地区保卫了列宁格勒南部方向的安全。其部队在普图罗洛沃、大库兹明诺、新库兹明诺和上库兹明诺阻止了德国军队的推进。从1941年10月到1942年12月，该集团军进行了局部进攻以改善自身位置。11月，弗拉基米尔·斯维里多夫接替了拉扎列夫。12月20日，该集团军开始在姆加发动攻击，并于稍后与第54集团军联合行动，试图分散即将进行的柳班攻势的注意力，但未成功。1942年7月23日，该集团军的一个步兵师和一个坦克旅向科尔平诺南部的党卫军警察师发起了进攻，取得了一些进展。9月26日，两个步兵师的部分兵力被派过涅瓦河以增援被包围的第8集团军。在失去其中两个桥头堡后，第55集团军部队撤过了涅瓦河。<cr>1943年2月，该集团军参加了克拉斯尼博罗战役。作为进攻的左翼钳形部队，该集团军从科尔平诺出发攻击蓝师，并在克拉斯尼博罗消灭了蓝师，然后向托斯诺东南方向推进。2月8日的一次师级规模攻击迫使蓝师的几个前哨后撤。2月10日，第55集团军与第54集团军同时发起进攻。第55集团军在长达14公里的正面上集中了3个步兵师和一个坦克旅的力量，对蓝师的一个团发动攻势。苏军突破了西班牙防线，并由该集团军的第63近卫步兵师占领克拉斯尼博罗。在其左翼，其第43步兵师攻击党卫军警察师的一个团，但未能推进。德军增援部队抵达并在克拉斯尼博罗以南形成新的防御线，阻止了第55集团军的进攻。该集团军调动坦克部队，并于2月17日重新发起对米什金诺方向的攻势，但再次被党卫军装甲团502的虎式坦克击退。在此次攻势中，该集团军推进了五公里并遭受超过一万人的伤亡。该集团军给蓝师造成了3645人的伤亡。3月19日，该集团军与第8集团军协同发起进攻，但被迫撤退以应对利格尼昂法兰德斯和党卫军装甲团502的反攻。1943年12月25日，该集团军与第67集团军合并。<cr><cr><cr>

text:
The 55th Guards Rifle Division was formed on 12/18/1942 by converting the 30th Rifle Division

It was in battle from 18.12.1942 to 21.04.1944 from 28.05.1944 to 14.09.1944 from 13.10.1944 to 31.03.1945 from 20.04.1945 to 11.05.1945 year.

It took part in the liberation of North Caucasus and the Taman Peninsula. In November 1943, participated in the Kerch-Eltigen Operaton, landing on the beach in Danger, Yenikale, fighting on the Kerch Peninsula until April 1944, then participated in the Belorussian Offensive by helping in the liberation of Ivanovo and Luninets areas Brest Region of Pinsk and Logishin district Pinsk area, eastern Poland, in East Prussian, Berlin and Prague offensive operations.

The division participated in the liberation of the city Novorossiysk, Kerch, Pinsk, taking Gumbinenn and Berlin.

With 28th Army of the 1st Ukrainian Front in May 1945.<cr><cr>
translation:
第55近卫步兵师于1942年12月18日由改编第30步兵师而成

该师自1942年12月18日至1944年4月21日、1944年5月28日至1944年9月14日、1944年10月13日至1945年3月31日以及1945年4月20日至1945年5月11日期间参战。

该师参与了北高加索和塔曼半岛的解放行动。1943年11月，参加了刻赤-埃利季行动，在危险地带（叶尼卡莱）登陆，并在克里米亚半岛战斗至1944年4月，随后参加白俄罗斯进攻战役，协助解放了伊万诺沃和卢宁内茨地区的别雷地区、皮斯基区的皮斯克地区以及波兰东部。该师还参加了东普鲁士、柏林和布拉格的攻势作战。

该师参与了解放新罗西斯克市、刻赤市、皮斯克市，并占领了贡宾嫩和柏林的任务。

1945年5月，隶属于第28集团军（第一乌克兰方面军）<cr><cr><cr><cr>

text: Part of the Kiev Military District at the outbreak of the war, the corps consisted of the 130th, 169th, and 189th Rifle Divisions. Destroyed in the Kiev Pocket, it was reformed in January 1944 as part of 51st Army. At that time, it consisted of 87th, 347th, and 387th Rifle Divisions. It participated in the Crimean Offensive as part of 2nd Guards Army<cr><cr><cr>Poirier, Robert and Conner, Albert, The Red Army Order of Battle in the Great Patriotic War, Presidio Press, 1985<cr><cr>Entry contributed by Stewart King

text: The 56th Army was formed in October 1941 and subordinated to the North Caucasus Military District. Subordinated to the Southern Front in December 1941, the 56th Army was made up of the following units, as well as five regiments of artillery and a rocket-launcher regiment. The 31st, 106th, 343rd, 347th and 353rd Rifle Divisions. The 62nd, 64th, 70th and 'NO' Cavalry Divisions. The 11th, 13th, 16th, and 78th Rifle Brigade, 54th Tank Brigade, 33rd NKVD Motorized Rifle Regiment and 8th Tank Battalion.<cr>In January 1942 the army comprised the 31st, 106th, 343rd, and 347th Rifle Divisions, the 13th and 16th Rifle Brigades, the Rostov Separate Rifle Regiment of the People's Militia, and the 62nd, 64th, 70th Cavalry Divisions.<cr>Among prominent actions, the 56th Army fought during the successful Soviet liberation of Rostov in late 1941 and spearheaded the amphibious landings in the Crimea in late 1943. The 56th Army was disbanded in November 1943 to create the second formation of the Separate Coastal Army.<cr><cr>
translation: 第56集团军成立于1941年10月，隶属于北高加索军区。1941年12月被编入南方方面军，第56集团军由以下部队组成：第31、第106、第343、第347和第353步兵师；第62、第64、第70和“NO”骑兵师；第11、第13、第16和第78步兵旅，第54坦克旅，第33边防军摩托化步兵营和第8坦克营。<cr>1942年1月，该集团军包括第31、第106、第343和第347步兵师，第13和第16步兵旅，罗斯托夫人民民兵独立步兵团以及第62、第64和第70骑兵师。<cr>在显著行动中，第56集团军参与了苏联成功解放罗斯托夫的战役（1941年底）以及克里米亚登陆作战（1943年底）。第56集团军于1943年11月解散，以组建第二支独立海岸集团军。<cr><cr>

text: The 56th Guards Rifle Division was formed as an elite infantry division of the Red Army in June, 1943, based on the 2nd formations of the 74th and 91st Rifle Brigades, and served in that role until after the end of WWII. The division was formed 'out of sequence', that is, many Guards rifle divisions were higher numbered and formed earlier than the 56th. The division was immediately assigned to the 19th Guards Rifle Corps of the 10th Guards Army and remained under those headquarters for the duration of the war. It first saw action in Western Front's summer offensive, Operation Suvorov. On September 8 the 254th Guards Rifle Regiment was given the honorific title 'in the name of Aleksandr Matrosov' and on September 25 the division as a whole was awarded the honorific 'Smolensk' for its role in the liberation of that city. During the winter of 1943-44 it took part in the stubborn fighting north and east of Vitebsk, first in Western and later in 2nd Baltic Front. During the following summer offensives it helped break through the defenses of the German Panther Line and advanced into the Baltic states, eventually being decorated with the Order of the Red Banner after the liberation of Riga. For the rest of the war it was part of the forces blockading the remnants of German Army Group North in the Courland Pocket in Latvia, eventually in Leningrad Front.<cr><cr>
translation: 第56近卫步兵师于1943年6月作为红军精锐步兵师组建，基于第74和第91步兵旅的第二编组，并在二战结束后继续服役。该师是“非序列”组建的，也就是说许多近卫步兵师编号更高且成立时间更早。该师立即被分配给第十近卫集团军下的第19近卫步兵军，并在整个战争期间都隶属于这些司令部。它首次参战是在西方方面军夏季攻势“苏沃洛夫行动”中。9月8日，第254近卫步兵团获得以亚历山大·马特罗索夫命名的荣誉称号；9月25日，整个师因在解放斯摩棱斯克市中的作用而被授予“斯摩棱斯克”荣誉称号。1943-44年冬季，它参与了维捷布斯克北部和东部顽强战斗，最初是在西方方面军，后来是第二波罗的海方面军。在随后夏季攻势中，该师帮助突破德军豹式防线，并推进至波罗的海国家，在解放里加后被授予红旗勋章。战争剩余时间里，它作为封锁拉脱维亚库尔兰半岛上德国北方集团军群残余部队的一部分力量，最终隶属于列宁格勒方面军。<cr>司令官报告<cr><cr><cr>司令官报告<cr><cr>

text: In 1941 the 56th Infantry Division was in the spearhead of Army Group Center, crossing the Bug River on rubber rafts. The 56th took part in the advance on and retreat from Moscow (fighting in the battles of Kovel, Kiev and Bryansk on the way) and remained on the central sector of the Russian Front for the rest of the war. It held a sector near Orel throughout 1942, and suffered heavy casualties in the Battle of Kursk in July 1943. The division temporarily ceased to exist on November 2, 1943, when its Staff was redesignated Corps Detachment D. It controlled Division Group 56 (the former members of the 56th Infantry Division); Division Group 262 (the former 262nd Infantry Division); the 761st Grenadier Brigade; and assorted divisional troops, which bore the number 156. Corps Detachment D fought at Smolensk and Vitebsk, and was smashed in the Soviet summer offensive of 1944.<cr>Briefly withdrawn in the autumn of 1944, the 56th was recreated in East Prussia on September 10, 1944, when Staff, Corps Detachment D became Headquarters, 56th Infantry Division, once more. Division Group 56 became the 171st Grenadier Regiment, Division Group 262 became the 192nd Grenadier Regiment, and the 761st Grenadier Brigade became the 234th Grenadier Regiment. Each grenadier regiment in the new division had only two battalions. The division also included the 156th Artillery Regiment (with two battalions instead of the normal four), the 156th Fusilier Battalion, the 156th Tank Destroyer Battalion, the 156th Engineer Battalion, the 156th Signal Battalion, and the 156th Field Replacement Battalion. During this process, the division absorbed the 1067th and 1068th Grenadier Regiment, the 1041st March Battalion and several artillery battalions. The 56th Infantry Division returned to Army Group Center as a Volksgrenadier division and was destroyed in the Battle of the Heiligenbeil Pocket in March 1945. The divisional staff was evacuated to Pomerania, where it was used to form Staff, Division Ulrich von Hutten.<cr><cr>German Order of Battle Vol I 1st - 290th Infantry Divisions in WWII, Samuel W. Mitcham Jr.
translation: 1941年，第56步兵师是中央集团军群的尖刀部队之一，在橡皮筏的帮助下渡过了布格河。该师参与了对莫斯科的进攻和撤退（途中参加了科韦利、基辅和布良斯克等地的战斗），并在整个战争期间驻守在俄罗斯方面军的中部战区。1942年，它一直坚守着奥廖尔附近的防区，并于1943年7月在库尔斯克战役中遭受了重大伤亡。该师于1943年11月2日暂时解散，其指挥部被重新指定为D军部编队；控制第56师团（原第56步兵师成员）；第262师团（原第262步兵师成员）；第761掷弹兵旅；以及各种师级部队，编号为156。D军部编队在斯摩棱斯克和维捷布斯克作战，并于1944年苏联夏季攻势中被击溃。<cr><cr>1944年秋季短暂撤出后，第56步兵师于1944年9月10日在东普鲁士重建。当时司令部、军直属部队D成为第56步兵师司令部。第56师团改编为第171掷弹兵团，第262师团改编为第192掷弹兵团，第761掷弹兵旅改编为第234掷弹兵团。新组建的每个掷弹兵团只有两个营。该师还包括第156炮兵团（有两个而非通常四个营）、第156突击步枪营、第156坦克歼击车营、第156工兵营、第156通信营和第156野战补充营。在此过程中，该师吸收了第1067掷弹兵团、第1068掷弹兵团、第1041行军营以及几个炮兵营。第56步兵师作为国民掷弹兵师返回中央集团军群，并于1945年3月在海利根贝伊尔包围圈战役中被消灭。该师司令部撤退到波美拉尼亚，用于组建乌尔里希冯胡滕师司令部。<cr>Samuel W. Mitcham Jr., 《二战中的第1至290步兵师：德国战斗序列卷一》

text: The 57th Army was formed in October 1941 and subordinated to the Reserve of the Supreme High Command (RVGK). Still under RVGK control in December 1941, the 57th Army was made up of the following units, the 333rd, 335th, 337th, 341st, 349th and 351st Rifle Divisions, and the 60th and 79th Cavalry Divisions.<cr>During the May 1942 Battle of Kharkov, the army was surrounded and practically destroyed. Attempting to break out, General Kuzma Podlas, the army commander, was killed in action. Slowly rebuilt, by December 1942, the army was part of the Stalingrad Front. The 57th Army was disbanded in February 1943 to form the headquarters of the 68th Army.<cr>The 57th Army was formed a second time in April 1943 and subordinated to the Southwestern Front. The 68th Rifle Corps first appears in Soviet OOB 1 August 1943, as part of the 57th Army, Southwestern Front. Subordinate divisions at this time were the 19th, 52nd, and 303rd Rifle Divisions. The army subsequently fought in the Ukraine, Romania, Bulgaria, Yugoslavia, and Hungary until the end of the war. During the final months of the war, the army occupied the southernmost position of the Soviet front line; to the south of 57th Army on the eastern front were Bulgarian (including the Bulgarian First Army) and Yugoslavian forces. At war's end, the 57th Army was subordinated to the 3rd Ukrainian Front.<cr><cr>

text:
57th Cavalry Division was formed from 1 August to October 1941 at Ferghana in the Central Asia Military District, with the 212th, 218th, and 225th Cavalry Regiments. The division was part of the second wave of cavalry division formed during the war. The division spent almost three months in the rear before being deployed to the front. In October the division moved to the Volga Military District to join the 10th Army.

The division, along with the 41st and 75th Cavalry Divisions, was assigned to Mishulin's Cavalry Group, the mobile group for the 10th Army. The group minus the 41st Cavalry Division was assigned to attack the flank of the German 2nd Panzer Army south of Tula. Before it was fully committed, the group was assigned to the 1st Guards Cavalry Corps.

It was then transferred to the 1st Guards Cavalry Corps of the Western Front - January 1942 to 21 March 1942. Then the division participated in one of the greatest cavalry raids of the war. On the night of 26-27 January 1942 the Corps slipped across the lines into the German 4th Army's rear areas and began what would be a six-month operation against the German supply lines.

The division was dissolved on 3 February 1942, and portions were used to replenish the 1st Guards Cavalry Division.<cr><cr>

该师与第41和75骑兵师一起被分配给米什林斯基的骑兵群，这是第十集团军的一个机动部队。除去第41骑兵师后，该群被指定攻击德国第二装甲集团军在图拉以南侧翼的任务。在完全投入战斗之前，该群被重新分配到第一近卫骑兵军。

随后于1942年1月1日至3月21日转移到西方面军的第一近卫骑兵军。之后该师参与了战争中最大的一次骑兵突袭之一。1942年1月26至27日夜，该军悄悄越过前线进入德国第四集团军的后方区域，并开始了长达六个月针对德军补给线的行动。

text: n June 1941 the 57th Infantry Division took part in the sweep across southern Russia, fighting at Brody, Uman, Krivoy Rog and Kharkov. The division remained on the southern sector, taking part in the Battle of Voronezh in 1942, and suffering heavy losses at the battles of Kursk and Kharkov (1943). It participated in the Dnieper withdrawal (1943) and was encircled at Cherkassy in February 1944. It broke out but with heavy loss of equipment and life. Briefly sent to the rear (to Debica, Poland) to regroup, the 57th was rebuilt as a Type 44 division (with six grenadier battalions). Its artillery was partially re-equipped with captured French guns. The division soon returned to the front, but this time to Army Group Center just in time for the Russian summer offensive of 1944. It was surrounded at Mogilev (east of Minsk) along with the rest of the 4th Army's XXVII Corps, and was destroyed during the first week of July 1944. Soon afterward the 57th Infantry was officially disbanded. Its survivors were incorporated into the II/57th Divisional Group of Corps Detachment G.<cr><cr>German Order of Battle Vol I 1st - 290th Infantry Divisions in WWII, Samuel W. Mitcham Jr.
translation: 1941年6月，第57步兵师参加了横扫俄罗斯南部的行动，在布鲁迪、乌曼、克里沃伊罗格和哈尔科夫作战。该师继续留在南部战区，参与了1942年的沃罗涅日战役，并在库尔斯克和哈尔科夫（1943年）战役中遭受重大损失。它参加了第聂伯河的撤退行动（1943年），并在1944年2月被包围于切尔卡瑟，成功突围但装备和人员损失惨重。短暂调往后方（波兰德比察）重组后，第57师重建为Type 44型师（拥有六个掷弹兵营）。其炮兵部分重新配备了缴获的法国火炮。该师很快返回前线，这次是在中央集团军群参加1944年的苏联夏季攻势。它在莫吉廖夫（明斯克以东）与第4集团军的第27军一起被包围，并于1944年7月第一周被消灭。不久之后，第57步兵师正式解散。其幸存者并入了G集群直属部队II/57师团。<cr> 德国战斗序列 第1至290步兵师在二战中的表现，塞缪尔·W·米切尔少校著。<cr>

text:
The 57th Tank Division was formed February-May 1941 in Transbaikal Military District as independant division with:<cr>
114th Tank Regiment
1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th Tank Bns - all light tanks
115th Tank Regiment
1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th Tank Bns - all light tanks
57th Motorized Rifle Regiment
1st, 2nd, 3rd bns
57th Howitzer Regiment
1 light, 1 medium bn
57th Reconnaissance Battalion
57th Motorized Pontoon Battalion
57th Antiaircraft Battalion<cr>
The 57th Tank Division was formed late, but had a large number of personnel with combat experience from the fighting at Khalkin-Gol in 1939. By June 1941 the division had 324 T-26 tanks, but no modern vehicles.
On 30 May 1941 the division was ordered to move west with 16th Army. On 26 June, the first elements of the division were arriving from the east by rail at Shepetovka station in the Ukraine just ahead of the first German panzer units coming from the west! 115th Tank Regiment was immediately split off as a separate reinforcing unit for Group Lukin, defending the Soviet supply dump at Belaya Tserkov. The rest of the division was shifted north to the Smolensk area, where 57th Motorized Rifle Regiment was split off as a
separate regiment in 16th Army. In mid-July the 114th Tank Regiment was reinforced by the Orel Tank Training Battalion, but the division still consisted, basically, of a reinforced tank regiment. It fought with 20th Army until August, when the division HQ was disbanded and the surviving division elements used to reinforce other units in Western Front.<cr><cr>Soviet Order of Battle Volume I by Charles C. Sharp

1941年5月30日，该师接到命令与第16集团军一起向西移动。6月26日，该师的先头部队从东部通过铁路抵达乌克兰谢佩托夫卡车站，比来自西部的德军装甲单位提前到达！第115坦克团立即被分派为卢金集群增援部队，保卫白采尔科维苏军补给站。其余部队则向北转移到斯摩棱斯克地区，在那里第57机械化步兵团被分派为第16集团军的一个独立团。

text: In recognition of its courage in the initial stages of Operation Little Saturn, the 1st Rifle Divison was converted into the 58th Guards Rifle Division, an elite Guards unit, on 31 December 1942. Advancing into Ukraine, the division participated in the Third Battle of Kharkov in early 1943. From midyear it fought in the Belgorod-Kharkov Offensive, the Battle of the Dnieper, and the Dnieper-Carpathian Offensive, receiving the honorific Krasnograd for its capture of that city and the Order of the Red Banner. After capturing the Sandomierz bridgehead at the end of the Lvov-Sandomierz Offensive, the division fought in the Sandomierz-Silesian Offensive in January 1945, receiving the Order of Suvorov for its crossing of the Oder. It was the first to meet American forces on the Elbe during the Berlin Offensive on 25 April 1945, receiving the Order of Lenin. For its actions in the Prague Offensive at the end of the war, the division was awarded the name of Prague as an honorific.<cr><cr>
translation: 为了表彰其在土星行动初期的英勇表现，第1步兵师于1942年12月31日改编为第58近卫步兵师，成为一支精英近卫部队。该师推进至乌克兰境内，在1943年初参与了第三次哈尔科夫战役。从下半年开始，它参加了别尔哥罗德-哈尔科夫进攻、第聂伯河战役和第聂伯河-喀尔巴阡山进攻战，并因攻占克拉斯诺戈尔斯克而获得荣誉称谓“克拉斯诺戈尔斯克”，并荣获红旗勋章。在夺取桑多梅日桥头堡后，该师于1945年1月参加了桑多梅日-西里西亚进攻战，并因渡过奥得河而荣获苏沃洛夫勋章。在柏林战役期间，该师于1945年4月25日在易北河畔首次与美军会合，并因此获得列宁勋章。由于其在战争末期的布拉格攻势中的表现，该师被授予荣誉称谓“布拉格”。<cr><cr>

text: The 58th Infantry Division was first heavily engaged in 1941 on the northern sector of the Russian Front, where it broke through the Stalin Line, swept through the Baltic States, fought at Lake Peipus, and took part in the siege of Leningrad. The next year it took part in the Battle of Volkhov (south of Leningrad) from March through July, before being switched to the Oranienbaum sector, where it remained until November 1942. Meanwhile, in July 1942, its I/154th Infantry Regiment, III/209th Infantry Regiment, and III/220th Infantry Regiment were disbanded. Their survivors were assigned to the extant battalions in their regiments. The division, meanwhile, remained on the northern sector of the Eastern Front until the fall of 1943, when it was sent to Nevel (Newel) on the extreme southern flank of the army group. It was hurriedly rushed back to the north in January 1944, but arrived too late to prevent the Soviets from breaking the siege of Leningrad. It lost one-third of its men and all its heavy equipment in the withdrawal from the city. It nevertheless fought on the Narva, at Dnaburg, and at Memel. In February 1945, the 58th returned to the central sector and was cut off in the Samland region of East Prussia in March 1945. It ended up on the Hela peninsula, where it surrendered in May.<cr><cr>German Order of Battle Vol I 1st - 290th Infantry Divisions in WWII, Samuel W. Mitcham Jr.
translation: 第58步兵师于1941年首次在俄罗斯方面军北部战区重创斯大林防线，横扫波罗的海诸国，并参与了列宁格勒围城战。次年3月至7月间，该师参加了沃尔霍夫战役（位于列宁格勒以南），随后被调往奥拉宁鲍姆地区，直至1942年11月。与此同时，在1942年7月，其第154步兵团第一营、第209步兵团第三营和第220步兵团第三营解散，幸存者被分配到各团中现存的营级单位。该师继续驻守东线北部战区直至1943年秋季，随后被调往集团军群最南端的新尔（Nevel）。1944年1月，它匆忙返回北方，但为时已晚，未能阻止苏联军队突破列宁格勒的包围。在撤出城市的过程中，该师损失了三分之一的人力和所有重型装备。尽管如此，它仍在纳尔瓦、达努堡（Dnaburg）和梅梅尔（Memel）继续作战。1945年2月，第58步兵师返回中央战区，并于同年3月在东普鲁士萨姆兰地区被切断联系。最终该师投降于赫拉半岛。<cr>德国战斗序列 第一卷 1至290号步兵师在二战中的经历，山姆·W·米奇马尔（Samuel W. Mitcham Jr.）

text:
For its courage, tenacity, and heroism the 197th Rifle Division was honored and renamed the 59th Guards Rifle Division on 3 January 1943. The divisions next combat participation was in the Donbass Offensive and the Barvenkov-Pavlograd Offensive operation (13.08 22.09.1943) in the Don basin and liberating the Donbass region. For its efforts in capturing the city of Kramatorsk on 6 September 1943 it was awarded the honorific name Kramator on 8 September 1943 by the Order of High Command No.9 on the same day During the liberation of Kramatorsk the division was supported by the 5th Guards Independent Motor-Rifle Brigade and the 243rd Independent Tank Regiment.<cr>
The division also supported clearing the city of Zaporozhye of the enemy on 14 October 1943, in conjunction with other units. For its exemplary battle skills and valour the division was awarded the Order of the Red Banner on 14 October 1943.<cr>
During the 1944 Nikopolsk-Krivorozhsk Offensive operation (30.01 - 29.02) the division fought first as part of 3rd Guards Army, and then as part of 6th Army together with the 61st Guards Rifle Division, 203rd Rifle, and the 320th Rifle Division divisions of the 34th Guards Rifle Corps. For the skilful performance of combat tasks and courage of the division's troops it was awarded the Order of Suvorov, 2nd degree, on 13 February 1944.<cr>
In the following months, the division was part of the attack toward Odessa, and was the first formation to enter the city on 10 April 1944 despite the bad road conditions, crossing the river lines of the Ingulets, Ingul, and Southern Bug rivers in the process. The division was awarded the Order of Bogdan Khmelnitsky, 2nd degree on 20 April 1944 for its courage and heroism in clearing the city of Odessa. In the summer of the same year the division, as part of the 46th Army (with which it remained to the end of the war), 3rd Ukrainian Front, the division participated in the Yassy-Kishinev Offensive operation. As part of the offensive the division broke through the Wehrmacht defense to the east of Bendery, fighting on the left shore of lake Kitai, and cut off the withdrawal route to parts of German III Army Corps. Pursuing the retreating German troops, the division crossed the Soviet-Romanian border on August, 28th near the city of Reni, 25 kilometres to the East of Gala?i. On 8 September, the Bulgarian border was also crossed as the division was transferred to the 2nd Ukrainian Front for the Belgorod Offensive (28.09 - 20.10). From October 1944 to February 1945 the division took part in the Battle of Debrecen and the initial phase of the Budapest Offensive, the Kechkemet-Budapest Offensive operation.<cr>
The last stages of the divisions combat path during World War II was the participation in the Vienna Offensives D'er Offensive operation, during which the divisions active and resolute actions to the north of Vienna led to the Red Armys capture of the Austrian capital on 13 April 1945. The divisions combat operations finished in the Freistadt area, north of Linz, in May 1945.<cr><cr>
translation:
由于其勇气、坚韧和英雄主义，第197步兵师于1943年1月3日被授予荣誉称号并改名为第59近卫步兵师。该师下一次参战是在顿巴斯攻势和巴尔文科夫-帕夫洛格勒攻势（1943年8月13日至9月22日）中，在顿河盆地作战，解放了顿巴斯地区。由于在1943年9月6日占领克拉斯诺佩特罗夫卡市的行动中的努力，该师于同一天被授予荣誉称号“克拉斯诺佩特罗夫卡”，这是根据最高统帅部第9号命令颁发的荣誉名称。在解放克拉斯诺佩特罗夫卡的过程中，该师得到了第5近卫独立机械化旅和第243独立坦克团的支持。<cr><cr>该师还于1943年10月14日支持其他部队清除扎波罗热市敌军的行动。由于其出色的战斗技能和英勇行为，该师被授予红旗勋章，日期为1943年10月14日。<cr><cr>在1944年的尼科波尔-克里沃罗格攻势（1月30日至2月29日）中，该师最初作为第3近卫集团军的一部分参战，然后与第6集团军的第61近卫步兵师、第203步兵师和第320步兵师一起作战。由于其在完成战斗任务时表现出色以及士兵们的勇气，该师于1944年2月13日被授予苏沃洛夫勋章二级。<cr><cr>
在接下来的几个月里，该师参加了进攻敖德萨的行动，并于1944年4月10日率先进入这座城市，尽管路况不佳。在此过程中，该师穿越了因古列茨河、因古尔河和南布格河的防线。由于其在清除敖德萨市中的勇气与英勇表现，该师于1944年4月20日被授予博格丹·赫梅利尼茨基勋章二级奖章。

同年夏天，作为第46集团军（该师一直隶属于它直到战争结束）和第三乌克兰方面军的一部分，该师参加了雅西-奇什古尔进攻战役。在此次攻势中，该师突破了德国国防军在别德内的东部防线，在凯泰湖的左岸作战，并切断了部分德国第3集团军撤退路线。

追击撤退中的德军部队，该师于1944年8月28日穿越苏罗边境附近的雷尼市（距离加拉茨以东约25公里），并于同年9月8日越过保加利亚边界。随后，该师被调往第二乌克兰方面军参加别尔哥罗德进攻战役（9月28日至10月20日）。

从1944年10月至1945年2月，该师参加了德布勒森之战和布达佩斯攻势的初始阶段，即凯奇梅特-布达佩斯进攻行动。<cr>

该师在第二次世界大战中的最后战斗阶段是参加维也纳攻势，在此期间其积极而果断的行为导致了苏联红军于1945年4月13日占领奥地利首都维也纳。该师的作战行动最终于1945年5月在林茨以北的弗赖施塔特地区结束。<cr><cr>
