text: The Crimean Front was formed on 28 January 1942 by splitting the Caucasian front and included the armies then in the Kerch and Taman peninsulas and the region of Krasnodar, along with operational control over other forces. It was tasked with assisting the troops of Sevastopol Defence Area, striking at Karasubazar and threatening the rear of the Axis forces blockading Sevastopol. Its troops went on the offensive three times from February 27 to April 13, 1942, but made no significant progress, and after minor gains they were forced onto the defensive. On 21 April 1942, the troops in the North Caucasus were added to it.<cr>On 8 May 1942, the Germans launched an offensive on the Kerch Peninsula and recaptured it on 16 May, forcing the Soviet troops of the Crimean Front to be evacuated to the Taman Peninsula. Some troops were unable to evacuate and fought the Germans at Adzhimushkay until the end of October of the same year, with no significant stocks of food, water, medicine, arms, or ammunition. The Red Army lost over 300,000 men in the Kerch landings, and a large amount of its heavy weaponry. The landings' failure was also a major factor in the Soviet loss of Sevastopol, and helped make possible the German summer offensive into the Caucasus. On 19 May 1942, the Crimean Front was disbanded, and its troops given to the command of the North Caucasus Front.<cr><cr>
translation: 克里米亚方面军于1942年1月28日成立，由高加索方面军分拆而来，包括当时驻扎在刻赤半岛和塔曼半岛以及克拉斯诺达尔地区的军队，并对其他部队实施作战指挥。该方面军的任务是协助塞瓦斯托波尔防御区的部队，打击卡拉斯布扎尔并威胁轴心国封锁塞瓦斯托波尔后方的安全。从1942年2月27日至4月13日，其部队三次发起进攻，但未取得显著进展，在小有斩获之后被迫转入防御状态。1942年4月21日，北高加索地区的军队被加入该方面军。<cr>1942年5月8日，德国人对刻赤半岛发动攻势，并于5月16日重新占领了该地，迫使克里米亚方面军的苏联部队撤退至塔曼半岛。一些无法撤离的部队在阿杰姆舒凯与德军战斗到同年10月底，在此期间几乎没有食物、水、药品、武器或弹药。<cr>红军在刻赤登陆行动中损失了超过30万名士兵，以及大量重型装备。此次登陆失败也是苏联失去塞瓦斯托波尔的重要因素，并帮助德国夏季攻势进入高加索成为可能。1942年5月19日，克里米亚方面军被解散，其部队交由北高加索方面军指挥。<cr><cr><cr><cr>

text: During World War II, the Italian Expeditionary Corps in Russia (Corpo di Spedizione Italiano in Russia, or CSIR) was a corps-sized expeditionary unit of the Regio Esercito (Italian Army) that fought on the Eastern Front. In July 1942, the three divisions of the CSIR all became part of the Italian XXXV Army Corps.<cr><cr>The CSIR was formed in an attempt to provide a somewhat 'mobile' unit to fight on a front where mobility was key. Two of the divisions were 'truck-moveable' and one was a 'fast' division, drawn from the reserve Army of the Po. However, this amounted to more on paper than in reality.<cr><cr>The CSIR was created by Italian dictator Benito Mussolini in an attempt to show solidarity with Nazi Germany after German dictator Adolf Hitler launched Operation Barbarossa and attacked the Soviet Union. Mussolini created the CSIR despite the lack of enthusiasm shown by Hitler. The CSIR was constituted on 10 July 1941 and, between July and August 1941, the various units of the CSIR arrived in southern Russia.<cr><cr>The CSIR included an Aviation Command (Commando Aviazione) with a limited number of fighters, bombers, and transport aircraft. This command was part of the Royal Air Force (Regia Aeronautica) and was also known as the 'Expeditionary Air Corps in Russia' (Corpo Aereo Spedizione in Russia).<cr><cr>The CSIR was initially subordinated to the German 11th Army (11. Armee) commanded by General Eugen Ritter von Schobert. On 14 August 1941, the CSIR was transferred to the control of the1st Panzer Group (Panzergruppe 1) commanded by General Ewald von Kleist. On 25 October 1941, Tank Group 1 was redesignated as the 1st Tank Army (1.Panzerarmee). The CSIR remained under von Kleist's command until 3 June 1942 when it was subordinated to the German 17th Army (17. Armee) commanded by General Richard Ruoff.<cr><cr>The CSIR's original commander was Italian General Francesco Zingales. He fell ill in Vienna during the early stages of transport to Russia. On 14 July 1941, Zingales was replaced by Italian General Giovanni Messe.<cr><cr>In July 1942, the CSIR was incorporated into the far larger Italian Army in Russia (Armata Italiana in Russia, or ARMIR) when Mussolini decided to expand the Italian presence in the Soviet Union. The three divisions of the CSIR all became part of the ARMIR's XXXV Army Corps.<cr><cr>
translation:
在第二次世界大战期间，意大利远征军俄罗斯部队（Corpo di Spedizione Italiano in Russia，简称CSIR）是意大利王国军队派出的军团级远征部队，在东线作战。1942年7月，CSIR的三个师全部并入了意大利第35军。

CSIR成立的初衷是为了提供一个相对“机动”的单位在需要高度机动性的战线上作战。其中两个师可以依靠卡车运输，另一个是来自波河后备集团军的快速师。然而，这更多体现在纸面上而非实际操作中。

1941年7月10日，在德国独裁者阿道夫·希特勒发动巴巴罗萨行动并入侵苏联后，意大利独裁者贝尼托·墨索里尼为了展示对纳粹德国的支持而创建了CSIR。尽管希特勒对此并不热心，墨索里尼还是在1941年7月至8月期间将CSIR的各个单位派往南俄罗斯。

CSIR包括一个航空指挥部（Commando Aviazione），拥有一定数量的战斗机、轰炸机和运输机。该指挥部隶属于意大利王家空军，并被称为“远征航空军俄罗斯”（Corpo Aereo Spedizione in Russia）。CSIR最初隶属于德国第11集团军（由尤根·冯·肖伯特将军指挥）。1941年8月14日，CSIR被转交给第1装甲集群（由克莱斯特将军指挥）控制。1941年10月25日，第1坦克集群改称为第1坦克集团军。直至1942年6月3日，CSIR一直受克莱斯特的指挥，之后被转交至德国第17集团军（由理查德·鲁夫将军指挥）控制。<cr><cr>CSIR最初的指挥官是意大利的弗朗切斯科·津加莱斯将军。他在运输到苏联初期在维也纳生病了。1941年7月14日，津加莱斯被意大利的乔万尼·梅西将军取代。<cr><cr>1942年7月，当墨索里尼决定扩大意大利在苏联的存在时，CSIR并入规模更大的意大利驻苏军队（Armata Italiana in Russia 或 ARMIR）。CSIR的三个师都成为ARMIR第35军的一部分。

text: The Feldherrnhalle Panzergrenadier Division was redesignated Panzer Division Feldherrnhalle on November 27, 1944, it was sent to Hungary and was soon involved in the Siege of Budapest. The FHH, along with the rest of the IX SS Mountain Corps, was surrounded in the city on December 26, 1944. The garrison broke out on February 11, 1945, but was cut to pieces before it could reach German lines. Only 800 of its 30,000 men escaped.<cr><cr>German Order of Battle Vol III - Panzer, Panzer Grenadier and Waffen SS Divisions in WWII, Samuel W. Mitcham Jr.
translation: 菲德尔赫尔纳宫装甲掷弹兵师于1944年11月27日改编为菲德尔赫尔纳宫装甲师，并被派往匈牙利，很快便参与了布达佩斯围城战。FHH（菲德尔赫尔纳宫）连同其余的第9武装党卫军山地军，在该市于1944年12月26日被包围。<cr>守备部队在1945年2月11日突围，但在到达德军防线前已被击溃。只有30,000人中的800人生还。<cr><cr>德国战斗序列第III卷 - 装甲、装甲掷弹兵和武装党卫军师在二战中的记录，山姆·W·米奇安少校

text: The Feldherrnehalle Panzer Corps was formed at the end of February 1945 from the remnants of units that escaped Budapest, when it was overrun by the Red Army. Most of the combat units were sent into action at the end of March 1945. The corps executed a fighting withdrawal towards Vienna and then into southern Austria. By the beginning of May 1945, the remnants of the corps broke up and attempted to reach the American lines, where they surrendered on May 9, 1945.<cr><cr>
translation: 费尔特黑内大厅装甲军于1945年2月底由逃离布达佩斯的部队残部组建而成，当该城被红军攻占时，大部分战斗单位在1945年3月底投入了作战。该军执行了一次向维也纳方向的撤退行动，随后进入南奥地利。到1945年5月初，该军残部瓦解并试图到达美军防线，在1945年5月9日投降。<cr><cr>

text: This unit was formed in March 1945, from Replacement and Training Brigade 'Feldherrnhale', the remnants of the 13th Panzer Division, the 110th Panzer Brigade and elements of the I Cavalry Corps. Very much understrength, the new division formed part of Feldherrnehalle Panzer Corps of the 8th Army in Slovakia, where it fought its only battles on the upper Danube. It tried to capitulate to the Americans at the end of the war, but they insisted in surrender to the Soviets. Major General Dr. Franz Bke, the divisions only commander, withdrew a short distance and disbanded the unit. It broke into small groups. Some managed to infiltrate through American lines and to surrender to the U.S. Army; others fell into Russian hands.<cr><cr>German Order of Battle Vol III - Panzer, Panzer Grenadier and Waffen SS Divisions in WWII, Samuel W. Mitcham Jr.
translation: 该师成立于1945年3月，由“斐迪南大厅”补充和训练旅、第13装甲师残部、第110装甲旅以及第一骑兵军的部分部队组建而成。兵力严重不足，新编成的师成为位于斯洛伐克的第八集团军麾下斐迪南大厅装甲军的一部分，在上多瑙河地区进行了唯一几次战斗。在战争结束时，该师试图向美军投降，但美军坚持要求其向苏军投降。少将弗朗茨·贝克博士是该师唯一的指挥官，他带领部队撤退了一段距离后解散了部队。部队成员分散成小队，一些人设法穿过美军防线并向美国陆军投降；其他人则落入苏联军队手中。<cr>德国战斗序列 第三卷 - 二战中的德军装甲师、装甲掷弹兵师和武装党卫军师<cr>萨缪尔·W·米奇姆 Jr.

text: A second 60th Motorized Division was created in southern France on February 17, 1943. Officially activated on March 15, 1943, it was built around the 271st Infantry Regiment 'Feldherrnhalle', which had previously served with the 93rd Infantry Division in Russia, and several other cadre units from a variety of sources. The division received the honorary title 'Feldherrnhalle' because it contained a high number of Brownshirt volunteers. It was redesignated Panzer Grenadier Division 'Feldherrnhalle' (FHH) on May 27. Its units were all renamed and the division now consisted of the Grenadier Regiment FHH, the Fusilier Regiment FHH, the Panzer Battalion FHH, the Artillery Regiment FHH, the Panzer Reconnaissance Battalion FHH, and so on. In August 1943, it was sent to southern France during the period of vacillation of the post-Mussolini Italian government, while the Italian 4th Army evacuated the area and returned home.<cr>Ultimately the new mobile division was posted to the Greco-Turkish frontier region, and then was sent to the Eastern Front in the fall of 1943. It fought against the massive Soviet summer offensive of 1944 that annihilated Army Group Centre. The division was smashed near Minsk and was almost trapped east of the Dnieper. Divisional commander Major General Friedrich-Carl von Steinkeller was among those captured. The remnants of the FHH were withdrawn to the Estergom Troop Maneuver Area in Hungary and a second FHH Panzer Grenadier Division began to form on July 19, 1944. Later it was sent to Debreczen in the Warthegau, a district of Poland annexed by the Third Reich in 1939. Here the new FHH Panzer Grenadier Division was officially activated on September 1, 1944. Built around the 109th Panzer Brigade (which it absorbed), the new division had a strength of 8,000 men, twenty-five tanks, and a battalion of superb Hummel 150mm self-propelled howitzers by November 1. Redesignated Panzer Division Feldherrnhalle on November 27, 1944, it was sent to Hungary and was soon involved in the Siege of Budapest. The FHH, along with the rest of the IX SS Mountain Corps, was surrounded in the city on December 26, 1944. The garrison broke out on February 11, 1945, but was cut to pieces before it could reach German lines. Only 800 of its 30,000 men escaped.<cr><cr>German Order of Battle Vol III - Panzer, Panzer Grenadier and Waffen SS Divisions in WWII, Samuel W. Mitcham Jr.
translation: 1943年2月17日，第二支第60摩托化师在法国南部成立。该师于1943年3月15日正式组建，核心是此前曾在俄罗斯与第93步兵师一同服役的“宫廷元帅”团（第271步兵团）。此外还吸纳了来自多个单位的骨干力量。由于该师拥有大量褐衫党志愿者，因此获得了“宫廷元帅”的荣誉番号。5月27日，该师被重新命名为装甲掷弹兵师“宫廷元帅”（FHH）。其下属各部均改名换姓，现由掷弹兵团FHH、燧发枪团FHH、装甲营FHH、炮兵团FHH和装甲侦察营FHH等组成。1943年8月，在墨索里尼下台后意大利政府摇摆不定的时期，该师被派往法国南部，而意军第4集团军则从该地区撤出回国。<cr>最终，这支新的摩托化师被部署到希腊和土耳其之间的边境地区，然后于1943年秋季被派往东线。它参加了苏联在1944年夏天发动的大规模攻势，该攻势摧毁了中央集团军群。该师在明斯克附近遭到重创，并几乎被困在第聂伯河以东。师长少将弗里德里希-卡尔·冯·斯坦凯勒尔被俘虏。FHH残部撤退到匈牙利的埃斯特戈姆部队演习区，第二支FHH装甲掷弹兵师于1944年7月19日开始组建。后来该师被派往波兰瓦尔特加地区的德布雷岑，在那里新的FHH装甲掷弹兵师于1944年9月1日正式成立。新师以第109装甲旅为核心（吸收了该旅），到11月1日，拥有8000名士兵、25辆坦克和一个装备有卓越的野蜂自行榴弹炮营。1944年11月27日重新编为“ Feldherrnhalle ”装甲师后，它被派往匈牙利，并很快卷入了布达佩斯围城战。FHH与第九山地军（武装党卫军）一起于1944年12月26日在城市中被包围。守备部队在1945年2月11日突围，但在到达德军防线前几乎全军覆没。只有30,000人中的800人生还。<cr>参考文献：德国战斗序列卷III - 二战中的装甲师、装甲掷弹兵师和武装党卫军师，萨缪尔·W·米查姆少校

text: Also known as the 1st Frontier Guard Division the Frontier Romanian Infantry Division was assigned to the Romanian XI Corps at the start of Operation Barbarossa. The division participated in numerous battles during the Siege of Odessa. The division arrived back in Romania in October of 1941 and was largely demobilized. Elements of the division continued to serve as frontier guards until May of 1943 when the division was merged with the 4th Romainian Infantry Division.<cr><cr><cr><cr>Entry courtesy Chris Munson
translation: 也被称为第1边防师，罗马尼亚边境步兵师在巴巴罗萨行动开始时被分配给罗马尼亚第11军。该师参加了敖德萨围城战中的多次战斗。该师于1941年10月返回罗马尼亚，并且大部分部队都被解散了。<cr>该师的部分单位继续担任边防任务，直到1943年5月与第4罗马尼亚步兵师合并。<cr>资料提供：克里斯·芒森

text: On September 28, 1944 the OKH ordered the creation of a new panzer corps. It was planned to contain enlarged corps troops and several panzer divisions; a unit that could be used as strong reserve for an army. To achieve this, parts of the Panzergrenadier Division Grossdeutschland were, while the division retained its status, used as base for the Grossdeutschland Panzer Corps.<cr>With the addition of the Panzergrenadier Division Brandenburg the corps had its first structure with two active divisions. The first commander of the corps was General der Panzertruppe Dietrich von Saucken, the former commander of the XXXIX Panzer Corps.<cr>Still in the forming phase during the looming of the Soviet Vistula-Oder Offensive the staff and the Brandenburg Division were ordered to Poland, while the Division Grodeutschland was detached to Eastern Prussia. Ultimately the corps never fought as a unified body, and during the retreat towards the west its composition steadily changed. When von Saucken was promoted to command the 2nd Army in February he was succeeded by General der Panzertruppe Georg Jauer, who commanded the corps's 20th Panzergrenadier Division. Never surrendering at-large the corps was dismissed on war's end on May 8, 1945.<cr><cr>
translation: 1944年9月28日，陆军总司令部下令组建一个新的装甲军。计划中该部队将包含扩编的军级部队和几个装甲师；一个可以作为集团军强大预备队使用的单位。为了实现这一目标，在第6装甲掷弹兵师保留其编制的同时，将其用作大德意志装甲军的基础。<cr>随着勃兰登堡装甲掷弹兵师的加入，该军首次拥有两个作战师。该军的第一任指挥官是原第XXXIX装甲军指挥官、装甲兵上将迪特里希·冯·索肯。在苏联维斯瓦河-奥得河攻势迫近之际，该军仍处于组建阶段，其指挥部和勃兰登堡师被调往波兰，而大德意志师则被派往东普鲁士。<cr>最终，该军从未作为一个统一的单位作战，在撤退向西的过程中，其编制不断变化。1945年2月冯·索肯晋升为第2集团军指挥官后，由装甲兵上将乔治·乔尔接任，后者指挥该军的第20装甲掷弹兵师。<cr>在战争结束时，该军从未投降，在1945年5月8日被解散。

text: The Gyorshadtest (variously translated 'Rapid Corps', 'Fast Corps' or 'Mobile Corps') was the most modern and best-equipped mechanized unit of the Royal Hungarian Army (Magyar Kirlyi Honvdsg) at the beginning of World War II. However, the 'Rapid Corps' name was something of a misnomer as it was only 'mechanized' compared to other Hungarian units. The corps was not particularly mechanized when compared to similar units fielded by countries like Germany or the Soviet Union.<cr>The corps consisted of the 1st and 2nd Motorized Brigades and the 1st Cavalry Brigade.<cr>Each of the two motorized brigades of the 'Rapid Corps' had a 'reconnaissance battalion' with obsolete light and medium tanks, which were extremely vulnerable to modern anti-tank weapons; two motorized infantry battalions; two bicycle battalions; one 105mm howitzer battalion; and one antiaircraft battery. The necessary engineering, communication, and supply troops enabled the motorized brigades to perform as independent tactical units.<cr>The cavalry brigade had two horse-mounted cavalry regiments; a reconnaissance battalion; two bicycle battalions; and horsedrawn as well as motorized artillery units, engineering, communication, and supply troops.<cr>Directly subordinate to the commander of the 'Rapid Corps' were two bicycle battalions, two medium artillery batteries, seven antiaircraft batteries, additional communication, engineering and supply troops, and one air force regiment.<cr>The mechanized corps looked impressive on paper as a strategic unit there is no doubt that it included the most modern, best-equipped troops of the Royal Hungarian Army. In reality, it was not very effective against the more modern equipped Soviet motorized or tank corps, especially later in the war. Because of the military leadership's wish to see the Hungarian troops in action as soon as possible, the mechanized corps was ordered to begin its march-up before completing mobilization. Therefore, the effective force was only 75-80 per cent of projected strength. Cars and trucks requisitioned for military operations failed to arrive on time at the mobilization stations. The horses requisitioned for the cavalry were untrained for military service.<cr>65 Italian Fiat L3 tankettes and 95 Hungarian Toldi I light/medium tanks were available. The L3s had two 8 mm machine guns in a fixed forward position. The L3s had no turret and were referred to as 'tankettes' rather than light tanks. The Toldis were light tanks and had a 20 mm gun in a rotating turret. But this gun offered no serious armor-piercing capability. Overall, the armored Hungarian forces were of little value, especially against the more modern Soviet T-34 and KV tanks.<cr>The 'Rapid Corps' was initially attached to the Carpathian Group during the early days of Operation Barbarossa. Unable to keep pace with the 'Rapid Corps, the 'Carpathian Group' was dissolved. The 'Rapid Corps was then attached to Army Group South.<cr>By August 1941, the Hungarian mechanized corps was a key participant in the Battle of Uman. The 'Rapid Corps' represented one half of a pincer which was enveloping the 6th Soviet Army and the 12th Soviet Army. The German 16th Panzer Division represented the other half of the pincer. On 3 August 1941, the pincer halves met and the 6th Army and the 12th Army were trapped. Over 100,000 Soviets were captured.<cr>Even victories cost the Hungarians dearly. The 'Rapid Corps' grew weaker in the summer of 1941. By comparison, the retreating Soviet armies, far from growing weaker, seemed to be growing stronger.<cr>Aware of the general situation, Hungarian Regent Admiral Mikls Horthy and the rest of the Hungarian political leadership tried to gain the release of the battle weary troops in the 'Rapid Corps'. Henrik Werth, the pro-German Chief of Staff, was replaced on 5 September 1941 by Colonel-General Ferenc Szombathelyi. Unlike Werth, who supported the German offensive in Russia, Szombathelyi held the conviction that Hungarian troops should be employed only for the defense of Hungarian frontiers. Szombathelyi did not hesitate to communicate this view to the Germans. To force the Germans to release the 'Rapid Corps', Szombathelyi neglected to replace either the armored vehicles or the personal carriers and trucks that the corps had lost during the campaign. Even so, the Germans continued to utilize the weak Hungarian mechanized corps.<cr>The German commanders typically allowed little room for the Hungarians to take independent action. However, the commander of the 'Rapid Corps', Major General Bla Dalnoki-Mikls, did make an independent decision on at least one occasion. Making this decision, forced Dalnoki-Miklos to disobey direct orders from Field Marshal Gerd von Rundstedt.<cr>On 19 October 1941, after the Battle of Kiev, General Carl-Heinrich von Stlpnagel's German 17th Army was advancing through Poltava towards Voroshilovgrad. Facing von Stlpnagel were elements of the 18th Soviet Army. Field Marshal von Rundstedt had ordered von Stlpnagel to order the Hungarian mechanized corps to break through the Russian defenses directly in his way. As he was told, Stlpnagel ordered Dalnoki-Miklos to attack the Russian defenses and break through them.<cr>Dalnoki-Miklos had many things to consider. The Hungarian mechanized corps was down to six battalions. The Russian defenses had already repelled the attack of 40 German battalions. After assessing the situation, Dalnoki-Miklos decided to try something other than the ordered breakthrough. Instead, Dalnoki-Miklos, planned and performed a maneuver that led to the encirclement of the Russian defenses. As a result, a superior Soviet forces was neutralized and the road to Voroshilovgrad was opened up for the continuation of the German advance.<cr>The German General Staff (Groer Generalsstab) had high praise for the outstanding achievements and tactical victories of the Hungarian mechanized corps. The mechanized corps fought for five months in a long campaign and covered over 1,000 miles of territory.<cr>Yet once again these victories were too costly. And the costs was not limited to the mechanized corps itself. The costs were also too high to the whole Hungarian nation. For a country the size of Hungary, the losses were tremendous. By the end of 1941, there were over 200 officers and more than 2,500 rank and file dead. Over 1,500 Hungarians were missing in action. At a minimum, another 7,500 were wounded. Losses in material were high as well. Gone were over 1,200 personnel carriers, 30 airplanes, 28 artillery pieces, 100 per cent of the L3 tankettes, 80 per cent of the Toldi tanks, and 90 per cent of the armored cars.<cr>In November 1941, the 'Rapid Corps' returned to Budapest.<cr><cr>
translation: 快速军（又称机械化军或摩托化军）是匈牙利皇家陆军在第二次世界大战初期最现代化和装备最好的机械化部队。然而，“快速军”这个名字有些名不副实，因为它只是相对于其他匈牙利单位而言较为机械化。与德国或苏联等国的类似部队相比，该军并不特别机械化。<cr>快速军由第1摩托化旅和第2摩托化旅以及第1骑兵旅组成。<cr>每个摩托化旅都包括一个装备过时轻型和中型坦克的侦察营；两个摩托化步兵营；两个自行车营；一个105毫米榴弹炮营；以及一个防空连。工程、通信和补给部队使摩托化旅能够作为独立战术单位行动。<cr>骑兵旅拥有两个马背上的骑兵团；一个侦察营；两个自行车营；以及由马拉和摩托化的炮兵、工兵、通信和补给部队组成。<cr>直接隶属于快速军指挥官的是两个自行车营，两个中型炮兵连，七个防空连，额外的通信、工程和补给部队，以及一个空军团。机械化军在纸面上看起来非常壮观，毫无疑问它包括了匈牙利皇家军队中最现代化、装备最好的部队。然而，在实际作战中，面对更先进的苏联摩托化或坦克军时，特别是战争后期，它的效果并不理想。由于军事领导层希望尽快将匈牙利部队投入战斗，机械化军在完成动员之前就被命令开始行军。因此，有效兵力只有预计人数的75%到80%。用于军事行动征用的汽车和卡车未能按时到达动员站。为骑兵征用的马匹未经军事训练。<cr>65辆意大利菲亚特L3坦克车和95辆匈牙利Toldi I轻型/中型坦克可供使用。L3坦克车配备了两个固定在前方位置上的8毫米机枪，没有炮塔，被称为“坦克车”而不是轻型坦克。Toldi坦克是轻型坦克，配备了一门可旋转炮塔中的20毫米火炮。但这门火炮对装甲的穿透能力并不强。总体而言，匈牙利的装甲部队几乎没有价值，尤其是在面对更先进的苏联T-34和KV坦克时。<cr>“快速军”最初在巴巴罗萨行动初期被编入喀尔巴阡集团。由于无法跟上“快速军”的步伐，“喀尔巴阡集团”被解散。“快速军”随后被编入南方集团军群。1941年8月，匈牙利机械化军是乌曼战役的关键参与者。‘快速军’代表了钳形攻势的一半，包围了第6苏军集团军和第12苏军集团军。<cr>德军第16装甲师则代表了钳形攻势的另一半。1941年8月3日，钳形攻势的两部分会合，第6集团军和第12集团军被包围。<cr>超过10万苏联士兵被俘虏。<cr><cr>即使胜利也给匈牙利带来了沉重代价。在1941年夏天，‘快速军’变得越来越弱。相比之下，撤退中的苏军集团军并没有变得更弱，反而似乎变得更加强大。<cr><cr>意识到整体情况后，匈牙利摄政米克洛什霍尔蒂元帅和匈牙利的政治领导层试图让疲惫的‘快速军’士兵获得释放。亲德的总参谋长亨里克·韦特少校于1941年9月5日被中将费伦茨·索姆拜莱伊取代。<cr>与支持德国在俄罗斯进攻的韦特不同，索姆拜莱伊认为匈牙利军队应该只用于保卫匈牙利边境。索姆拜莱伊毫不犹豫地向德军传达了这一观点。为了迫使德军释放‘快速军’，索姆拜莱伊没有更换该军失去的装甲车辆、人员运输车和卡车。<cr>即便如此，德国人仍然继续使用这支虚弱的匈牙利机械化军。<cr><cr>通常情况下，德国指挥官很少给匈牙利军队独立行动的空间。然而，‘快速军’的指挥官布拉·达尔诺基-米克洛什少将至少有一次做出了独立决定。<cr>做出这个决定时，达尔诺基-米克洛什被迫违抗了德军元帅格尔德·冯·龙德施泰特直接下达的命令。<cr><cr>1941年10月19日，基辅战役结束后，德国第17集团军卡尔-海因里希·冯·斯图尔纳格尔将军正在从波尔塔瓦向沃罗希洛夫格勒推进。面对冯·斯图尔纳格尔的是第18苏军的部分部队。陆军元帅冯·伦斯特德命令冯·斯图尔纳格尔指示匈牙利机械化军突破他面前的俄罗斯防御工事。按照指示，斯图尔纳格尔命令达尔诺基-米克洛什攻击俄国防御并突破它们。<cr><cr>达尔诺基-米克洛什有许多事情要考虑。匈牙利机械化军只剩下六个营了。俄罗斯防御工事已经击退了40个德国营的进攻。在评估形势后，达尔诺基-米克洛什决定尝试除命令中的突破之外的方法。相反，达尔诺基-米克洛什计划并执行了一个机动，导致包围了俄国防御工事。<cr>结果是中和了一支强大的苏军部队，并为德国继续向沃罗希洛夫格勒推进打开了道路。<cr><cr>德军总参谋部（Groer Generalsstab）对匈牙利机械化军的杰出成就和战术胜利给予了高度赞扬。该机械化军在长达五个月的战役中作战，并覆盖了超过1,000英里的领土。<cr><cr>然而，这些胜利的代价再次过高。不仅仅是机械化军自身损失惨重，整个匈牙利国家也承受不起这样的代价。对于一个像匈牙利这样规模的国家来说，这种损失是巨大的。到1941年底，已有超过200名军官和2500多名士兵阵亡。另有1500多名匈牙利军人失踪。至少还有7500人受伤。物资损失也很严重：超过1200辆人员输送车、30架飞机、28门火炮、100%的L3坦克车、80%的Toldi坦克和90%的装甲汽车被摧毁。<cr>匈牙利快速军于1941年11月返回布达佩斯。<cr><cr><cr><cr><cr>

text: The Fallschirm-Panzerkorps Hermann Gring was created in 1944 through the combination of the Fallschirm-Panzer-Division 1. Hermann Gring and Fallschirm-Panzergrenadier Division 2. Herman Gring.<cr>The Fallschirm-Panzerkorps Hermann Gring was activated in early October 1944, and the Hermann Gring Panzer Division, along with its sister division, Fallschirm-Panzergrenadier Division 2 Hermann Gring, was transferred to the command of the corps. The Panzerkorps was then transferred to the East Prussia-Kurland region to halt the Soviet offensive which had already achieved the isolation of Army Group North in the Courland Pocket and was now aimed at the capture of East Prussia. The Panzerkorps was involved in heavy defensive fighting near Gumbinnen, and when the Soviet assault petered out in late November, the Panzerkorps set up static defensive lines.<cr>The massive Soviet Vistula-Oder Offensive trapped the Hermann Gring Panzerkorps in the Heiligenbeil Pocket along with the rest of the 4th Army. In February, the Grossdeutschland Panzergrenadier Division was attached to the corps.<cr>Despite several breakout attempts, the Panzerkorps had to be evacuated by sea to Swinemnde in Pomerania. Upon landing, it was thrown back into combat, defending the Oder-Neisse line against Soviet attacks through mid-March. To bolster the corps' strength, the elite Brandenburg Panzergrenadier Division was attached to the unit.<cr>In April, the remnants of the Hermann Gring Panzerkorps was sent to Silesia, and in heavy fighting was slowly pushed back into Saxony. On April 22, the Fallschirm-Panzer-Division 1. Hermann Gring was one of two divisions that broke through the inter-army boundary of the Polish 2nd Army (Polish People's Army or LWP) and the Soviet 52nd Army, in an action near Bautzen, destroying parts of their communications and logistics trains and severely damaging the Polish (LWP) 5th Infantry Division and 16th Tank Brigade before being stopped two days later.<cr>By early May, the Panzerkorps was positioned near the Saxon capitol of Dresden. The remains of the corps began breakout attempts to the west, in order to surrender to the Americans who were currently halted on the Elbe. Despite valiant breakout attempts, the corps was encircled, and although several small groups successfully made it through to the west, the majority of the corps surrendered to the Soviets on 8 May 1945.<cr><cr>
translation: 伞兵装甲集群赫尔曼·戈林于1944年通过合并伞兵装甲师第1“赫尔曼·戈林”和伞兵装甲掷弹兵师第2“赫尔曼·戈林”组建而成。<cr>伞兵装甲集群赫尔曼·戈林在1944年10月初被激活，该集群指挥了赫尔曼·戈林装甲师及其姊妹部队伞兵装甲掷弹兵师第2“赫尔曼·戈林”。随后，装甲集群被转移到东普鲁士-库尔兰地区以阻止苏联进攻，该攻势已经孤立北方集团军群于库尔兰包围圈，并且现在目标是占领东普鲁士。装甲集群在古姆宾嫩附近进行了激烈的防御作战，在11月下旬苏军突击结束后，装甲集群建立了静态防御线。<cr>庞大的苏联维斯瓦-奥得进攻将赫尔曼·戈林装甲集群困于海利根贝伊尔包围圈内，与第4集团军其余部队一同被困。2月，大德意志装甲掷弹兵师被编入该集群。<cr>尽管进行了多次突围尝试，但装甲集群最终不得不通过海上撤离到波美拉尼亚的施韦特尼茨。登陆后，它又被投入战斗，在3月中旬之前防御奥得-尼斯防线以抵御苏军进攻。为了增强集群实力，精英勃兰登堡装甲掷弹兵师被编入该单位。<cr>四月，赫尔曼·戈林装甲集群的残部被调往西里西亚，在激烈的战斗中逐渐撤退至萨克森。4月22日，空降-装甲师第1“赫尔曼·戈林”师与其他一个师一起突破了波兰第二集团军（波兰人民军或LWP）和苏联第52集团军之间的交界地带，在巴特津附近采取行动，摧毁了部分通信和后勤列车，并严重破坏了波兰（LWP）第5步兵师和第16坦克旅。到五月初，装甲集群部署在萨克森首府德累斯顿附近。该部开始向西突围，以向当时停在易北河的美军投降。尽管进行了英勇的突围尝试，但该部被包围了，虽然有几个小单位成功突破到了西方，但大部分部队于1945年5月8日向苏联投降。<cr>指挥官报告：赫尔曼·戈林装甲集群在战争结束前的最后一战中遭受重创。

text: The I Army Corps was deactivated in April 1941 before the start of Operation Barbarossa. It was reactivated in Hungary in August of 1944 and assigned to the Hungarian Second Army. In November 1944 it was assigned to the Third Hungarian Army during the Siege of Budapest. The I Corps was destroyed and disbanded in February 1945.<cr><cr>Charles D. Pettibone, The Organization and Order of Battle of Militaries in World War II Volume VII - Germany's and Imperial Japan's Allies & Puppet States<cr><cr><cr>Entry courtesy Chris Munson
translation: 第1集团军群在巴巴罗萨行动开始前于1941年4月被解散。该部队于1944年8月在匈牙利重新激活，并分配给匈牙利第二集团军。1944年11月，它又被分配给第三匈牙利集团军，在布达佩斯围城战期间作战。第1集团军群于1945年2月被消灭并解散。<cr><cr>Charles D. Pettibone, 第二次世界大战中军事组织与战斗序列第七卷 - 德国盟友及傀儡政权<cr><cr><cr>Chris Munson 提供

text: The I Army Corps (home station Craiova) was attached to the First Romanian Army and did not participate in the inital stages of Operation Barbarossa. It was later attached to the Romanian 3rd Army and in November of 1942 on the eve of the Battle of Stalingrad in which it became heavily engaged it consisted of the 7th Infantry and 11th Infantry Divisions. It was disbanded in December of 1944.<cr><cr>Charles D. text: The II Army Corps was attached to the Italian 1st Army when Italy declared war on France in June of 1940. The Corps participated in the Italian invasion of France. In the summer of 1942 the Corps was sent to the Eastern Front with the 8th Army, or Italian Army in Russia as part of the expansion of the Italian Expeditionary Corps in Russia. Attached to the Corps were the 2nd Sforzesca, 3rd Ravenna, and 5th Cosseria mountain infantry divisions. The Corps found itself, along with the rest of the 8th Army, stretched along a 160 mile section of the Don River between the Hungarian Second Army and Romanian 3rd Army on the German left flank at the start of Operation Little Saturn. The Corps received the brunt of the inital Russian attacks and despite being heavily outnumbered managed to hold the onslaught for over a week before retreating with heavy casualties. The Corps was severely mauled in the subsequent winter fighting with some units being surrounded or completely destroyed. The Corps returned to Italy with the rest of the 8th Army after February 1943.<cr><cr><cr>Entry courtesy Chris Munson
translation: 第2集团军 corps 在1940年6月意大利对法国宣战时隶属于意大利第1集团军。该军参与了意大利入侵法国的行动。1942年夏季，该军随同第8集团军（即在俄罗斯作战的意大利远征军）被派往东线，作为意大利远征军在俄罗斯扩张的一部分。该军下辖第2索福塞卡、第3拉文纳和第5科瑟里亚山地步兵师。在“小土星行动”开始时，该军连同第8集团军的其余部分被部署在匈牙利第2集团军与罗马尼亚第3集团军之间的顿河160英里地段上，在德国左翼。该军承受了最初的苏联攻势的主要打击，并且尽管严重处于劣势，仍成功抵御了一周多的时间才被迫撤退并遭受重大伤亡。随后的冬季战斗中，该军受到重创，部分部队被包围或完全消灭。第8集团军在1943年2月之后返回意大利时，该军也随同返回。<cr> <cr> <cr> 入库感谢克里斯·芒森

text: The Kalinin Front was a major formation of the Red Army active in the Eastern Front of World War II. It was formally established by Stavka directive on 17 October 1941 and allocated three armies: 22nd, 29th and 30th. In May 1942, the Air Forces of the Kalinin Front were reorganised as the 3rd Air Army, comprising three fighter, two ground attack, and one bomber division.<cr>In November 1942 the Kalinin Front, along with the Soviet Western Front, launched Operation Mars against the German defenses in the Rzhev-Vyaz'ma salient . The 3rd Shock Army, now allocated to Kalinin Front, started the operation on 24 November by attacking 3rd Panzer Army at Velikiye Luki, and the next day the Kalinin and Western Fronts assaulted the entire perimeter of the Rzhev salient. The offensive involved the 41st, 22nd, 39th Army, 31st, 20th, and 29th Armies from both Fronts. The Front was then involved in the Battle of Velikiye Luki in January-March 1943. The 3rd Air Army supported both the Rzhev-Sychevka and the Velikiye Luki operations, but then appears to have been shifted to Northwestern Front briefly to cover the Demiyansk bridgehead.<cr>During the Nevel-Haradok operation, from 6 October31 December 1943, the Front (which changed names halfway through) consisted of 3rd and 4th Shock, 11th Guards and 43rd Armies, plus the 3rd Air Army. Its initial strength was 198,000 men. The losses amounted to 43,551 dead and missing and 125,351 wounded and sick.<cr>It was renamed the 1st Baltic Front in October 1943.<cr><cr>https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kalinin_Front

text: The Karelian Army (Finnish: Karjalan armeija) was a Finnish army during the Continuation War.<cr>Army of Karelia was formed on 29 June 1941 soon after the start of the Continuation War.<cr>The army was organised in two corps and one separate group. The corps consisted of a total of 5 infantry divisions. The Cavalry Brigade and the 1st and 2nd Jger Brigades were organised into Group O. Also, the German 163rd Infantry Division was later added to the army.<cr>On July 10 the Army started its offensive against East Karelia, north of Lake Ladoga. The aim was to reclaim the areas lost to the Soviet Union in the Winter War, but also to advance deeper in to Soviet territory to gain a more easily defensible front.<cr>On the north flank the army was supported by the independent 14th Division and to the south by forces on the Karelian Isthmus.<cr>The army's advance was rapid due to the use of light jger troops. The capital of Karelia Petrozavodsk was taken in October and promptly renamed to the poetic nislinna. During the autumn of 1941 the army took positions along the river Svir between lakes Ladoga and Onega. Medvezhegorsk was taken in December.<cr>After the offensive phase of the war ended, Army of Karelia was disbanded and its HQ became HQ of Aunus Group.<cr><cr>
translation: 卡累利阿集团军（芬兰语：Karjalan armeija）是芬蘭在繼續戰爭期间的一支军队。<cr>卡累利阿集团军于1941年6月29日，在继续战争开始不久后成立。<cr>该集团军由两个军和一个独立小组组成，其中两军共辖5个步兵师。骑兵旅以及第1、第2猎兵旅被编入奥组。此外，德军第163步兵师后来也被加入到该集团军中。<cr>7月10日，集团军开始向东卡累利阿发起进攻，在拉多加湖以北地区作战。目标是收复在冬季战争期间失去的领土，并进一步深入苏联境内，以便获得一个更容易防守的前线。<cr>在北部战线上，该集团军得到了独立第14师的支持；而在南部，则有卡累利阿地峡地区的部队提供支援。<cr>由于轻装猎兵部队的使用，该集团军推进迅速。卡累利阿首府彼得罗扎沃茨克于10月被占领，并立即改名为诗意的名字“米列尔纳”。在1941年秋季，该集团军沿拉多加湖和奥涅加湖之间的斯维里河一线部署。梅德韦日戈尔斯克于12月被占领。<cr>战事进攻阶段结束后，卡累利阿集团军解散，其司令部成为奥努斯小组的司令部。<cr>

text: The Kharkov Military District was originally created in 1919. In the Soviet Union, a military district was a territorial association of military units, formations, military schools, and various local military administrative establishments. This territorial division type was utilised in the USSR to provide a more efficient management of army units, their training and other operations activities related to combat readiness. The number of military districts varied depending on the circumstances and with the evolution of the Soviet Army. Before Operation Barbarossa there were 16 military districts and one front although this number fluctuated and as many as 25 military districts existed at different time before the war.<cr>The District was disbanded at the end of 1941 and was reformed in September 1943. In Jun 1946 it was disbanded and amalgamated into the Kiev Military District as the 21st Army.<cr><cr><cr>Entry courtesy NOSB
translation: 哈尔科夫军区最初创建于1919年。在苏联，一个军区是军事单位、编成单位、军事学校和各种地方军事行政机构的地域性联合体。这种领土划分类型被用于苏联以更高效地管理军队单位、训练和其他与战备相关的活动。根据情况的变化以及苏军的发展，军区的数量有所不同。巴巴罗萨行动之前有16个军区和一个方面军，尽管这个数字有所波动，在战争爆发前曾有多达25个军区存在过。<cr>该军区在1941年底被解散，并于1943年9月重组。1946年6月，它再次被解散并合并到基辅军区作为第21集团军。<cr><cr><cr>词条由NOSB提供

text: On May 17, 1935 the Ukrainian Military District was split between the Kharkov Military District and the Kiev Military District.<cr>13th Rifle Corps was reformed in the district in accordance with a District order of December 1936, and its headquarters was established at Belaya Tserkov.<cr>On July 26, 1939 the district was renamed into the Kiev Special Military District.<cr>On February 20, 1941, the district formed the 22nd Mechanized Corps [which had 527 tanks] in the 5th Army, the 16th Mechanized Corps [which had 372 tanks] in the 12th Army, and the 9th Mechanized Corps [had 94 tanks], the 24th Mechanized Corps [which had 56 tanks], the 15th Mechanized Corps [which had 707 tanks], and the 19th Mechanized Corps [had 274 tanks] in the reserve of the district.<cr>When the German Operation Barbarossa began on 22 June 1941, on the base of the Kiev Special Military District was created the Soviet Southwestern Front that on September 10, 1941 completely integrated the district.<cr>The District was formed again on 25 October 1943, with the Headquarters in Kiev. In June 1946, 7 oblasts [provinces] of the disbanded Kharkov Military District were added to the Kiev Military District. The District now included the oblasts of Kiev, Cherkasy, Uman, Voroshilovgrad, Dnipropetrovsk, Poltava, Stalin, Sumy, Kharkiv and Chernihiv.<cr><cr>

text: The Kursk Front was set up on March 23, 1943, following a STAVKA directive of March 19 by re-purposing the command cadre of Reserve Front to defend the westernmost sector of the Kursk Salient. It consisted of 38th Army, 60th Army, and 15th Air Army, with another field army to be assigned, probably either the 63rd or 66th. Col. Gen. Max Reyter was appointed to command, with Maj. Gen. I.Z. Susaikov as member of the military council and Lt. Gen. Leonid Sandalov as chief of staff. The new Front was very short lived. Another Stavka directive on March 24 transformed Kursk Front into the new Orel Front, to be established by March 27. At the same time, 60th Army was transferred to Central Front, and 38th to Voronezh Front. Finally, on March 28, Oryol Front was ordered to be renamed as the new Bryansk Front.<cr><cr>
translation: 库尔斯克方面军于1943年3月23日根据最高统帅部大本营3月19日的指令建立，重组预备方面军的指挥人员以防御库尔斯克突出部最西端的区域。该方面军包括第38集团军、第60集团军和第15空军集团军，并将分配另一个野战集团军，可能是第63集团军或第66集团军。马克斯·雷特尔上将被任命为指挥官，伊万·苏萨依科夫中将担任军事委员会成员，列昂尼德·桑达尔洛夫少将任参谋长。新方面军存在时间非常短暂。最高统帅部大本营于3月24日发布另一指令，将库尔斯克方面军改组为新的奥廖尔方面军，并要求在3月27日前建立。同时，第60集团军被转移到中央方面军，而第38集团军则转到沃罗涅日方面军。最后，在3月28日，奥廖尔方面军被命令更名为新的布良斯克方面军。<cr><cr><cr><cr>

text: The Leningrad Front was formed during the 1941 German approach on Leningrad (now Saint Petersburg) by dividing the Northern Front into the Leningrad Front and Karelian Front on August 27, 1941. The Leningrad Front was immediately given the task of containing the German drive towards Leningrad and defending the city from the approaching Army Group North. By September 1941 German forces were effectively stopped on the outskirts of Leningrad which began the the two-and-a-half-year-long Siege of Leningrad. Although Finnish forces to the north stopped at the old FinnishSoviet border, the Leningrad front suffered severe losses on the Finnish Front. From September 8, 1941, soldiers of the front were forced to conduct operations under the conditions of a blockade, with very little supply. Some supplies did reach the city however via the lake Road of Life.<cr>During the seige, the Front executed various offensive and defensive operations, until finally with the help of the Baltic and Volkhov Front, the blockade was lifted. From June 1942, Leonid Govorov had been the commander of the front, and in June 1944, he was awarded the title Marshal of the Soviet Union. In January 1943, forces of the Leningrad front made their first advances in years when they took the town of Shlisselburg from German forces, thus restoring communications between Leningrad and the rest of the country. In mid and late January 1944 the Leningrad front, along with the Volkhov Front, the 1st Baltic Front and the 2nd Baltic Front, pushed back Army Group North and broke the 28-month-long seige. Several days later, these forces would completely liberate all of the Leningrad Oblast and Kalinin Oblast. Six months later the Leningrad Front took Narva.<cr>In April 1944, parts of the Leningrad Front were broken off to create the 3rd Baltic Front. In June 1944 the Leningrad Front, along with the Baltic Fleet successfully carried out the Vyborg operation. As a result of which Finland would later leave the German side of the war. From September to November 1944 the Front participated in the Baltic Offensive, advanced towards Narva-Tartu and then towards Tallinn. Following the capture of continental Estonia, elements of the Front, along with the Baltic Fleet, took part in the recapture of the Moonsund archipelago. These were the last offensive operations for the Rront. The Front was stationed on the Soviet-Finnish border and along the Baltic coast from Leningrad to Riga. Later, the Leningrad Front was reinforced with elements of the recently disbanded 2nd Baltic Front. These forces were primarily stationed near the Courland Pocket with the task of containing German Army Group Courland which continued to resist Soviet forces up until the end of war in Europe. On June 24, 1945, the Leningrad front was reorganized into the Leningrad Military District.<cr><cr><cr>Entry courtesy NOSB
translation: 列宁格勒方面军是在1941年德国军队逼近列宁格勒（现圣彼得堡）时，于1941年8月27日从北方方面军中分出成立的。列宁格勒方面军立即被赋予阻止德军向列宁格勒推进并防御来自北方集团军群威胁的任务。到1941年9月，德国军队在列宁格勒外围被有效阻挡，开始了长达两年半的列宁格勒围城战。尽管芬兰军队在北部停止于旧芬苏边界处，但列宁格勒方面军在与芬兰军队交战中遭受了严重损失。<cr>从1941年9月8日起，前线士兵被迫在封锁条件下作战，补给非常有限。然而，部分物资还是通过湖上的“生命之路”抵达城市。<cr><cr>在整个围城期间，方面军执行了一系列进攻和防御行动，最终在波罗的海方面军、沃尔霍夫方面军的帮助下解除了封锁。<cr>从1942年6月起，列昂尼德·戈沃罗夫成为该方面的指挥官，并于1944年6月被授予苏联元帅称号。1943年1月，列宁格勒方面军部队在数年内首次取得进展，从德国军队手中夺回了施利谢尔堡镇，从而恢复了与全国其他地区的联系。<cr>1944年1月中旬和下旬，列宁格勒方面军、沃尔霍夫方面军、第一波罗的海方面军和第二波罗的海方面军联手将北方集团军群击退，并结束了长达28个月的围城战。几天后，这些部队完全解放了整个列宁格勒州和加里宁州。<cr>六个月后，列宁格勒方面军攻占了纳尔瓦。<cr><cr>1944年4月，列宁格勒方面军的部分部队被划出组建了第3波罗的海方面军。6月，列宁格勒方面军与波罗的海舰队成功实施了维堡行动。芬兰随后退出了德国一方。从9月至11月，该方面军参与了波罗的海攻势，推进至纳尔瓦-塔尔图，然后是塔林。占领大陆爱沙尼亚后，部分部队和波罗的海舰队参加了重新夺回月亮岛群岛的行动。这些是该方面军最后的进攻行动。列宁格勒方面军驻扎在苏芬边境以及从列宁格勒到里加的波罗的海沿岸地区。之后，列宁格勒方面军得到了最近解散的第2波罗的海方面军部队的支持，主要部署在库尔兰包围圈附近，任务是围困继续抵抗苏联军队直至欧洲战争结束的德国库尔兰集团军群。1945年6月24日，列宁格勒方面军重组为列宁格勒军区。<cr>资料来源：NOSB

text: On 22 June 1941 the District comprised the 7th Army, the 14th Army, the 23rd Army, the 1st Mechanized Corps, 177th Rifle Division, 191st Rifle Division, 8th Rifle Division, the 21st, 22nd, 25th, 29th Fortified Regions, Air Forces (six aviation divisions, including the 1st, 2nd, 5th, 39th, 41st, and 55th), and other formations and units.<cr>Two days after the German invasion of the Soviet Union, on 24 June 1941, the District was reorganised as the Northern Front, and two months later, on 23 August 1941, it was split into the Leningrad and Karelian Fronts. The Fronts forces heroic efforts played a major part in resisting the German attacks during the Siege of Leningrad.<cr>By the joint efforts of troops of the Leningrad Front, Volkhov Front, and the 2nd Baltic Front during January 1944 the enemy was routed from the environs of Leningrad and Novgorod. Pressing home the attack, the forces of the Leningrad Front in summer and in the fall of 1944 helped seize Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. The Front was reorganized under the Leningrad District into a peacetime status on 9 July 1945. Marhal Leonid Govorov took command shortly afterwards.<cr><cr>
translation: 1941年6月22日，该区包括第7集团军、第14集团军、第23集团军、第1机械化军、第177步兵师、第191步兵师、第8步兵师、第21、22、25和29要塞区以及空军（六个航空师，包括第1、第2、第5、第39、第41和第55航空师）和其他部队。<cr>在德国入侵苏联两天后的1941年6月24日，该区重组为北方方面军，并于两个月后，在1941年8月23日分为列宁格勒方面军和卡累利阿方面军。这些方面军的英勇努力在列宁格勒围城战中抵抗德国攻击时发挥了重要作用。<cr>通过列宁格勒方面军、沃尔霍夫方面军以及第2波罗的海方面军在1944年1月的共同努力，敌人被逐出列宁格勒和诺夫哥罗德周边地区。继续发动攻势，在1944年的夏季和秋季，列宁格勒方面军帮助占领了爱沙尼亚、拉脱维亚和立陶宛。该方面军于1945年7月9日重组为列宁格勒区的和平时期编制，并由马尔夏尔列昂尼德·戈沃罗夫不久后接管指挥权。<cr><cr>

text: Luftflotte 1 (Air Fleet 1) was one of the primary divisions of the German Luftwaffe in World War II. It was formed 1 February 1939 from Luftwaffengruppenkommando 1 in Berlin. This Luftwaffe detachment served in Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania and Immola, Finland for air support of Axis forces in area; with command offices in Malpils, Latvia, (26 June 1944), Eastern Front.<cr><cr>
translation: 第一航空队是德国空军在第二次世界大战中的主要部队之一。它成立于1939年2月1日，由柏林的第1空军集团军指挥部组建而成。该空军部队曾在爱沙尼亚、拉脱维亚、立陶宛和芬兰的伊莫拉为轴心国军队提供空中支援；其指挥办公室位于拉脱维亚马尔皮尔斯（1944年6月26日），在东线方面军内。<cr><cr><cr>

text: Luftflotte 2 (Air Fleet 2) was one of the primary divisions of the German Luftwaffe in World War II. It was formed 1 February 1939 in Braunschweig and transferred to Italy on 15 November 1941. The Luftflotte was disbanded on 27 September 1944.<cr><cr>
translation: 第二航空队是德国空军在第二次世界大战中的主要部队之一。该部队成立于1939年2月1日的不伦瑞克，并于1941年11月15日转移到意大利。<cr>解散于1944年9月27日。<cr>

text: Luftflotte 4 (Air Fleet 4) was one of the primary divisions of the German Luftwaffe in World War II. It was formed on March 18, 1939, from Luftwaffenkommando sterreich in Vienna. The Luftflotte was redesignated on 21 April 1945, to Luftwaffenkommando 4, and became subordinated to Luftflotte 6. It was the Luftflotte 4, which was responsible for the bombing campaign of Stalingrad, where ca. 40000 civilians died. This Luftwaffe Detachment was based in Romania, Bulgaria, Southeast Poland, Hungary, Ukraine and Russian occupied territories, for supporting Axis forces; with command offices in Morczyn, Hungary, during 26 June 1944, Eastern Front.<cr><cr>
translation: 第四航空队是德国空军在第二次世界大战中的主要部队之一。它成立于1939年3月18日，由维也纳的奥地利空军指挥部组建而成。该航空队于1945年4月21日重新指定为第4空军指挥部，并隶属于第六航空队。正是第四航空队负责对斯大林格勒进行轰炸行动，在此过程中约有40000名平民死亡。这支空军部队驻扎在罗马尼亚、保加利亚、东南波兰、匈牙利、乌克兰和被占领的俄罗斯领土，以支持轴心国军队；其指挥办公室位于1944年6月26日到东线期间的匈牙利莫尔钦。<cr><cr><cr>

text: Luftflotte 6 (Air Fleet 6) was one of the primary divisions of the German Luftwaffe in World War II. It was formed on May 5, 1943 from Luftwaffenkommando Ost in Central Russia (Smolensk). The Luftwaffe units listed here were detached in Belarus, East Poland, East Prussia, Ukraine, Slovakia and in Russian-occupied lands for air support of Axis forces in the sector; with command offices in Pryluky and Belarus during June 26, 1944 within the Eastern Front.<cr><cr>
translation: 第六航空队是德国空军在第二次世界大战中的主要部队之一。它成立于1943年5月5日，由位于俄罗斯中部（斯摩棱斯克）的东线空军指挥部组建而成。这里列出的空军单位被派往白俄罗斯、波兰东部、普鲁士东部、乌克兰、斯洛伐克以及苏联占领区，为轴心国部队提供空中支援；指挥机构设在普里卢基和白俄罗斯，时间为1944年6月26日，在东线方面军的范围内。<cr><cr>

text: The LVI was formed in Bad Salzuflen, Wehrkreis VI, as a motorized corps. It became a panzer corps on March I, 1942. It crossed into the Soviet Union on June 22, 1941, and served primarily on the central sector. It escaped the disaster at Bobruisk (June-July 1944), but was smashed when the Russians broke out of the Baranov bridgehead on the Vistula in January 1945. It was chosen to defend Berlin in the last weeks of the war, which it valiantly attempted to do, but without success. Hitler committed suicide on April 30, 1945, and the LVI Panzer surrendered on May 2. Many of its men, including its last commander, died in Soviet prison camps.<cr><cr>The Panzer Legions A Guide to the German Army Tank Divisions of World War II and Their Commanders, Samuel W. Mitcham Jr.
translation: 第66摩托化军于1942年3月1日改编为装甲军。该部队于1941年6月22日进入苏联境内，并主要在中央战区作战。它幸免于鲍里斯克（1944年6月至7月）的灾难，但在1945年1月苏军从维斯杜拉河畔巴诺夫桥头堡突破时遭到重创。该部队被选中在战争最后几周保卫柏林，尽管英勇尝试但未能成功。希特勒于1945年4月30日自杀，第66装甲军于5月2日投降。许多士兵包括其最后一任指挥官，在苏联战俘营中丧生。<cr>德军装甲军团：二战德国陆军坦克师及其指挥官指南<cr>萨缪尔·W·米查姆 Jr.

text: The LVII was formed as a motorized corps in Augsburg, Wehrkreis VII, on February 15, 1941. It was upgraded to a panzer corps on June 21, 1942. It spent four years on the Eastern Front, taking part in the drive on Moscow, the Caucasus campaign, the retreat to the Dnieper, and the Hungarian and Silesian campaigns. It ended the war with the 4th Panzer Army on the Eastern Front.<cr><cr>The Panzer Legions A Guide to the German Army Tank Divisions of World War II and Their Commanders, Samuel W. Mithcham Jr.
translation: LVII摩托化军于1941年2月15日在德国第七军区的奥格斯堡成立。该部队在1942年6月21日升级为装甲军。它在东线服役了四年，参与了进攻莫斯科、高加索战役、撤退至第聂伯河以及匈牙利和西里西亚战役。战争结束时，它隶属于第四装甲集团军，在东线作战。<cr>指挥官报告:<cr>《装甲军团：二战德军坦克师及其指挥官指南》，萨缪尔·W·米奇姆 Jr.

text: The Moscow Military District was a military district of the Soviet Armed Forces in World War II. During World War II the District formed three fronts, 23 armies, 128 divisions of all arms, 197 brigades of all arms for an approximate total of 4.5 million men. In 19445 alone the District sent 1,200,000 soldiers to the front. From summer 1945 to summer 1946, in order to supervise the demobilisation process, the District was subdivided into four: the Moscow, Voronezh, Gorki and Smolensk Military Districts.<cr><cr><cr>Entry courtesy NOSB

text: The vnatori de munte, English translation: Mountain Huntsmen) are the elite mountain troops of the Romanian Land Forces. They were first established as an independent Army Corps in 1916 during World War I, and became operational in 1917 under Corpul de Munte designation.<cr><cr>The Romanian vn?tori de munte saw action in World War II on the Eastern Front in some of the harshest battles - including the sieges of Sevastopol and Stalingrad - where their performance lived up to their reputation: virtually all their commanders from brigade level and up received the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross, with general Mihail Lascar being the first foreigner to receive Oak Leaves on 22 November 1942. After 23 August 1944, they fought on the Soviet side, notably in Tatra Mountains.<cr><cr>
translation: 山地猎兵是罗马尼亚地面部队的精锐山地部队。他们在第一次世界大战期间首次于1916年作为独立集团军组建，并在1917年以“山地军团”名义开始运作。<cr>第二次世界大战中，他们参加了东线一些最艰苦的战斗——包括塞瓦斯托波尔和斯大林格勒的围攻——他们的表现不负盛名：几乎所有旅级及以上的指挥官都获得了骑士十字勋章，其中米哈伊·拉扎尔将军于1942年11月22日成为首位获得橡叶饰章的外国人。1944年8月23日后，他们转而与苏联并肩作战，在塔特拉山脉等地参战。<cr><cr>

text: The North Caucasus Front describes either of two distinct organizations during the war. The first formation was created on May 20, 1942 and was commanded by Marshal Semyon Budyonny throughout its existence. 1st Rifle Corps reappeared in the Soviet OOB on 1 June 1942 directly subordinated to the North Caucausus Front, and made up of four rifle brigades.<cr>The Front incorporated forces from the (disbanded) Crimean Front and received additional forces from the (disbanded) Southern Front on July 28, 1942.<cr>On September 1, 1942 the Front was reorganized as the Black Sea Group of Forces and assigned to the Transcaucasus Front during the German occupation of the Krasnodar Krai.<cr>The second formation of this Front was created on January 24, 1943 from the Northern Group of Forces in the Transcaucasian Front (located in the eastern Caucasus), and reintegrated the Black Sea Group of Forces on February 5, 1943. Lieutenant General Ivan Maslennikov, who was promoted to Colonel General in January 1943, initially took command. He handed over to Lieutenant General Ivan Petrov, in May 1943, and Petrov was then promoted to Colonel General in August.<cr>At the time of the Battle of Kursk in August 1943, during the long series of engagements known as the Battle of the Caucasus, the Transcaucasian Front included the Black Sea Group of Forces consisting of the 46th, 18th Desant, 47th, 56th Armies, and the 5th Air Army as well as the 13th and 16th Separate Rifle Corps. The Northern Group of Forces commanded the 37th, 9th, 58th Army, 44th Armies, as well as a Cavalry Mechanized Group and the 10th Separate Rifle Corps. Additionally it commanded the Black Sea Fleet and the Baku Army of PVO.The Front was reorganized into the Separate Coastal Army on November 20, 1943 during the Kerch-Eltigen Operation, the Soviet amphibious crossing of the Sea of Azov.<cr><cr>
translation: 北高加索方面军在战争期间曾是两个不同的组织。第一个组建于1942年5月20日，由元帅谢苗·布琼尼统率直至解散。第1步兵军重新出现在苏联编制中，直接隶属于北高加索方面军，下辖四个步兵旅。<cr>该方面军吸纳了（已解散的）克里米亚方面军的部分力量，并于1942年7月28日从（已解散的）南方方面军接收增援部队。<cr>1942年9月1日，该方面军重组为黑海集团军群，并被分配给高加索方面军，以应对德国占领克拉斯诺达尔边疆区的情况。<cr>第二个组建于1943年1月24日的北高加索方面军是由高加索方面军中的北方集团军群建立的，并在1943年2月5日重新整合了黑海集团军群。最初由晋升为上将的伊万·马斯连尼科夫将军指挥，他于1943年5月将指挥权移交给伊万·彼得罗夫中将，后者则于同年8月晋升为上将。<cr>1943年8月库尔斯克战役期间，在被称为高加索战役的长期战斗系列中，外高加索方面军包括黑海集团部队，该部队由第46、第18空降、第47、第56集团军以及第5空军集团军组成，并且还包括第13和第16独立步兵军。北方集团部队指挥第37、第9、第58、第44集团军，还有一支机械化骑兵群和第10独立步兵军。此外，它还指挥黑海舰队和巴库防空集团军。该方面军在1943年11月20日刻赤—埃利季金行动期间重组为独立海岸集团军。<cr><cr><cr>

text: The North Caucasus Military District was a military district of the Soviet Union. The District was originally establishedin May 1918 and reorganised as a field formation during the Russian Civil War. The District was reformed in the early 1920s with its headquarters at Rostov. During the 1920s and 1930s the District became home to many training establishments, which were to multiply greatly during World War II.<cr>In June 1941 at the start of Operation Barbarossa the district's first line troops comprised the 64th Rifle Corps commanded by Major General A.D. Kuleshov with the 165th and 175th Rifle Divisions, the 26th Mechanised Corps with the 52nd and 56th Tank Divisions and the 203rd Mechanised Division, the 28th Mountain Rifle Division, and the 157th Rifle Division. The 19th Army which had formed in the District in MayJune 1941 under former district commander Ivan Konev and was engaged against the Germans from the beginning of Operation Barbarossa. 50th and 53rd Cavalry Divisions were also formed here, joining the Soviet Western Front.<cr>Later the District became the site of the battles around Rostov in November 1941 where the Germans suffered a defeat and the Battle of Stalingrad which has been described as the most ferocious battle to date. Following the conclusion of Caucasus Campaign the North Caucasian Front and the headquarters of the 56th Army were disbanded in accordance with a Supreme Command directive of November 20, 1943.<cr><cr><cr>Entry courtesy NOSB
translation: 北高加索军区是苏联的一个军区。该军区最初于1918年5月建立，并在俄国内战期间重新组建为野战部队。军区在20世纪20年代初进行了重组，司令部设在罗斯托夫。在20世纪20至30年代，军区内建立了许多训练机构，在第二次世界大战中这些机构的数量大幅增加。<cr>1941年6月巴巴罗萨行动开始时，该军区的一线部队包括由少将A.D.库列绍夫指挥的第64步兵军、第165师和第175师，以及拥有第52坦克师和第56坦克师的第26机械化军、第203机械化师、第28山地步兵师和第157步兵师。该军区在1941年5月组建了第19集团军，在伊万·科涅夫将军（前军区指挥官）的领导下，从巴巴罗萨行动开始就与德军作战。<cr>50骑兵团和53骑兵团也在该地区建立，并加入苏联西方方面军。<cr>后来，该军区成为1941年11月罗斯托夫战役以及斯大林格勒战役的战场。后者被认为是迄今为止最激烈的战斗之一。根据最高统帅部于1943年11月20日发布的指令，在高加索战役结束后解散了北高加索方面军和第56集团军司令部。<cr>词条由NOSB提供

text: To gear for the European war, Luftwaffe needed a high command equivalent to Army (Oberkommando des HeeresOKH) or Navy (Oberkommando der MarineOKM). Thus on 5 February 1935, Air Force Command (German:Oberkommando Der LuftwaffeOKL) was created.<cr>OKL like OKH or OKM reported to Supreme High Command of the Armed Forces(German: Oberkommando der Wehrmacht OKW). The OKW was answerable to Hitler for the operation command of the three branches of the armed forces. OKL was divided into forward Echelon (German: 1. Staffel) and rear echelon (German: 2. Staffel). The forward echelon moved with the theater of operations while rear echelon remained almost exclusively in Berlin.<cr>OKL was also the operational branch of the Luftwaffe. It was divided operationally into air fleets at a high level. Initially it was divided into four air fleets(German: Luftflotte) that were formed geographically and were numbered consecutively. Three more Luftflotten were added later on as German territorial expansion grew further. Each Luftflotte was a self-contained entity. The leader of each was in charge of overall air operations and Support activities. However a fighter leader (German: Jagdfliegerfhrer) was in charge of all the fighter operations and reported to the Luftflotte Leader.<cr><cr>
translation: 为了准备欧洲战争，德国空军需要一个类似于陆军总司令部（OKH）或海军的高级指挥机构。因此，在1935年2月5日成立了空军指挥部（OKL）。<cr>OKL像OKH和OKM一样向国防军最高统帅部（OKW）汇报。OKW对希特勒负责，协调三个武装力量分支的作战指挥。OKL分为前指（1. Staffel）和后指（2. Staffel）。前指随战区行动而移动，而后指则几乎全部驻扎在柏林。<cr>OKL也是空军的实际操作部门。它从高层上被划分为航空队。最初，它被划分为四个地理区域的航空队，并按顺序编号。随着德国领土扩张的进一步发展，又增加了三个航空队。每个航空队都是一个独立实体。每个航空队的指挥官负责所有空中行动和支援活动。然而，战斗机指挥官（Jagdfliegerführer）则负责所有的战斗机操作并向航空队指挥官汇报。<cr><cr>空军指挥部<cr><cr>前指随战区移动，后指驻柏林<cr><cr><cr><cr>

text: The Oberkommando des Heeres (OKH) was the Supreme High Command of the German Army. It was founded in 1935 as a part of Adolf Hitler's re-militarisation of the Third Reich. Its commander held the title Oberbefehlshaber des Heeres, Supreme High Commander of the Heer. From 1938 OKH was together with Oberkommando der Luftwaffe(OKL), Supreme High Command of the Air Force and Oberkommando der Marine (OKM), Supreme High Command of the Navy, formally subordinated to the Oberkommando der Wehrmacht (OKW), Supreme High Command of all Armed Forces (with exception of the Waffen-SS). During the war OKH had the responsibility of strategic planning of Armies and Army Groups, while the General Staff of the OKH managed operational matters. Each German Army also had an Armeeoberkommando (AOK). Until the German defeat at Moscow in December 1941, OKH and its staff was de facto the most important unit within the German war planning. Later OKW (Oberkommando der Wehrmacht, Supreme High Command of the Armed Forces) took over this position.<cr><cr>
translation: 陆军总司令部（OKH）是德军的最高统帅机构。它成立于1935年，作为阿道夫·希特勒重新武装第三帝国计划的一部分。其指挥官拥有“陆军最高统帅”的头衔。从1938年起，陆军总司令部与空军最高统帅部（OKL）和海军最高统帅部（OKM）一起，正式隶属于国防军最高统帅部（OKW），即所有武装力量的最高统帅部（不包括武装党卫军）。在战争期间，OKH负责集团军和集团军群的战略规划，而OKH总参谋部则管理作战事务。每个德军集团军也有一个集团军司令部（AOK）。直到1941年12月德国在莫斯科的失败之前，陆军总司令部及其人员实际上是德国战争计划中最重要的单位。后来国防军最高统帅部（OKW）接管了这一角色。<cr><cr> 指挥官报告 <cr>

text: After the German invasion of the Soviet Union on 22 June 1941, the 20th Army was formed in the district under the command of district commander Fyodor Remezov. Lieutenant General Pavel Kurochkin replaced Remezov, and was himself replaced by Lieutenant General Alexander Tyurin in July. The district also mobilized those eligible for military service, formed new units and formations, sent march battalions to the front, and expanded the network of hospitals and other rear services. 17 rifle divisions, five brigades, and eight reserve brigades were formed in the district after 22 June.<cr>On 2 October, German troops began Operation Typhoon, an offensive which aimed to capture Moscow. German tank troops quickly broke through Soviet lines and advanced deep into the Soviet rear. The 4th Panzer Division reached Orel on 3 October, surprising the military district's headquarters, which hastily left the city. Tyurin, district chief of staff P.E. Glinsky, and district commissar N.E. Yefimov were held responsible for the abandonment of Orel, with Tyurin sentenced to seven years of imprisonment, and Glinsky and Yefimov to five years. However, all three were later pardoned, demoted, and sent back to the front. The district headquarters was subsequently relocated to Yelets, Tambov, and Orenburg. With most of its territory under German occupation, the district was disbanded on 8 December and its remaining territory transferred to the Volga Military District. The headquarters of the Orel Military District was used to form the headquarters of the South Ural Military District in Orenburg on 26 November.<cr>The district was reformed on 21 August 1943, under the command of then-Major General Matvei Popov. It included troops in Kursk and Orel Oblasts, transferred from the Moscow Military District, and Voronezh Oblast, transferred from the Volga Military District. Despite its name, the district's third formation was headquartered in Voronezh. On 30 October, Tambov Oblast became part of the district after being transferred from the Volga Military District. In October, the district temporarily oversaw recently recaptured Gomel and Polesia Voblasts in eastern Belarus. From July 1944, the district included newly reestablished Bryansk Oblast. The district was tasked with restoring military commissariats in its territory, creating lines of communication with the front, forming march battalions for movement to the front, forming new units, and clearing mines from the territory of the district. Postwar, it became the Voronezh Military District on 9 July 1945.<cr><cr>
translation: 1941年6月22日德国入侵苏联后，第20集团军在弗拉基米尔·雷梅佐夫指挥的军区下组建。7月，帕维尔·库罗奇金中将接替了雷梅佐夫，并被亚历山大·图林中将取代。该军区动员适龄人员参军，组建新部队和编制，派遣行军队到前线，并扩大医院和其他后方服务网络。6月22日后，该军区共组建了17个步兵师、5个旅和8个预备旅。<cr>10月2日，德军开始台风行动，旨在攻占莫斯科。德国坦克部队迅速突破苏军防线，并深入苏联后方。第4装甲师于10月3日到达奥廖尔，令该军区司令部措手不及，后者匆忙离开城市。<cr>图林、军区参谋长P.E.格林斯基和军区政委N.E.叶菲莫夫因放弃奥廖尔而被追究责任。图林被判7年监禁，格林斯基和叶菲莫夫被判5年监禁。然而，三人后来均获赦免，并降职派回前线。<cr>该军区司令部随后迁至伊列茨克、坦博夫和奥伦堡。由于大部分领土被德军占领，该军区于12月8日解散，剩余领土划归伏尔加河军区管辖。<cr>11月26日，奥廖尔军区司令部在奥伦堡用于组建南乌拉尔军区司令部。该军区于1943年8月21日重组，由当时的少将马特维·波波夫指挥。它包括来自莫斯科军区的库尔斯克和奥廖尔州部队以及来自伏尔加河军区的沃罗涅日州部队。尽管名为该军区，其第三次组建总部设在沃罗涅日。10月30日，坦博夫州从伏尔加河军区转交给该军区。同年十月，该军区暂时负责最近收复的白俄罗斯东部戈梅利和波列西耶州。自1944年7月以来，该军区包括新成立的 Bryansk 州。该军区的任务是恢复其领土内的军事征兵处，在前线建立通信线路，组建行军营以向前线移动，组建新的部队，并清除其辖区内的地雷。战后，它于1945年7月9日成为沃罗涅日军区。<cr><cr>

text: The SS Police Division was formed from members of the German Order Police in October 1939. It was not transferred to the Waffen-SS until February 10, 1942, and was not designated a panzer grenadier unit until June 1943. It became the 4th SS Panzer Grenadier Division on October 22, 1943. Initially it consisted of the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd Police Infantry Regiments. After finishing training in February 1940, the division fought in the French campaign and took part in the invasion of Russia in June 1941. It never distinguished itself in combat to the degree its brother German Waffen-SS divisions did, although it performed creditably. It fought in all the major battles of Army Group North from June 1941 to May 1943, including Nevel, Luga, Lake Ilmen, Volkhov, and Lake Ladoga, where it suffered heavy casualties. The 4th SS performed security duties in the Protectorate (formerly Czechoslovakia) and Poland in the spring of 1943, before being transferred to Greece that summer. By September 1944, the unit was in Serbia, fighting Tito's partisans, before returning to action against the Russians in Hungary in October. The 4th SS fought in Pomerania and West Prussia, and as part of Army Group Vistula, was cut off in the Hela Peninsula by the Soviet advance on Berlin. It surrendered to the Russians on May 8, 1945, although some members of the division were attached to Army Group Steiner and managed to surrender to the Americans at the end of the war.<cr><cr>German Order of Battle Vol III - Panzer, Panzer Grenadier and Waffen SS Divisions in WWII, Samuel W. Mitcham Jr.
translation: 党卫军警察师于1939年10月由德国秩序警察成员组建。直到1942年2月10日才转交给武装党卫军，直至1943年6月才被指定为装甲掷弹兵部队。该部队在1943年10月22日正式成为第4装甲掷弹兵师。最初由第一、第二和第三警察步兵团组成。完成训练后于1940年2月，该师参加了法国战役，并参与了1941年6月入侵苏联的行动。尽管表现尚可，但其在战斗中的表现并未达到兄弟德国武装党卫军师团的程度。从1941年6月至1943年5月，它参加了北方集团军群的所有主要战役，包括内夫尔、卢加、伊利门湖、沃尔霍夫和拉多加湖，在这些战役中遭受了严重伤亡。第4装甲掷弹兵师在1943年春季执行保护区内（原捷克斯洛伐克）和波兰的治安任务后，于同年夏天被调往希腊。到1944年9月，该部队已在塞尔维亚与铁托游击队作战，并于10月返回匈牙利对抗苏联红军。第4装甲掷弹兵师在波美拉尼亚和西普鲁士地区作战，在维斯瓦集团军群中被切断在赫拉半岛，因苏军进攻柏林而无法撤退。该部队于1945年5月8日向苏联投降，尽管一些成员隶属于斯坦纳集团军群并在战争结束时向美军投降。<cr>Samuel W. Mitcham Jr., 德国二战装甲、装甲掷弹兵和武装党卫军师团战斗序列 第三卷

text: The Southeastern Front was formed on Aug. 5, 1942 out of parts of the Stalingrad Front, using the command elements from the 1st Tank Army and the disbanded Southern Front. The front's main aim was to prevent the German advance towards the Volga River and ward off the threat of a German encirclement of Stalingrad. For this purpose it included Soviet 52nd, 57th and 64th Armies. 28th and 62nd Armies and 8th Air Army were later added to the forces of the front.<cr>On Sept. 28 the Southeastern Front was disbanded; most of its forces became the new Stalingrad Front, whilst the former Stalingrad Front was renamed the Don Front.<cr><cr>
translation: 东南方面军成立于1942年8月5日，由斯大林格勒方面军的部分部队组建而成，并使用了第1坦克集团军和解散的南方方面军的指挥元素。该方面军的主要目标是阻止德国军队向伏尔加河推进，并防止德军对斯大林格勒形成包围圈的威胁。为此，它包括了苏联第52、57和64集团军。后来又加入了第28和62集团军以及第8空军集团军。<cr>1942年9月28日，东南方面军被解散；其大部分部队成为新的斯大林格勒方面军，而原来的斯大林格勒方面军则改名为顿河方面军。

text: The Southern Front was a Front a roughly Army group sized formation of the Soviet Army during the Second World War. The Southern Front directed military operations during the Soviet occupation of Bessarabia and Northern Bukovina in 1940 and was then disbanded. After the start of Operation Barbarossa the Southern Front was rapidly reformed on June 25, 1941 from the forces in the Moscow and Odessa Military Districts and included the 9th Army. It was commanded by General Ivan V. Tiulenev from June 1941 to August 1941. Lieutenant General Dmitri I. Ryabyshev took over on August 30, 1941 and held command until October 5th, when Colonel General Yakov Cherevichenko took command in December 1941. During 1941 the Front fought in the border battles in the southern Ukraine, defended Odessa, and then conducted the defense and successful counteroffensive at Rostov on Don.<cr>In 1942 the Front took part in the Donbass, Barvenko-Lozovaia, and Voronezh operations. The Front then suffered a notable failure at the Second Battle of Kharkov. The Front received additional forces from the disbanded Southwestern Front on in July 1942 and was formally disbanded on July 28, 1942 with its forces transferred to the North Caucasus Front.<cr><cr><cr>Entry courtesy NOSB
translation: 南方方面军是苏联在第二次世界大战期间编成的一个大致相当于集团军群规模的战役战略军团。该方面军于1940年指挥了苏占比萨拉比亚和北布科维纳的军事行动，随后被解散。巴巴罗萨行动开始后，南方方面军于1941年6月25日迅速重组，由莫斯科和敖德萨军区的力量组成，并包括第9集团军。从1941年6月至8月，该方面军由伊万·V·图里耶夫将军指挥；自1941年8月30日起至同年10月5日，由德米特里·I·利亚比舍夫中将接任指挥；之后从12月起则由雅科夫·切列维琴科上将接手。在1941年内，该方面军参与了南部乌克兰的边境战斗、保卫敖德萨，并在顿河畔罗斯托夫进行了防御和成功的反攻。<cr>1942年，南方方面军参加了顿巴斯、巴文科-洛佐瓦亚和沃罗涅日行动。该方面军随后在第二次哈尔科夫战役中遭遇了显著的失败。1942年7月，从解散的西南方向接收了增援部队，并于同年7月28日正式解散，其力量被转移到北高加索方面军。<cr>感谢NOSB提供资料

text: The Southwestern Front dates to the Imperial Russian Army during the First World War and later by the Soviet Federative Socialist Republic during the Russian Civil War, and finally by the Red Army during the Second World War. The Southwestern Front was on the main axis of attack by German Army Group South during Operation Barbarossa. The Front contained the Soviet 5th, 6th, 26th, and 12th Armies which were stationed on the frontier. The 16th and 19th Armies were in reserve behind the forward forces. These Front resisted the German invasion in the western Ukraine and its forces were largely surrounded and destroyed at the Battle of Uman and the Battle Kiev in August and September 1941.<cr>The Front was immediately re-established with new forces. In late 1941 during the period of the Battle of Moscow it was under the command of Marshal Timoshenko, and included from north to south the 40th, 21st, 38th and 6th Armies. It was formally disbanded on July 12, 1942 and the forces transferred to the Stalingrad Front and Southern Front. The Front was reformed from reserve armies in October 1942. It was renamed the 3rd Ukrainian Front in October 1943.<cr><cr><cr>Entry courtesy NOSB
translation: 西南方面军可以追溯到第一次世界大战期间的俄罗斯帝国军队，在俄国内战时期由苏维埃社会主义共和国继承，最终在第二次世界大战中成为红军的一部分。在巴巴罗萨行动期间，德国南方集团军群的主要攻击轴线就是针对这个方面军。该方面军编有苏联第5、第6、第26和第12集团军，这些部队驻扎在边境地区；第16和第19集团军则作为预备队部署于前线部队后方。这些部队抵抗了德国人在乌克兰西部的入侵，并在1941年8月和9月的乌曼战役和基辅保卫战中被大部分包围并消灭。<cr>方面军立即重组，重新组建新的部队。 1941年末，在莫斯科会战期间，该方面军由铁木辛哥元帅指挥，并从北向南编有第40、第21、第38和第6集团军。它于1942年7月12日正式解散，部队被转移到斯大林格勒方面军和南方方面军。<cr>该方面军在1942年10月从预备队中重新组建，并于1943年10月改名为第3乌克兰方面军。

text: The St. Laszlo Hungarian Guard Division was formed in October 1944. It was considered an elite division by the Hungarian Royal Army and consisted of a Parachute Assault regiment, a Grenadier (Royal Bodyguard and Gendarmerie) regiment and an Air Force Rifle regiment with each regiment consisting of two battalions. In September 1944 the division was part of the Third Hungarian Army defending Hungary's southern border. The division surrendered to the British 8th Army in Austria in early May 1945. However, the division was not immediately disarmed by the British as a precaution should it be needed against Yugoslavian Partisans. It was disbanded in June 1945.<cr><cr>Dr. Nigel Thomas and Lazlo Pal Szabo, The Royal Hungarian Army in World War II<cr><cr>Entry courtesy Chris Munson
translation:
圣拉斯洛匈牙利卫队师成立于1944年10月。该师被认为是匈牙利皇家陆军的精锐部队，由一个伞兵突击团、一个掷弹兵团（王室警卫和宪兵）以及一个空军步兵团组成，每个团下辖两个营。1944年9月，该师隶属于第三匈牙利集团军，在匈牙利南部边境进行防御作战。1945年5月初，该师在奥地利向英国第八集团军投降。然而，为了避免可能需要对抗南斯拉夫游击队的情况，英军并未立即解除其武装。该师于1945年6月解散。

text: By order of the STAVKA on July 12, 1942, Stalingrad Front was formed, under the command of Marshal S.K. Timoshenko, with N.S. Krushchev as member of the Military Council and Gen. P.I. Bodin as chief of staff. Ostensibly this was simply a renaming of the now-dissolved Southwestern Front, but in fact was a largely new formation, as the only effective units under its command were the new 62nd, 63rd and 64th Armies, formed from the 7th, 5th and 1st Reserve Armies, respectively. The armies of the former front had been badly battered and partly encircled in the German Operation Wilhelm (June 1015), Operation Fridericus II (June 2225), and the opening stages of Operation Blue (began June 28) and the remnants were in retreat towards the east bank of the Don River. The new front was ordered to hold a defensive line within the great bend of the Don, roughly between Kletskaya and the confluence of the Chir and the Don, preparing for the oncoming German 6th Army.<cr>On July 21, Stalin concluded that Timoshenko was no longer capable of effective command, and called Lt. Gen. V.N. Gordov to Moscow, appointing him to command of the front effective July 23. Khrushchev and Bodin remained in their respective posts. At this time Stalingrad Front had eight armies under command: the above-mentioned had been joined by the 51st,57th , 21st, 28th and 38th Armies, of which the last four were in particularly poor condition. The remnants of 28th Army were being rebuilt as the 4th Tank Army, while 38th was similarly rebuilding as 1st Tank Army. The front also commanded 8th Air Army and the Volga River Flotilla.As of Nov. 19, Stalingrad Front commanded five field armies, plus the 8th Air Army.<cr> On January 1, 1943, Stalingrad Front was renamed as the new Southern Front.<cr><cr>

text: Totenkopf fought on the northern sector of the Eastern Front from June 1941 to October 1942. It suffered such heavy losses in the initial advance on Leningrad that its 2nd SS Totenkopf Motorized Infantry Regiment (as it was then called) had to be dissolved in July 1941. Later surrounded in the Battle of the Demyansk Pocket in the winter of 194142, it distinguished itself in the heavy fighting, although it suffered tremendous losses. Of the 17,265 men who crossed into Russia with Totenkopf, 12,625 were casualties by March 20, 1942. Of these, only 5,029 had been replaced. Nevertheless, fighting with fanatical bravery, it remained in the line, playing a decisive role in keeping the sole supply route to II Corps at Demyansk open against repeated Russian attacks.<cr>By September 1942, its infantry and artillery regiments, reconnaissance, engineer, and anti-tank battalions had all suffered an average of 80 percent casualties, and the division was at less than regimental strength. Finally, in October 1942, it was sent to France, where it was rebuilt as an SS panzer division. Upon its return to the Eastern Front in February 1943, its commander and founder, General of SS Theodor Eicke, was killed when his reconnaissance plane was shot down by the Russians on February 26. The 3rd SS spent the rest of its career on the Eastern Front, serving as a fire brigade and fighting at Kharkov, Kursk (where it lost 50 percent of its tanks and vehicles), and the Dniepr campaign, where it again suffered heavy casualties. It fought at Krivoi Rog (November 1943June 1944), in the Cherkassy sector (FebruaryMarch 1944), and helped slow the Russian spring offensive of 1944 west of Kirovograd. It was transferred to Army Group Centre in July 1944, after the 4th and 9th Armies collapsed.<cr>Despite its reduced numbers, Totenkopf participated in the defense of Modlin and Warsaw and once again took heavy losses and inflicted heavy casualties on the Soviets. Transferred to Hungary in December 1944, it took part in the unsuccessful counterattack west of Budapest and in the Battle of Vienna. It ended the war in Austria, having suffered more than 54,000 casualties during the conflicta truly incredible statistic. On May 8, 1945, the 3rd SS surrendered to the U.S. Army south of Linz.<cr><cr>German Order of Battle Vol III - Panzer, Panzer Grenadier and Waffen SS Divisions in WWII, Samuel W. Mitcham Jr.
translation: 骷髅师从1941年6月到1942年10月在东线北部作战。它在进攻列宁格勒的初期行动中损失惨重，其第二摩托化步兵团（当时称为骷髅第二摩托化步兵团）不得不于1941年7月解散。在1941年至1942年冬季德梅扬斯克包围圈战役中被包围后，它在激烈的战斗中表现出色，尽管遭受了巨大损失。从1941年6月随骷髅师进入苏联的17,265名士兵中，到1942年3月20日已有12,625人伤亡，其中只有5,029人得到补充。然而，凭借狂热的勇气作战，它仍然坚守在前线，发挥了决定性作用，确保了通往德梅扬斯克第二军的唯一补给路线免受反复的苏联攻击。<cr>到1942年9月，其步兵和炮兵团、侦察营、工兵营以及反坦克营平均伤亡率已达80%，师级部队实力已低于团级规模。最终，在1942年10月，它被调往法国重建为党卫军装甲师。1943年2月返回东线时，其创始人兼指挥官SS上将西克于2月26日因侦察机被苏联击落而阵亡。骷髅第三师余下的职业生涯都在东线上度过，作为救火部队参与了哈尔科夫、库尔斯克（在那里它损失了50%的坦克和车辆）以及第聂伯河战役，在这些战斗中再次遭受严重伤亡。它在克里沃罗格作战（1943年11月至1944年6月），在切尔卡瑟地区作战（1944年2月至3月），并帮助减缓了苏联1944年的春季攻势，该攻势从基洛夫格勒以西发起。它于1944年7月被调往中央集团军群，在第四和第九集团军崩溃后。<cr>尽管人数减少，骷髅师仍参与了莫德林和华沙的防御，并再次遭受重大损失并给苏联军队造成严重伤亡。该师于1944年12月被调往匈牙利，在布达佩斯西面的反攻中失利，并参加了维也纳战役。战争结束时，该师位于奥地利境内，整个冲突期间共损失超过54000人——这真是一个令人难以置信的数字。<cr>指挥官报告：德国战斗序列 第三卷 - 装甲、装甲掷弹兵和武装党卫军师在二战中的作战情况，萨缪尔·W·米奇姆 Jr.

text: Transcaucasian Front or Transcaucasus Front was a front of the Red Army during the Second World War. This sense of the term is not identical with the more general usage of military front which indicates a geographic area in wartime, although a Soviet Front may operate within designated boundaries. The Transcaucasus Front describes two distinct organizations during the war. The first version was created on August 23, 1941 from the Transcaucasus Military District, which was apparently originally formed in 1922. The boundary of the Front extended along the border with Turkey and along the Black Sea coast from Batumi to Tuapse. It was commanded by Lieutenant-General Dmitri T. Kozlov from August 1941 to December 1941. On June 22, 1941, when Operation Barbarossa started, the TCMD included the 3rd, 24th, and 40th Rifle Corps, the 28th Mechanised Corps, two cavalry divisions (the 17th Mountain and the 24th) and three separate rifle divisions (the 63rd, 76th, and 77th). Also part of the District were three fortified regions and District troops, which included artillery and NKVD frontier units.<cr>The initial Front organization incorporated the four Soviet armies stationed in the district in June 1941: the 45th and 46th on the border with Turkey and the 44th and 47th on the border with Iran. On August 25, 1941 troops from the Front entered Iran according to the Soviet-Iran Treaty of Friendship of February 21, 1921, which eliminated the direct threat to the Baku oil fields.<cr><cr><cr>Entry courtesy NOSB
translation: 高加索方面军是苏联红军在第二次世界大战期间的一个战役战略军团。这个术语的含义不同于一般意义上的军事前线，后者指的是战争时期的地理区域。然而，一个苏联方面的作战范围可能在其指定边界内运作。高加索方面军在战争中描述了两个不同的组织。第一个版本于1941年8月23日从高加索军区成立，该军区似乎最初成立于1922年。该方面军的边界沿着与土耳其接壤的边境以及从巴统到图阿普谢的黑海海岸线延伸。它由少将德米特里·T·科佐洛夫指挥，时间是从1941年8月到1941年12月。1941年6月22日巴巴罗萨行动开始时，TCMD包括第3步兵军、第24步兵军、第40步兵军、第28机械化军和两个骑兵师（第17山地骑兵师和第24骑兵师），以及三个独立的步兵师（第63步兵师、第76步兵师和第77步兵师）。该地区还包括三个设防区和军区部队，其中包括炮兵和内务人民委员部边防单位。<cr>初始方面军组织包括1941年6月驻扎在该地区的四个苏联集团军：第45集团军和第46集团军位于与土耳其接壤的边境上，第44集团军和第47集团军位于与伊朗接壤的边境上。<cr>1941年8月25日，根据1921年2月21日签署的苏伊友好条约，方面军部队进入伊朗，消除了对巴库油田的直接威胁。

text: The Volkhov Front was formed on 17 December 1941 from the left wing of the Leningrad Front and elements of the Reserve of the Supreme High Command (Stavka Reserve) during the conduct of the Tikhvin Offensive operation under the command of the General of Army Kirill Meretskov, with General Grigory Stelmakh (former commander of the 4th Army) as Chief of Staff and Army Commissar 1st Rank A.I.Zaporozhets. Initially Sokolov's 26th Army (later 2nd Shock Army) and Galanin's 59th Armies were allocated to the Front's formation. The Front also included Meretskov's 4th Army and Klykov's 52nd Army. The Front's air support was provided by the 14th Air Army of General-Major I.P. Zhuravlev. The 8th Army that was formed in early January was also added to the Front. Initially the Front held a frontage of 250 km. The Front's neighbouring formations were the 54th Army of the Leningrad Front (later incorporated into the Volkbov Front) and the 11th Army of the Northwestern Front.<cr>The Front was disbanded and its elements reorganised as the Volkhov Operational Group and incorporated into the Leningrad Front on 23 April 1942.<cr>The Front was reformed on the 9 June 1942 from the Volkhov Operational Group of the Leningrad Front and served until 15 February 1944, participating in the relief of the Siege of Leningrad and other operations.<cr><cr>
translation: 沃尔霍夫方面军于1941年12月17日由列宁格勒方面军左翼和最高统帅部预备队（大本营预备队）的部分部队在陆军元帅基里尔·梅列茨科夫的指挥下组建，总参谋长为少将格里戈里·斯捷尔马赫（前第四集团军司令），政治委员为第一级军队政委A.I.扎波罗热茨。最初索科洛夫的第二十六集团军（后来成为第二突击集团军）和加拉宁的第五十九集团军被分配给该方面军的组建工作。梅列茨科夫的第四集团军和克利科夫的第五十二集团军也隶属于该方面军。空军支援由少将I.P.朱拉韦列夫指挥的第十四空军集团军提供。一月初成立的第八集团军也在之后加入该方面军。最初，该方面军正面宽度为250公里。相邻部队是列宁格勒方面军第五十四集团军（后来并入沃尔霍夫方面军）和西北方向第十一个集团军。<cr>1942年4月23日，该方面军解散，其部分单位重组为沃尔霍夫作战群，并被纳入列宁格勒方面军。<cr>1942年6月9日，该方面军从列宁格勒方面军的沃尔霍夫作战群中重建，并一直服役至1944年2月15日，参与解救列宁格勒围城战和其他战役。<cr>

text: The Voronezh Front was established at the end of June 1942 when tanks of the 6th Army reached Voronezh during the early stages of Stalingrad. It was a renaming of the earlier Bryansk Front.<cr>Voronezh Front participated in the Battle of Voronezh, the defensive operations on the approaches to Stalingrad, and in the December 1942 Operation Saturn, the follow-on to the encirclement of German 6th Army at Stalingrad where it destroyed the Hungarian Second Army. Following Operation Saturn the front was involved in Operation Star, which included the Third Battle of Kharkov, and resulted in a long-running battle from 2 February to 23 March 1943, and the reversal of much of the Soviet gains by the Germans. During Zvezda the front included the 38th, 40th, 60th, and 69th Armies plus the 3rd Tank Army. The 3rd Tank Army was so badly battered by the operation that it was reorganized afterwards as the 57th Army. In the Battle of Kursk in August 1943, the front operated on the southern shoulder, during which it commanded the Battle of Prokhorovka on the Soviet side.<cr>During Operation Polkovodets Rumyantsev, which began on August 3, 1943, the front included 38th, 40th, 27th, 6th Guards, 5th Guards, and 1st and 5th Guards Tank Armies. During this battle both 1st and 5th Guards Tank Armies made their main effort in the 5th Guards Army sector, and succeeded eventually in taking both Belgorod and liberating Kharkov. One of the divisions in 5th Guards Army was the 13th Guards Rifle Division. The front also fought in the subsequent liberation of eastern Ukraine.<cr>Voronezh Front was renamed to the 1st Ukrainian Front on October 20, 1943.<cr><cr>
translation: 沃罗涅日方面军成立于1942年6月底，当时第6集团军的坦克部队在斯大林格勒战役初期抵达沃罗涅日。它是早先布良斯克方面军的改名。<cr>沃罗涅日方面军参与了沃罗涅日之战、接近斯大林格勒的防御作战，以及1942年12月的土星行动（即对围困在斯大林格勒的德国第6集团军的后续行动，在此期间消灭了匈牙利第二集团军）。<cr>土星行动之后，该方面军参与了“波罗金斯基”行动，其中包括第三次哈尔科夫战役，并导致了一场从1943年2月2日至3月23日的长期战斗，苏联在此过程中取得的大部分战果被德军逆转。在“星辰”行动期间，沃罗涅日方面军包括第38集团军、第40集团军、第60集团军和第69集团军以及第3坦克集团军。<cr>由于该次作战中第3坦克集团军损失惨重，在此之后被重组为第57集团军。在1943年8月的库尔斯克战役期间，沃罗涅日方面军在南部肩头行动，并指挥了苏联方面的普罗霍罗夫卡之战。<cr>在“波将金”行动中，该方面军包括第38集团军、第40集团军、第27集团军、第6近卫集团军、第5近卫集团军以及第1和第5近卫坦克集团军。在这场战役中，第1和第5近卫坦克集团军在第5近卫集团军的战区内进行了主要努力，并最终占领了别尔哥罗德并解放了哈尔科夫。<cr>第5近卫集团军中的一个师是第13近卫步兵师。该方面军还参与了解放乌克兰东部的后续战斗。<cr>沃罗涅日方面军于1943年10月20日改名为第1乌克兰方面军。<cr>

text:
The Western Front was a Front (military formation) of the Red Army, one of the Red Army Fronts during World War II. The Western Front was created on 22 June 1941 at the start of Operation Barbarossa from the Western Special Military District (which before July 1940 was known as Belorussian Special Military District). The first Front commander was Dmitry Pavlov (continuing from his position as District Commander since June 1940).
The western boundary of the Front in June 1941 was 470 km long, from the southern border of Lithuania to the Pripyat River and the town of W?odawa. It connected with the adjacent North-Western Front, which extended from the Lithuanian border to the Baltic Sea, and the Southwestern Front in the Ukraine.<cr><cr><cr>Entry courtesy NOSB

text: The X SS Corps headquarters was formed in January 1945 with the use of men and equipment provided by the disbanded XIV SS Corps headquarters (a temporary HQ unit employed during Operation Nordwind). The Corps was subordinated to the 11th SS Panzer Army in February 1945, and then to the 3rd Panzer Army in March. They were deployed in the vicinity of Dramburg, Pomerania. In February 1945, the X SS Corps controlled the 5th Jger Division and the 402nd Division. Generalleutnant Gnther Krappe took command of the corps on February 10, 1945. In March 1945, the corps also had the 163rd Infantry Division under its control.<cr><cr>In March 1945, the X SS Corps (and Korpsgruppe Tettau) were encircled by elements of the 1st Guards Tank Army, 3rd Shock Army, and the First Polish Armyin an area approximately 20 kilometres (12 mi) north of Dramburg. The two Soviet armies pushed against the pocket from the west and northwest while the Polish 1st Army drove from the south, east, and northeast, resulting in the destruction of the encircled German troops by March 7, 1945. On March 8, 1945, the Soviets announced the capture of General Krappe and 8,000 men of the X SS Corps.<cr><cr>
translation:
第X党卫军军司令部于1945年1月成立，使用了解散的第 XIV 党卫军军司令部提供的人员和装备（一个临时司令部单位，在“北方风”行动期间被征用）。该军在1945年2月隶属于第11装甲集团军，并在3月转隶给第3装甲集团军。它们部署在波美拉尼亚德雷堡附近地区。1945年2月10日，中将贡特尔·克拉佩接管了该军的指挥权。1945年3月，该军还控制着第163步兵师。

1945年3月，第X党卫军军（和科鲁普集团）被第一波兰集团军、第1近卫坦克集团军以及第3突击集团军的部分部队包围，在德雷堡以北约20公里的地区。两个苏联集团军从西面和西北方向推进，而波兰第一集团军则从南面、东面和东北方向进攻，导致被围困的德国军队在1945年3月7日之前遭到毁灭性打击。1945年3月8日，苏军宣布俘获了克拉佩将军及其第X党卫军军中的8000名士兵。

text: The XI SS Corps was formed on July 24, 1945 from the remnants of the V Army Corps. It was attached to the 17th Army. On February 1, 1945 it was renamed the XI SS Panzer Corps and re-assigned to the 9th Army. It fought in Poland and was destroyed during the Battle of Berlin. text: The XIV Motorized Corps was renamed the XIV Panzer Corps on June 21, 1941.<cr>It participated in Operation Barbarossa, where as part of Panzer Group 1, it served with Army Group South on the southern sector of the eastern front, advancing via Lvov, Tarnopol and Zhitomir to Kremenchug and Mirgoro, and south to Marfinskaya in the Mius sector. It took part in Fall Blau where it commanded the 60th Motorized Infantry Division, 16th Panzer Division and the 3rd Infantry Motorized Division. Elements of the Corps were the first German units to reach Stalingrad. It was surrounded in the Stalingrad Pocket in November 1942 and was subsequently destroyed in January 1943.<cr><cr>

text: The XVII Corps participated in the Axis invasion of Poland in 1939 and subsequently the Balkans campaign in April 1941 before being withdrawn to southern Poland in preperation for Operation Barbarossa. The corps was part of the German Sixth Army in Army Group South and contained the 56th, 62nd and 298th Infantry Divisions. The corps, still part of Sixth Army participated in the German summer offensive Fall Blau. It contained the 79th, 113th and 294th Infantry Divisions. The corps largely escaped encirclement during Operation Little Saturn. The corps next major campaign was the Battle of Kursk in July 1943.<cr><cr><cr><cr>Entry courtesy Chris Munson
