It initially attacked towards Vilnius and was then involved in the first Battle of Minsk. By August, it was assigned to Army Group North for the attack on Leningrad. It was redesignated XXXIX Panzer Corps on July 9, 1942.<cr><cr>
translation: 该部队于1940年1月27日在第九军区哥达成立，最初为第39摩托化军。<cr>在法国战役期间隶属于古德里安装甲集群。<cr>1941年6月，该军被分配给中央集团军群参加巴巴罗萨行动。它最初向维尔纽斯方向发起攻击，并随后参与了明斯克的第一场战斗。到8月份，该部队被重新分配至北方集团军群，准备对列宁格勒的进攻。1942年7月9日，该部队改名为第39装甲军。<cr><cr>

text: The XXXV Army Corps was created from the existing Italian Expeditionary Corps in Russia when Mussolin decided to increase Italian strength on the Eastern Front from 3 divisions to 10. The Corps was attached to the the 8th Army, or Italian Army in Russia. Attached to the Corps were the 3rd Principe Amedeo Cavalry, 9th Pasubio Motorized, and 52nd Torino Motorized divisions. The Corps found itself, along with the rest of the 8th Army, stretched along a 160 mile section of the Don River between the Hungarian Second Army and Romanian 3rd Army on the German left flank at the start of Operation Little Saturn. The Corps was stationed in the center of the Italian defensive line and endured 11 days of sustained attacks before being surrounded. Some elements fought free but the much of the Corps was destroyed. The Corps returned to Italy with the rest of the 8th Army after February 1943.<cr><cr><cr>Entry courtesy Chris Munson
translation: 第35军 corps 是从现有的意大利远征军改编而成的，当时墨索里尼决定将意大利在东线的力量从3个师增加到10个师。该军隶属于第8集团军（即意大利驻俄军队）。军下辖第3阿梅迪奥亲王骑兵师、第9帕苏比奥机械化师和第52都灵机械化师。在“小土星行动”开始时，该军与第8集团军的其余部队一起，在匈牙利第二集团军和罗马尼亚第三集团军之间，沿着顿河160英里长的一段布防，位于德国左翼。该军驻扎在意军防御线中央，并在持续了11天的攻击后被包围。<cr>部分单位突围成功，但大部分军被消灭。第35军于1943年2月随第8集团军返回意大利。<cr>资料来源：克里斯·芒森<cr>

text: The XXXVIII Panzer Corps was created on Jamuary 8, 1945, by the renaming of the XXXVIII Army Corps. It was trapped in the Courland Pocket, where it surrendered at the end of the war.<cr><cr>
translation: 第38装甲军于1945年1月8日由改名第38集团军而成。它被困在库尔兰包围圈，在战争结束时投降了。<cr> <cr>

text: Formed in Luebeck, Wehrkreis X, as the XXXX Corps on January 26, 1940, this unit fought as an infantry corps in France (1940). Redesignated a motorized corps on September 15, 1940, it took part in the invasion of Greece (1941) and in the Russian campaign (1941-45). It was redesignated XXXX Panzer Corps on July 9, 1942. The XXXX fought at Kharkov (1942), in the Caucasus campaign (1942-43), in the Donets and Dnieper battles (1943), and in the subsequent retreats across Ukraine and Romania (1943-44). Transferred to East Prussia in August 1944, it was sent south again in January 1945, and fought in western Galicia. It ended the war in Silesia and surrendered to the Russians.<cr><cr>The Panzer Legions A Guide to the German Army Tank Divisions of World War II and Their Commanders Samuel W. Mitcham Jr.
translation: 成立于1940年1月26日的第40军，最初驻扎在吕贝克的第十军区。该部队作为步兵军参加了法国战役（1940年）。1940年9月15日改组为摩托化军，参与了入侵希腊（1941年）和苏联战役（1941-45年）。1942年7月9日重新编组为第40装甲军。该部队参加了哈尔科夫战役（1942年）、高加索战役（1942-43年）、顿涅茨克和第聂伯河战役（1943年），以及随后在乌克兰和罗马尼亚的撤退行动（1943-44年）。该部队于1944年8月被调往东普鲁士，1945年1月又被派往南线，在加利西亚西部作战。战争结束时位于西里西亚，并向苏联投降。<cr>装甲军团：二战德军坦克师及其指挥官指南<cr>萨缪尔·W·米查姆 Jr.

text: This unit was formed in Brieg, Wehrkreis VIII, on February 24, 1940, as the XXXXI Motorized Corps. In late 1940, its home station was moved to Breslau and later to Oels. The corps fought in Belgium and France in 1940 (and was at the decisive Battle of Sedan). After serving as an occupation force in the Netherlands and in Paris, it was sent east, and fought on the Russian Front until 1945. It was renamed the XXXXI Panzer Corps on July 10, 1942. The Corps was virtually destroyed at Bobruisk in June 1944, when Army Group Center was smashed. Hastily rebuilt, it fought in East Prussia until March 1945, when it was sent to the 12th Army on the Havel. It surrendered to the Western Allies at the end of the war.<cr><cr>The Panzer Legions A Guide to the German Army Tank Divisions of World War II and Their Commanders, Samuel W. Mitcham Jr.
translation: 该部队成立于1940年2月24日，当时是第八军区布里格的第31摩托化军。到1940年末，其驻地迁至布雷斯劳，并最终移至奥尔斯。该军在1940年的比利时和法国作战（并在决定性的色当战役中参战）。作为占领荷兰和巴黎的力量服役后，它被派往东线，在俄罗斯方面军作战直至1945年。该部队于1942年7月10日改名为第31装甲军。在1944年6月的鲍里索夫战役中，该军几乎被消灭（当时中央集团军群遭到重创）。仓促重建后，它继续在东普鲁士作战，直到1945年3月被调往哈弗尔河畔的第12集团军。该部队在战争结束时向西方盟国投降。<cr>装甲军团：二战德国陆军坦克师及其指挥官指南，萨缪尔·W·米查姆少校

text: The XXXXVI was formed in Goerlitz, Wehrkreis VIII, on October 25, 1940, as a motorized corps. It was redesignated a panzer corps on June 14, 1942. It fought in Yugoslavia and on the Eastern Front (1941-45), mostly on the central sector. It ended the war fighting in Pomerania with the 3rd Panzer Army and managed to surrender to the British.<cr><cr>The Panzer Legions A Guide to the German Army Tank Divisions of World War II and Their Commanders Samuel W. Mitcham Jr.
translation: 第46摩托化军于1940年10月25日在戈尔利茨，卫戍区8成立。该部队于1942年6月14日改编为装甲军。它参加了南斯拉夫战役和东线战场（1941-45），主要在中央战区作战。战争结束时，该军与第3装甲集团军一起在波美拉尼亚作战，并成功向英军投降。<cr>【参考文献】<cr>《装甲军团：二战德军坦克师及其指挥官指南》<cr>山姆·米查姆 Jr.

text: This staff was formed in Hanover, Wehrkreis XI as a motorized corps. It was upgraded to a panzer corps on June 21, 1942. It fought on the Russian Front (1941-44) before being transferred to France in April 1944. It fought in Normandy, Metz, the Siegfried Line campaign, the Ardennes, and the Battle of the Ruhr Pocket, where it was destroyed. Its survivors surrendered to the Americans.<cr><cr>The Panzer Legions A Guide to the German Army Tank Divisions of World War II and Their Commanders, Sameul W. Mitcham Jr.
translation: 该指挥部成立于汉诺威，隶属于第十一军区的一个摩托化军。它在1942年6月21日升级为装甲军。它参加了东线战场（1941-44）的战斗，并于1944年4月被转移到法国。它参与了诺曼底战役、梅斯战役、齐格菲防线战役、阿登战役以及鲁尔包围圈战役，在后者中被消灭。幸存者向美军投降。<cr>装甲军团：二战德军坦克师及其指挥官指南，萨缪尔·W·米查姆

text: The 395th Rifle Division was converted from a militia division to a regular infantry division of the Red Army in October 1941, and served WWII in that role. As a militia unit it was under command of the and designated as the Voroshilovgrad Militia Division, although it was unofficially known as the 395th before it was converted. It took part in the fighting near Rostov during the winter of 1941-42 in the 18th Army, and retreated with that Army into the northern Caucasus mountains in the face of the German summer offensive, fighting under the command of the 18th and 12th Armies, then in the 56th Army in October. As the Axis forces retreated from the Caucasus in early 1943 it was sent to the 46th and later to the 37th Army of North Caucasus Front. During the battles that cleared the German forces from the Taman peninsula from August to October the 395th was back in 56th Army and was awarded a battle honor for its part in the campaign. By the end of 1943 it had returned to 18th Army, now under 1st Ukrainian Front near Kiev. In January, 1944 the division was decorated with both the Order of the Red Banner and the Order of Suvorov. With its Front it advanced through western Ukraine, Poland and eastern Germany, finally taking part in the Lower Silesia, Berlin, and Prague offensives in early 1945 as part of 13th Army.<cr><cr>
translation: 第395步兵师于1941年10月从民兵改编为红军正规步兵师，并在二战中一直担任此角色。作为民兵单位时，它隶属于指挥并被指定为沃罗希洛夫格勒民兵师，尽管在改编前它非正式地被称为第395师。该师参加了1941-1942年冬季罗斯托夫附近的战斗，并随第18集团军撤退到北高加索山脉，在德国夏季攻势面前作战，先后隶属于第18和第12集团军，后于10月转入第56集团军。随着轴心国部队在1943年初从高加索地区撤退，该师被派往第46集团军，并最终转至北高加索方面军的第37集团军。<cr>在8月至10月清除塔曼半岛德军的过程中，第395步兵师重新回到第56集团军并因参与此次战役而获得荣誉。到1943年底，该师返回了第18集团军，并隶属于第一乌克兰方面军靠近基辅的部队。<cr>1944年1月，该师被授予红旗勋章和苏沃洛夫勋章。随着其方面的推进，它穿越了西乌克兰、波兰和东德，在1945年初作为第13集团军参与下西里西亚、柏林和布拉格攻势。<cr>指挥官报告<cr>

text: The 411th Rifle Division was formed in September 1941 as an infantry division of the Red Army, at Chuhuiv in eastern Ukraine. It was a 'sister' unit to the 393rd Rifle Division, which was formed at about the same time and place and shared a very similar combat path during 1941-42. The division was assigned to the southern sector of the Soviet-German front during the winter winter counteroffensive, but was encircled during the German spring offensive that formed the Izium Pocket; unable to escape as a formed unit, the scattered survivors were not sufficient to warrant rebuilding the division, and it was officially disbanded on June 30, 1942. The 411th had one of the shortest and least distinguished careers of any Soviet rifle division.<cr><cr>
translation: 第411步兵师成立于1941年9月，是红军的一个步兵师，在乌克兰东部的楚胡伊夫组建。它与同年同地组建、在1941年至1942年间有着非常相似战斗经历的第393步兵师互为“姊妹”部队。该师被分配到苏德战场南部战区参加冬季反攻，但在德国春季攻势中被困于伊久姆包围圈；无法作为完整单位逃脱的散落幸存者不足以重建该师，因此它在1942年6月30日正式解散。第411步兵师有着苏联步兵师中最短且最不显赫的职业生涯。<cr><cr>

text: The 412th Rifle Division was formed in Kirov Oblast as part of the Arkhangelsk Military District in December 1941 from the 48th Reserve Rifle Brigade. The 412th included the 1355th, 1357th, and 1358th Rifle Regiments in addition to the 1022nd Artillery Regiment and the 910th Separate Communications Battalions, along with smaller units. It was relocated to the southwestern part of Vologda Oblast before being renumbered as the 24th Rifle Division.<cr><cr>
translation: 第412步兵师于1941年12月在基洛夫州作为阿尔汉格尔斯克军区的一部分，由第48预备步兵旅组建。第412师包括第1355、1357和1358步兵团以及第1022炮兵团和第910独立通信营，还有其他较小的单位。<cr>该师随后被调往沃洛格达州西南部，并改番为第24步兵师。<cr> <cr>

text:
The 357th Rifle Division began forming in August, 1941, in the Urals Military District. In December it was assigned to the 39th Army, Kalinin Front, and first went into combat in January 1942 helping to carve out the Rzhev salient. The Division held a precarious position north of Belyi and in July 1942 was surrounded and trapped by the Axis in Operation Sedlitz. Luckily the encirclement was not strong and many sections of the Division escaped to Soviet lines intact. The Division was assigned to the Moscow Military District for rebuilding.
 
In November, 1942 the Division was assigned to the 3rd Shock Army and participated in operations to eliminate Axis forces in the area of Battle of Velikiye Luki, at the end of which the 3rd Shock Army was in a weakened state, with most divisions down to 6,000 men. It was not until October 1943 that the Division was back in the line taking part in the liberation of Nevel.
 
In 1944 the Division took part in Operation Bagration and operations in the Baltic and was recognised for its part in the liberation of Riga. The Division ended the war in Courland, assigned to the 1st Rifle Corps, 1st Shock Army, holding the line against the pocketed remnants of Army Group North.
 
The Division was awarded the Order of Suvorov (Riga).
 
 

 
Courtesy of John Tomlinson
translation:
第357步兵师于1941年8月在乌拉尔军区开始组建。同年12月，该师被分配给加里宁方面军的第39集团军，并于1942年1月首次参战，在帮助形成别利以北的热季突出部时发挥了作用。1942年7月，该师在贝拉津行动中被轴心国军队包围并陷入困境。幸运的是，包围并不牢固，许多部队得以完整地撤回苏联防线内。随后，第357步兵师被分配到莫斯科军区进行重建。

1942年11月，该师被分配给第3突击集团军，并参与了在维捷布斯克战役区域消灭轴心国军队的行动，在此过程中，第3突击集团军因损失惨重而战斗力下降，大多数师的人数减少到6000人。直到1943年10月，该师才重新参战，参加了解放内夫列尔的战斗。

在1944年的巴格拉季昂行动和波罗的海地区的作战中，第357步兵师发挥了重要作用，并因参与解放里加而受到表彰。战争结束时，该师被分配给第1突击集团军的第1步兵军，在库尔兰地区坚守阵地，对抗北方集团军群残部。

该师荣获苏沃罗夫勋章（里加）。

 

感谢约翰·汤姆林森

text:
The first 416th Rifle Division began forming on December 9, 1941, in the Moscow Military District. The division was still forming up on January 27, 1942, when it was re-designated as the 2nd formation of the 146th Rifle Division while still in the Moscow region.<cr><cr>The second 416th Rifle Division began forming on March 15, 1942, at Sumgait in the Transcaucasus Military District, this time as a division of Azerbaijani nationals. It continued to form up in this District until July.<cr><cr>The division was first assigned to the 44th Army, and in late August it was defending along the Terek River on the northern approaches to Grozny. After September the 416th was transferred to the 58th Army in Transcaucasus Front's Northern Group. At year's end it was back in 44th Army, which was transferred to the South Front in February 1943. After liberating Rostov-na-Donu on the 14th, the front came up against the German fortified positions along the Mius River and were held there until the line was broken at the outset of the Donbass Strategic Offensive in August. 44th Army was on the front's left flank, and on August 30 the 416th participated in the liberation of the city of Taganrog, and received its name as an honorific. Immediately following, the division was moved to 28th Army, and after the front was renamed 4th Ukrainian in October, the 416th was shifted once again in November, joining 37th Rifle Corps in the 3rd Guards Army.

In February 1944, the division made its first major shift of commands, to the 5th Shock Army of 3rd Ukrainian Front. Apart from a brief shift with its corps to 46th Army in May, it would remain in that army for the duration. During the 1st Jassy-Kishinev Offensive in April 1944, 5th Shock assisted in the liberation of Odessa, but soon after came up against the German/Romanian defenses along the Dniestr River. On the night of 18-19 April, 37th Corps attempted an assault crossing to seize the German strongpoint at Talmazy, but was unsuccessful; the 416th was in reserve during this attack. A further effort was made in early May with similar results, and after several successful German counterattacks, the front went over to the defense in mid-May.

The division participated in the Second Jassy-Kishinev Offensive in late August. After this offensive was well underway, 5th Shock Army was withdrawn to the Reserve of the Supreme High Command. In October it became part of the 1st Belorussian Front, and the 416th became part of the 32nd Rifle Corps; it would remain in that front and that corps for the duration and afterwards. Under these commands it took part in the Vistula-Oder Offensive and the East Pomeranian Offensive, during which it played a main role in the capture of the fortified city of Kstrin, leading to the final offensive on Berlin.

During the Battle of Berlin, the division, with its corps, captured the Jannowitzbrcke station S-Bahn station on April 29, and attacked the City Palace the next day. The division also helped capture the Reichsbank on May 1. The soldiers of the 416th ended the war with the official title of 416th Rifle, Taganrog, Order of the Red Banner, Order of Suvorov Division.<cr><cr>
translation:
第一个第416步兵师于1941年12月9日在莫斯科军区开始组建。该师直到1942年1月27日仍在组建，此时在莫斯科地区被重新指定为第146步兵师的第二个建制单位。<cr>第二个第416步兵师于1942年3月15日在高加索军区苏姆盖特开始组建，这次是阿塞拜疆国民组成的部队。该师继续在该军区内组建直到7月。<cr>该师首次被分配给第44集团军，在8月下旬它沿特erek河防守格罗兹内的北部入口。9月份之后，第416步兵师转隶高加索方面军北方集群的第58集团军。年底时又回到第44集团军，后者于1943年2月被转移到南方面军。<cr>在解放罗斯托夫-诺沃西尔斯基后，前线遭遇了沿米乌斯河德国防御工事，并在那里坚守直到高加索战略进攻开始时的8月初。第44集团军位于前线左翼，在8月30日，第416步兵师参与了解放塔甘罗格市并因此获得荣誉名称。<cr>随后该师被调至第28集团军，并在10月方面军改名为第四乌克兰方面军后，于11月再次调动，加入第三近卫集团军的第37步兵军。

1944年2月，该师首次大规模调动指挥权，加入第3乌克兰方面军的第5突击集团军。除了在5月份短暂随其所属军调至第46集团军外，它一直留在该集团军直到战争结束。<cr><cr>在1944年4月进行的第一阶段雅西-奇尔诺夫攻势中，第5突击集团军协助解放了敖德萨。但很快便遇到了沿德涅斯特河的德国/罗马尼亚防御工事。<cr><cr>在4月18日至19日夜间，第37军试图强渡德涅斯特河夺取塔尔马济的德军据点，但未成功；第416师在此期间处于预备状态。5月初再次尝试类似行动，结果相同，在几次成功的德国反击后，该方面军在5月中旬转入防御。<cr><cr>

该师参加了第二次雅西-奇尔卡斯基攻势，时间是在八月末。在此次攻势进展顺利之后，第5突击集团军被调往最高统帅部预备队。十月时，它成为第1白俄罗斯方面军的一部分；第416师则成为了第32步兵军的组成部分，并且在此后一直留在该方面军和该军中。

在这些指挥下，它参与了维斯瓦-奥得攻势以及东波美拉尼亚攻势，在此期间，它在攻克设防城市科希策的过程中发挥了主要作用，最终为攻占柏林奠定了基础。

在柏林战役中，该师与其所属第 <cr> 军于4月29日占领了雅诺维茨桥站的市郊铁路车站，并于次日进攻城市宫。该师还协助于5月1日攻占帝国银行。第416步兵师（塔甘罗格，红旗勋章、苏沃洛夫勋章）在战争结束时获得了正式称号。<cr><cr>

text:
The 421st began forming on September 1, 1941 in Odessa in the Odessa Military District. Its order of battle, based on the last prewar shtat (table of organization and equipment) of April 5, 1941 for rifle divisions, was as follows:

1327th Rifle Regiment (from October 25)
1330th Rifle Regiment (until October 26; re-designated as 1331st)
3rd Naval Rifle Regiment (September 26 October 15)
54th Rifle Regiment (until September 26)
983rd Artillery Regiment
134th Howitzer Artillery Regiment
705th Antiaircraft Battalion
480th Reconnaissance Company
688th Sapper Battalion (later 247th)
860th Signal Battalion (later 150th)
503rd Medical/Sanitation Battalion
484th Chemical Protection (Anti-gas) Company
513th Motor Transport Company
318th Field Bakery
1474th Field Postal Station
865th Field Office of the State Bank
It was formed on the basis of the Eastern Group of Forces of the Odessa Military District, including militia, border guards and reservists. From September 3 to September 10 it was designated as the Odessa Rifle Division, but then reverted to the 421st. Col. Grigorii Matveevich Kochenov was appointed to command on the day the division began forming and remained in that position until it was disbanded. It immediately came under command of the Separate Coastal Army.<cr><cr>

text:
The 358th Rifle Division began forming in August, 1941, at Buguruslan, in the Volga Military District. In December it was moved to the Moscow area and assigned to the newly formed 4th Shock Army, Northwestern Front, and first went into combat in January 1942, at nearly full strength, eventually liberating Toropets. The offensive quickly ran out of steam and the Division took up a defensive position for the next 18 months.

In August 1943 the Division participated in unsuccessful operations to liberate Vitebsk, and in early 1944 was in Reserve for rebuilding. In April 1944 the Division was transferred to the Karelian Isthmus and participated in the successful offensive that captured the city of Vyborg.

In January 1945, assigned to the 94th Rifle Corps, 39th Army the Division fought in East Prussia and at Knigsberg. The Division was then transferred to the Far East where it took part in the invasion of Manchuria.

The Division was awarded the Order of the Red Banner, Order of Suvorov and the honorifics 'LENINGRAD' and 'KHINGHAN'.




Courtesy of John Tomlinson
translation:
第358步兵师于1941年8月在伏尔加河军区的布古鲁斯拉夫开始组建。同年12月，该师被调往莫斯科地区，并编入新成立的第四突击集团军（西北方面军）。1942年1月，该师以接近满员的状态首次投入战斗，最终解放了托罗佩茨。进攻很快失去动力，接下来的18个月里，第358步兵师采取防御态势。

1943年8月，该师参与了解放维捷布斯克未果的行动，并于1944年初进入预备状态重建。1944年4月，该师被调往卡累利阿地峡，参加了成功解放维堡城的进攻作战。

1945年1月，第358步兵师编入第94步兵军（第39集团军），在东普鲁士和柯尼斯堡地区作战。之后该师被调往远东地区，并参与了入侵满洲的行动。

第358步兵师获得了红旗勋章、苏沃洛夫勋章以及“列宁格勒”、“黑龙江”的荣誉称号。

text:
The 359th Rifle Division began forming in August, 1941, in the Urals Military District. In December, at nearly full strength, it was moved to the Moscow area and assigned to the newly formed 31st Army, Kalinin Front. It was in the front line in the Rzhev area and in 1942 took part in Operation Mars without success. 

In August 1943, as part of the 36th Rifle Corps, 31st Army, Western Front, the Division participated in operations to liberate Smolensk, and then Orsha but by the end of the year was in Reserve for rebuilding. In early 1944 the Division was moved South and became part of the 1st Ukrainian Front where it fought its way across the Ukraine and into Poland.

In January 1945, assigned to the 76th Rifle Corps, 6th Army the Division fought with distinction in the siege and capture of Breslau. 

The Division was awarded the Order of the Red Banner, Order of Lenin and the honorific 'YARTSEVO'.




Courtesy of John Tomlinson
translation:
第359步兵师于1941年8月在乌拉尔军区开始组建。同年12月，该师几乎满编后被调往莫斯科地区，并分配给新成立的第31集团军、加里宁方面军。该师部署在勒热夫地区的前线，在1942年的火星行动中参战但未取得成功。

1943年8月，作为第36步兵军、西方面军第31集团军的一部分，该师参与了解放斯摩棱斯克和奥尔沙的作战行动。到年底时，该师进入预备状态重建。1944年初，该师被调往南方，并成为第1乌克兰方面军的一员，在乌克兰境内战斗并推进至波兰。

1945年1月，作为第76步兵军、第6集团军的一部分，该师在布雷斯劳的围攻和占领中表现出色。

该师荣获红旗勋章、列宁勋章以及“雅罗斯拉夫”荣誉称号。

text:
In 1941, the 403rd Security Division was formed from the local defense unit, Special Administrative Division Staff 403, with the home station of Berlin. The Division served in Russia behind the lines of Army Groups Center and Army Group South performing security duties, and whilst never committed to combat as a Division, some elements of the Division served in the front line.

After the Axis disaster at Stalingrad, the Division was disbanded in 1943 with its components used to rebuild the 79th, 265th Infantry Division and 384th Infantry Divisions.

S.W. Mitcham Jr, Hitler's Legions

Courtesy of John Tomlinson
translation:
1941年，第403治安师由地方防卫单位、特别行政管理部第403处组建，并以柏林为驻地。该师在俄罗斯后方支援中央集团军群和南方集团军群执行治安任务，尽管从未作为一个整体投入战斗，但其部分部队曾参与前线作战。

轴心国在斯大林格勒的灾难之后，该师于1943年解散，其组成部分被用于重建第79步兵师、第265步兵师和第384步兵师。

S.W. Mitcham Jr,《希特勒的军团》

感谢 John Tomlinson

text:
In the winter of 1940/1941, the 207th Infantry Division, home station of Stargard, was converted into the 207th Security Division, being stripped of an Infantry Regiment and artillery. 

The Division served in Russia behind the lines of Army Group North performing security duties, but did see some combat in mopping up operations in 1941.

Headquartered at Tartu in Estonia, the Division was committed to front line combat after the Axis disasters of 1944, and suffered such heavy casualties it was disbanded.

S.W. Mitcham Jr, Hitler's Legions

Courtesy of John Tomlinson
translation:
1940/1941年冬季，驻扎在斯特加德的第207步兵师被改编为第207治安师，撤除了一个步兵团和炮兵部队。

该师在俄罗斯后方执行治安任务，隶属于北方集团军群，但在1941年的清缴行动中也参与了一些战斗。

总部设于爱沙尼亚塔尔图的该师，在轴心国1944年灾难性失败之后被投入前线作战，并遭受了严重损失最终解散。

摘自 S.W. Mitcham Jr 的《希特勒的军团》

感谢 John Tomlinson 提供

text:
The 360th Rifle Division began forming in August, 1941, at Chkalovsk, in the Volga Military District. In December it was moved to the Moscow area and assigned to the newly formed 4th Shock Army, Northwestern Front, and first went into combat in January 1942, advancing on Tropets, and capturing much needed supplies. 

In late 1942 the Division participated in operations to liberate Velikiye Luki, and in 1943 fought with distinction in the liberation of Nevel. The Division then took part in the grinding battles for the liberation of Vitebsk and then Polotsk and by this stage it was down to 5000 men. In July 1944, when preparing for the Baltic Offensive, the commander I.I. Chinnov, was killed by a sniper, and his adjutant severely wounded.

In February 1945, the Division was assigned to the 119th Rifle Corps, 1st Shock Army the Division and ended the war containing Axis units trapped in the Courland Pocket. 

The Division was awarded the Order of the Red Banner and the honorific 'NEVEL'.




Courtesy of John Tomlinson
translation:
第360步兵师于1941年8月在伏尔加河军区的恰洛夫斯克开始组建。同年12月，该师被调往莫斯科地区，并编入新成立的北方方面军第4突击集团军。1942年1月，该师首次投入战斗，在特罗佩茨推进并缴获了大量急需的补给。

1942年底，该师参与了解放维捷布斯克的行动；1943年在解放内夫尔的战斗中表现出色。随后，该师参加了为解放维捷布斯克和波洛茨克而进行的艰苦战斗，在此阶段兵力缩减至5000人。1944年7月，在准备巴尔干攻势时，指挥官I.I.奇诺夫被狙击手击毙，副官也严重受伤。

1945年2月，该师被编入第119步兵军、第1突击集团军，并在战役结束时包围了轴心国部队困守的库尔兰半岛包围圈。

该师荣获红旗勋章，并获得“内夫尔”荣誉称号。

text:
The 171st Soviet Rifle Division was formed in 1939 in the Urals Military District and was assigned to the 34th Rifle Corps, 19th Army, Stavka Reserves (RVGK). 

At the start of the war, the Division was close to 80% strength, but was lacking in support services and transport for heavy equipment. In July 1941 the Division was assigned to the rebuilt 27th Rifle Corps, 37th Army, Southwestern Front, and was completely destroyed in the Kiev pocket in September 1941. 

The Division was formed for a second time in early 1942, based on the forming 440th Rifle Division, in the Urals Military District. In April 1943 it was assigned to the 34th Army of the Northwestern Front. The Division fought at Demyansk where it suffered heavy casualties, in Operation Bagration, the Berlin and finished the war assigned to the 3rd Shock Army, 1st Belorussian Front.

The Division was awarded the Order of the Red Banner, Order of Kutuzov and the honorifics 'IDRITSKAYA' and 'BERLIN'.



Nigel Askey, Operation Barbarossa, Vol IIIB 

Courtesy of John Tomlinson
translation:
第171苏联步兵师成立于1939年，在乌拉尔军区组建，并被分配给第34步兵军，第19集团军，最高统帅部预备队（RVGK）。

战争开始时，该师接近80% s实力，但支援服务和重型装备运输不足。1941年7月，该师被分配到重建的第27步兵军，第37集团军，西南方面军，并于1941年9月在基辅包围圈中完全被消灭。

该师于1942年初第二次组建，在乌拉尔军区基于正在组建的第440步兵师。1943年4月，它被分配给西北方面军的第34集团军。该师参加了德米扬斯克战役，并在巴格拉季昂行动、柏林战役中作战，最终于战争末期被分配到第一白俄罗斯方面军的第3突击集团军。

该师荣获红旗勋章、库图佐夫勋章以及“IDRITSKAYA”和“BERLIN”的荣誉称号。


尼格尔·阿斯基，《巴巴罗萨行动》，第三卷B

约翰·汤姆林森提供

text:
The 1st Tank Division was formed in 1940 and was stationed near Kandalaksha on the White Sea. At the start of the war the Division was close to full strength, even having some T-34s and KV tanks, and was assigned to the 1st Mechanized Corps, Leningrad Military District. In July the Division moved south to defend Leningrad where it suffered heavy casualties. Its 2nd Tank Regiment was disbanded in August to form tank battalions and the rest of the Division was disbanded in September 1941 to form the 123rd Tank Brigade, amongst others.

Nigel Askey, Operation Barbarossa, Vol IIIA

Courtesy of John Tomlinson
translation:
第1坦克师成立于1940年，驻扎在白海附近的堪达拉克沙。战争开始时，该师接近满编状态，甚至装备了一些T-34和KV坦克，并被分配给第一机械化军、列宁格勒军区。7月，该师南下防御列宁格勒，在那里遭受了重大伤亡。其第二坦克团于8月解散重组为坦克营，其余部队则在1941年9月解散重组为第123坦克旅等单位。

尼格尔·阿斯基，《巴巴罗萨行动》，第三卷A

约翰·汤姆林森提供

text:
The 198th Mechanised Division started forming in March 1941 and was assigned to the 10th Mechanized Corps, Leningrad Military District. At the start of the war the Division was well under strength and was not fit for combat. As such it was held in reserve with the 23rd Army and some elements were assigned to other units. The Division was disbanded in September 1941 with the personnel used to form the 198th Rifle Division.

Nigel Askey, Operation Barbarossa, Vol IIIA

Courtesy of John Tomlinson
translation:
第198机械化师于1941年3月开始组建，并被分配到列宁格勒军区的第10机械化军。战争初期，该师兵力严重不足且不适合作战。因此它被置于预备状态，隶属于第23集团军，部分部队被调往其他单位。该师在1941年9月解散，人员用于组建第198步兵师。

尼格尔·阿斯基，《巴巴罗萨行动》，第三卷A

约翰·汤姆林森提供

text:
The 115th Rifle Division was formed in 1940 in Nalchik, near the Caucasus Mountains and at the start of the Operation Barbarossa was close to full strength, assigned to the 19th Rifle Corps, 23rd Army, Leningrad Military District. The Division took part in the defence of the Karelian Isthmus and Leningrad and by November 1941 the Division was assigned to the Neva Operational Group. 

In 1942/43 the Division was assigned to the Volkhov Front and fought its way along the Baltic and to East Prussia. It ended the war assigned to the 43rd Army, 3rd Belorussian Front.



Nigel Askey, Operation Barbarossa, Vol IIIA 

Courtesy of John Tomlinson
translation:
第115步兵师成立于1940年，在高加索山脉附近的纳尔奇克。巴巴罗萨行动开始时，该师接近满编，并被分配给第19步兵军、第23集团军、列宁格勒军区。

该师参与了卡累利阿地峡和列宁格勒的防御工作。到1941年11月，该师被分配给了涅瓦作战群。

在1942/43年间，该师被分配给沃尔霍夫方面军，并沿着波罗的海一路战斗至东普鲁士。战争结束时，该师隶属于第43集团军、第3白俄罗斯方面军。

内格尔·阿斯基，《巴巴罗萨行动》第三卷A

约翰·汤姆林森提供
